ispec.label: iSpec 附件摘录

chapters.definitionEN: Manufacturers' recommended time limits for inspections, maintenance checks and inspections (both scheduled and unscheduled).
chapters.definitionZH: Manufacturers' recommended 时限 用于 检查， 维修检查 和 检查 (both 计划 和 非计划)。

chapters.definitionEN: Those charts, diagrams, and text which show the area, dimensions, stations, access doors/zoning (Ref. [Heading 3-1-3.3]) and physical locations, of the major structural members of the aircraft. Includes an explanation of the system of zoning and measurement used.
chapters.definitionZH: 这些 charts， diagrams， 和 text 其 show area， dimensions， stations， access 门/zoning (Ref。[航向 3-1-3。3]) 和 physical locations， 的 major 结构的 members 的 飞机。包括an explanation 的 系统 的 zoning 和 measurement used。

chapters.definitionEN: This chapter shall include the necessary procedures to lift & shore aircraft in any of the conditions to which it may be subjected. Includes lifting and shoring procedures that may be employed during aircraft maintenance and repair.
chapters.definitionZH: 本章应包括必要的 程序 至 lift和shore 飞机 在 any 的 情况 至 其 it may be subjected。包括lifting 和 shoring 程序 该 may be employed during 飞机维修和修理。

chapters.definitionEN: This chapter shall include the necessary information to properly level the aircraft for any of the various maintenance, overhaul or major repairs which might become necessary during the life of the aircraft. It shall also include those units or components which are specifically dedicated to record, store or compute weight and balance data. Includes those maintenance practices necessary to prepare the aircraft for weighing.
chapters.definitionZH: 本章应包括必要的 information 至 properly level 飞机 用于 any 的 various 维修， 翻修 或 major repairs 其 might become 必要的 during life 的 飞机。It shall also include 这些 装置 或 部件 其 are specifically dedicated 至 record， 储存 或 compute weight 和 balance 数据。包括这些 维修施工 必要的 至 prepare 飞机 用于 weighing。

chapters.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to tow and taxi the aircraft. Charts showing location of attachment points, turning radius, etc., shall be included. Includes those maintenance practices necessary to prepare the aircraft for towing and taxiing.
chapters.definitionZH: 指为tow 和 taxi 飞机所必需的说明和程序。Charts showing location 的 连接点， 转弯半径， 等， shall be included。包括这些 维修施工 必要的 至 prepare 飞机 用于 towing 和 taxiing。

chapters.titleEN: PARKING, MOORING, STORAGE & RETURN TO SERVICE
chapters.titleZH: 停放、系留、存放与恢复适航
chapters.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to park, store, moor and prepare the aircraft for service in any of the conditions to which it may be subjected. Charts showing location of landing gear and control surface locks, blanking plugs and covers, mooring points, etc., shall be included. Includes those maintenance practices necessary to prepare the aircraft for parking, mooring, or storage.
chapters.definitionZH: 指为park， 储存， moor 和 prepare 飞机 用于 service 在 any 的 情况 至 其 it may be subjected所必需的说明和程序。Charts showing location 的 起落架和操纵面锁， 堵头和盖板， 系留点， 等， shall be included。包括这些 维修施工 必要的 至 prepare 飞机 用于 parking， mooring， 或 storage。

chapters.definitionEN: All procurable placards, labels, etc., shall be included in the illustrated Parts Catalog. They shall be illustrated, showing the part number, Legend and Location. The Maintenance Manual shall provide the approximate Location (i.e., FWD-UPPER-RH) and illustrate each placard, label, marking, self-illuminating sign, etc., required for safety information, maintenance significant information or by government regulations. Those required by government regulations shall be so identified.
chapters.definitionZH: 所有 procurable placards， labels， 等， shall be included 在 图解零件目录。They shall be illustrated， showing 件号， 标注和位置。维修手册 shall provide approximate Location (i。e， FWD-UPPER-RH) 和 illustrate each placard， label， marking， 自发光标志， 等， 要求的 用于 安全信息， 维修重要信息 或 由 政府规章。这些 要求的 由 政府规章 shall be so identified。

chapters.definitionEN: Those instructions for the replenishment of fluids, scheduled and unscheduled servicing applicable to the whole airplane. The information shall be concise and preferably in tabular or chart form. Precautions to be observed in servicing a particular tank or reservoir, such as grounding and prevention of fire hazards, shall be clearly stated. Instructions regarding access to any out-of-the-way or unusual places requiring service shall be given. A diagram showing location of regular and emergency servicing points shall be included. "No-step" areas or walkways leading to any tank in a wing or hull, with necessary precautions, shall be indicated.
chapters.definitionZH: 这些 说明 用于 replenishment 的 fluids， 计划 和 非计划 servicing applicable 至 whole 飞机。information shall be concise 和 preferably 在 tabular 或 chart form。Precautions 至 be observed 在 servicing a particular 油箱或储液箱， 例如 接地和防火危险， shall be clearly stated。说明 regarding access 至 any 偏僻或特殊位置 requiring service shall be given。A diagram showing location 的 常规和应急勤务点 shall be included。"No-step" areas 或 walkways leading 至 any tank 在 a wing 或 hull， 带有 必要的 precautions， shall be indicated。

chapters.titleZH: 振动和噪声分析（仅直升机）
chapters.definitionEN: This chapter shall provide the necessary information to enable operators to monitor and diagnose vibration and noise levels in order to identify imbalance, damage or misalignment in helicopter dynamic and structural components.
chapters.definitionZH: 本章应提供必要的 information 至 enable operators 至 monitor 和 diagnose vibration 和 noise levels 在 order 至 identify imbalance， damage 或 misalignment 在 直升机 dynamic 和 结构的 部件。

chapters.titleZH: 标准施工-机体（参见主题3-1-5）

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components which furnish a means of pressurizing, heating, cooling, moisture controlling, filtering and treating the air used to ventilate the areas of the fuselage within the pressure seals. Includes cabin supercharger, equipment cooling, heater, heater fuel system, expansion turbine, valves, scoops, ducts, etc.
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于furnish a means 的 pressurizing， heating， cooling， moisture controlling， filtering 和 treating air 用于 ventilate areas 的 机身 在。内 压力 seals的装置和部件。包括cabin supercharger， equipment cooling， heater， heater 燃油系统， expansion 涡轮， 活门， scoops， 管道， 等。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components which furnish a means of automatically controlling the flight of the aircraft. Includes those units and components which control direction, heading, attitude, altitude and speed.
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于furnish a means 的 automatically controlling flight 的 飞机的装置和部件。包括这些 装置 和 部件 其 控制 方向， 航向， 姿态， 高度 和 速度。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components which furnish a means of communicating from one part of the aircraft to another and between the aircraft and another aircraft or ground stations. Includes voice, data, C-W communicating components, reproducers, all transmitting/receiving equipment, associated antennas, etc.
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于furnish a means 的 communicating 从 one part 的 飞机 至 another 和 between 飞机 和 another 飞机 或 ground stations的装置和部件。包括voice， 数据， C-W communicating 部件， reproducers， 所有 transmitting/receiving equipment， associated 天线， 等。

chapters.definitionEN: Those electrical units and components which generate, control and supply AC and/or DC electrical power for other systems, including generators and relays, inverters, batteries, etc., through the secondary busses. Also includes common electrical items such as wiring, switches, connectors, etc.
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于产生， 控制 和 供给 AC 和/或 直流电源 用于 other 系统， including generators 和 继电器， inverters， batteries， 等， through 二级汇流条的电气装置及部件。还包括common electrical items 例如 导线/布线， 开关， connectors， 等。

chapters.definitionEN: Those removable items of equipment and furnishings contained in the flight and passenger compartments. Includes emergency, galley and lavatory equipment. Does not include structures or equipment assigned specifically to other chapters.
chapters.definitionZH: 指contained 在 flight 和 passenger compartments的可拆卸设备和客舱装饰件。包括应急， 厨房 和 盥洗室 equipment。不包括structures 或 equipment assigned specifically 至 other chapters。

chapters.definitionEN: Those fixed and portable units and components which detect and indicate fire or smoke and store and distribute fire extinguishing agent to all protected areas of the aircraft; including bottles, valves, tubing, etc.
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于detect 和 指示 火警/火 或 烟雾 和 储存 和 分配/输送 火警/火 extinguishing agent 至 所有 protected areas 的 飞机； including bottles， 活门， tubing， 等的固定式和便携式装置及部件。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components which furnish a means of manually controlling the flight attitude characteristics of the aircraft, including items such as hydraulic boost system, rudder pedals, controls, mounting brackets, etc. Also includes the functioning and maintenance aspects of the flaps, spoilers and other control surfaces, but does not include the structure which is covered in the Structures Chapters. Does not include rotorcraft rotor controls which are covered in [Chapter (System) 65].
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于furnish a means 的 manually controlling flight 姿态 characteristics 的 飞机， including items 例如 液压助力系统， 方向舵 pedals， 控制装置， mounting brackets， 等 Also 包括 functioning 和 维修 aspects 的 襟翼， 扰流板 和 other 操纵面， 但 不包括 结构 其 is covered 在 Structures Chapters的装置和部件。不包括rotorcraft 旋翼 控制装置 其 are covered 在 [Chapter (系统) 65]。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components which store and deliver fuel to the engine. Includes engine driven fuel pumps for reciprocating engines, includes tanks (bladder), valves, boost pumps, etc., and those components which furnish a means of dumping fuel overboard. Includes integral and tip fuel tank leak detection and sealing. Does not include the structure of integral or tip fuel tanks and the fuel cell backing boards which are covered in the Structures Chapters, and does not include fuel flow rate sensing, transmitting and/or indicating, which are covered in [Chapter (System) 73].
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于储存 和 输送 fuel 至 发动机的装置和部件。包括发动机 driven fuel pumps 用于 reciprocating engines， 包括 tanks (bladder)， 活门， boost pumps， 等， 和 这些 部件 用于提供 a means 的 dumping fuel overboard。包括integral 和 tip fuel tank leak detection 和 sealing。不包括结构 的 integral 或 tip fuel tanks 和 fuel cell backing boards 其 are covered 在 Structures Chapters， 和 不包括 燃油流量 sensing， transmitting 和/或 指示， 其 are covered 在 [Chapter (系统) 73]。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components which furnish hydraulic fluid under pressure (includes pumps, regulators, lines, valves, etc.) to a common point (manifold) for redistribution to other defined systems.
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于furnish 液压油 under 压力 (包括 pumps， regulators， lines， 活门， 等) 至 a common point (manifold) 用于 redistribution 至 other defined 系统的装置和部件。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components which provide a means of preventing or disposing of formation of ice and rain on various parts of the aircraft. Includes alcohol pump, valves, tanks, propeller/rotor anti-icing system, wing heaters, water line heaters, pitot heaters, scoop heaters, windshield wipers and the electrical and heated air portion of windshield ice control. Does not include the basic windshield panel. For turbine type power plants using air as the anti-icing medium, engine anti-icing is contained under Air System.
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于provide a means 的 preventing 或 disposing 的 结冰 和 雨水 在 various parts 的 飞机的装置和部件。包括alcohol pump， 活门， tanks， 螺旋桨/旋翼 anti-icing 系统， wing heaters， water line heaters， pitot heaters， scoop heaters， windshield wipers 和 electrical 和 heated air portion 的 windshield 冰 控制。不包括basic windshield panel。用于 涡轮 type 功率/动力 plants using air 作为 anti-icing medium， 发动机防冰 is contained under Air 系统。

chapters.definitionEN: Pictorial coverage of all instruments, instrument panels and controls. Procedural coverage of those systems which give visual or aural warning of conditions in unrelated systems. Units which record, store or compute data from unrelated systems. Includes systems/units which integrate indicating instruments into a central display system and instruments not related to any specific system.
chapters.definitionZH: Pictorial coverage 的 所有 instruments， instrument panels 和 控制装置。Procedural coverage 的 这些 系统 其 give visual 或 aural warning 的 情况 在 unrelated 系统。装置 其 record， 储存 或 compute 数据 从 unrelated 系统。包括系统/装置 其 integrate 指示 instruments into a central display 系统 和 instruments 不属于 any specific 系统。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components which furnish a means of supporting and steering the aircraft on the ground or water, and make it possible to retract and store the landing gear in flight. Includes tail skid assembly, brakes, wheels, floats, skids, skis, doors, shock struts, tires, linkages, position indicating and warning systems. Also includes the functioning and maintenance aspects of the landing gear doors but does not include the structure which is covered in [Chapter (System) 52].
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于furnish a means 的 supporting 和 steering 飞机 在 ground 或 water， 和 make it possible 至 retract 和 储存 起落架 在 flight的装置和部件。包括尾橇 组件， 刹车， 机轮， 浮筒， 滑橇， 雪橇， 门， 减震支柱， 轮胎， 连杆机构， position 指示 和 警告系统。还包括functioning 和 维修 aspects 的 起落架舱门 但 不包括 结构 其 is covered 在 [Chapter (系统) 52]。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components (electrically powered) which provide for external and internal illumination such as landing lights, taxi lights, position lights, rotating lights, ice lights, master warning lights, passenger reading and cabin dome lights, etc. Includes light fixtures, switches and wiring. Does not include warning lights for individual systems or self-illuminating signs (see [Chapter (System) 11]).
chapters.definitionZH: 这些 装置 和 部件 (electrically powered) 用于提供 用于 外部 和 内部 illumination 例如 landing 灯， taxi 灯， position 灯， rotating 灯， 冰 灯， master 警告灯， passenger reading 和 cabin dome 灯， 等 包括 light fixtures， 开关 和 导线/布线。不包括警告灯 用于 单独的 系统 或 self-illuminating signs (see [Chapter (系统) 11])。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components which provide aircraft navigational information. Includes VOR, pitot, static, ILS, flight director, compasses, indicators, etc.
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于provide 飞机 navigational information的装置和部件。包括VOR， pitot， static， ILS， 飞行指引仪， compasses， 指示器， 等。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components which store, regulate, and deliver oxygen to the passengers and crew, including bottles, relief valves, shut-off valves, outlets, regulators, masks, walk-around bottles, etc.
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于储存， 调节， 和 输送 氧气 至 旅客 和 机组， including bottles， relief 活门， shut-off 活门， outlets， regulators， masks， walk-周围 bottles， 等的装置和部件。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components (Ducts and Valves) which deliver large volumes of compressed air from a power source to connecting points for such other systems as air conditioning, pressurization, deicing, etc.
chapters.definitionZH: 这些 装置 和 部件 (管道 和 活门) 其 输送 large volumes 的 compressed air 从 a 功率/动力 source 至 connecting points 用于 such other 系统 作为 空调， pressurization， deicing， 等。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components used to generate, deliver and regulate negative air pressure, including pumps, regulators, lines, etc., through and including the manifold.
chapters.definitionZH: 这些 装置 和 部件 用于 产生， 输送 和 调节 negative air 压力， including pumps， regulators， lines， 等， through 和 including manifold。

chapters.definitionEN: Those fixed units and components which store and deliver for use, fresh water, and those fixed components which store and furnish a means of removal of water and waste. Includes wash basins, toilet assemblies, tanks, valves, etc.
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于储存 和 输送 用于 use， fresh water， 和 这些 fixed 部件 其 储存 和 furnish a means 的 removal 的 water 和 废水/污物的固定安装装置及部件。包括wash basins， 厕所 组件， tanks， 活门， 等。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components provided for the storage, balancing, control, filling, discharge, and dumping of water ballast. Does not include units or components covered in [Chapter (System) 38].
chapters.definitionZH: 这些 装置 和 部件 provided 用于 storage， balancing， 控制， filling， discharge， 和 dumping 的 水压载。不包括装置 或 部件 covered 在 [Chapter (系统) 38]。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components which furnish a means of entertaining the passengers and providing communication within the aircraft and between the aircraft cabin and ground stations. Includes voice, data, music and video transmissions. Does not include SATCOM, HF, VHF, UHF and all transmitting/receiving equipment, antennas, etc. which are covered in [Chapter (System) 23] or [Chapter (System) 46].
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于furnish a means 的 entertaining 旅客 和 providing communication 在。内 飞机 和 between 飞机 cabin 和 ground stations的装置和部件。包括voice， 数据， music 和 video transmissions。不包括SATCOM， HF， VHF， UHF 和 所有 transmitting/receiving equipment， 天线， 等 其 are covered 在 [Chapter (系统) 23] 或 [Chapter (系统) 46]。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units, components and associated system which interfaces with multiple aircraft systems. Contains checkout and fault isolation procedures using a central computer complex and/or standard fault isolation procedures to locate a single system or component malfunction.
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于interfaces 带有 multiple 飞机 系统的装置、部件和相关系统。Contains 检查/测试 和 故障隔离 程序 using a central computer complex 和/或 standard 故障隔离 程序 至 locate a single 系统 或 component malfunction。
chapters.noteEN: NOTE: Subsystem / Section Code is selected to match applicable system interface. For example, 45-21-XX would identify all air | conditioning monitoring and testing provided by the Central Maintenance System, and would provide directions for using the Central | Maintenance System to execute those maintenance functions. Detailed testing not capable of coverage in [Chapter (System) 45] would | be appropriately cross referenced and would be provided in [Chapter (System) 21]. Similarly, 45-32-XX would identify landing gear | monitoring and testing provided by the Central Maintenance System. 45-45-XX would identify the Central Maintenance System itself.
chapters.noteZH: NOTE： 子系统 / 段/章节 Code is selected 至 match applicable 系统 interface。用于 example， 45-21-XX would identify 所有 air。 conditioning 监控 和 测试 由。提供 中央维护系统， 和 would provide directions 用于 using Central。 维修 系统 至 execute 这些 维修 functions。Detailed 测试 not capable 的 coverage 在 [Chapter (系统) 45] would。 be appropriately cross referenced 和 would be provided 在 [Chapter (系统) 21]。Similarly， 45-32-XX would identify 起落架。 监控 和 测试 由。提供 中央维护系统。 45-45-XX would identify 中央维护系统 itself。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components which furnish a means of storing, updating, and retrieving digital information traditionally provided on paper, microfilm, or microfiche. Includes units that are dedicated to the information storage and retrieval function such as the Electronic Library mass storage and controller. Does not include units or components installed for other uses and shared with other systems, such as flight deck printer or general use display.
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于furnish a means 的 storing， updating， 和 retrieving 数字 information traditionally provided 在 paper， microfilm， 或 microfiche的装置和部件。包括装置 该 are dedicated 至 information storage 和 retrieval function 例如 电子资料库 大容量存储 和 控制器。不包括装置 或 部件 installed 用于 other uses 和 shared 带有 other 系统， 例如 驾驶舱 printer 或 通用/概述 use display。

chapters.definitionEN: Those airborne power plants (engines) which are installed on the aircraft for the purpose of generating and supplying a single type or combination of auxiliary electric, hydraulic, pneumatic or other power. Includes power and drive section, fuel, ignition and control systems; also wiring, indicators, plumbing, valves, and ducts up to the power unit. Does not include generators, alternators, hydraulic pumps, etc. or their connecting systems which supply and deliver power to their respective aircraft systems.
chapters.definitionZH: 指are installed 在 飞机 用于 generating 和 supplying a single type 或 combination 的 辅助 electric， hydraulic， pneumatic 或 other 功率/动力的机载辅助动力装置（发动机）。包括功率/动力 和 drive 段/章节， fuel， 点火 和 控制 系统； also 导线/布线， 指示器， 管路， 活门， 和 管道 up 至 功率/动力 unit。不包括generators， alternators， hydraulic pumps， 等 或 their connecting 系统 其 供给 和 输送 功率/动力 至 their respective 飞机 系统。

chapters.definitionEN: Those compartments for storage of cargo and various components and accessories. Includes those systems used to load/unload cargo and other cargo related systems. Does not include aircraft structure which is in [Chapter (System) 53]
chapters.definitionZH: 这些 compartments 用于 storage 的 cargo 和 various 部件 和 accessories。包括这些 系统 用于 load/unload cargo 和 other cargo related 系统。不包括飞机 结构 其 is 在 [Chapter (系统) 53]。

chapters.definitionEN: Standard Practices, General Procedures and typical repairs applicable to more than one chapter and are not specifically covered under [Chapter (System) 52] thru [Chapter (System) 57] Sub-Sys/Sect breakdown.
chapters.definitionZH: 标准施工， 通用/概述 程序 和 typical repairs applicable 至 more than one chapter 和 are not specifically covered under [Chapter (系统) 52] thru [Chapter (系统) 57] Sub-Sys/Sect breakdown。

chapters.definitionEN: Removable units used for entrance or exit, and for enclosing other structure contained within the fuselage. Includes passenger and crew doors, cargo doors, emergency exits, etc. Electrical and hydraulic systems associated with door control are included as appropriate.
chapters.definitionZH: 用于entrance 或 exit， 和 用于 enclosing other 结构 contained 在。内 机身的可拆卸装置。包括passenger 和 机组 门， cargo 门， 应急 exits， 等 Electrical 和 hydraulic 系统 associated 带有 door 控制 are included 作为 appropriate。

chapters.definitionEN: Structural units and associated components and members which make up the compartments for equipment, passengers, crew, cargo, plus the structure of the envelope and gondola of airships. Includes skins, belt frames, stringers, floor beams, floor, pressure dome, scuppers, tail cone, fuselage-to-wing-and-empennage fillets, attach/attached fittings, load curtains, cables, ballonets, etc.
chapters.definitionZH: 结构的 装置 和 associated 部件 和 members 其 make up compartments 用于 equipment， 旅客， 机组， cargo， plus 结构 的 envelope 和 gondola 的 airships。包括蒙皮， belt frames， 桁条， 地板梁， floor， 增压隔框， scuppers， tail cone， 机身-至-wing-和-尾翼 整流过渡段， 连接接头， load curtains， 钢索/电缆， ballonets， 等。

chapters.definitionEN: Structural units and associated components and members which furnish a means of mounting and housing the power plant or rotor assembly. Includes skins, longerons, belt frames, stringers, clamshells, scuppers, doors, nacelle fillets, attach/attached fittings, etc. Also includes the structure of power plant cowling inclusive of the structural portion of the inlet whether or not integral with the aircraft. Structural portions of the exhaust system are excluded where they are not integral with the airframe.
chapters.definitionZH: 结构的 装置 和 associated 部件 和 members 用于提供 a means 的 mounting 和 housing 动力装置 或 旋翼 组件。包括蒙皮， longerons， belt frames， 桁条， clamshells， scuppers， 门， nacelle 整流过渡段， 连接接头， 等 Also 包括 结构 的 动力装置 发动机罩/整流罩 inclusive 的 结构的 portion 的 inlet whether 或 not integral 带有 飞机。结构的 portions 的 exhaust 系统 are excluded 其中 they are not integral 带有 机体。

chapters.definitionEN: Horizontal and vertical stabilizers include the structure of the elevator and rudder.
chapters.definitionZH: Horizontal 和 vertical stabilizers include 结构 的 升降舵 和 方向舵。

chapters.definitionEN: Fuselage and crew compartment windows inclusive of windshield; also those windows installed in doors
chapters.definitionZH: 机身 和 机组 compartment 窗 inclusive 的 windshield； also 这些 窗 installed 在 门。

chapters.definitionEN: Center wing and outer wing structural units and associated components and members which support the aircraft in flight. Includes spars, skin, ribs, stringers, clamshells, scuppers, etc., and integral fuel tank structure of the flaps, slats, ailerons or elevons (complete with tabs), spoilers, and wing folding system.
chapters.definitionZH: Center wing 和 outer wing 结构的 装置 和 associated 部件 和 members 其 支撑飞机 在 flight。包括梁， skin， 肋， 桁条， clamshells， scuppers， 等， 和 integral fuel tank 结构 的 襟翼， 缝翼， ailerons 或 升降副翼 (complete 带有 调整片)， 扰流板， 和 wing folding 系统。

chapters.definitionEN: (Ref. [Subject 3-1-5])
chapters.definitionZH: (Ref。[Subject 3-1-5])。

chapters.definitionEN: The complete mechanical or electrical propeller, pumps, motors, governor, alternators, and those units and components external to or integral with the engine used to control the propeller blade angle. Includes propeller spinner synchronizers. Also includes propulsor duct assemblies, including aerodynamic fairing of mechanical components, stators, vectoring systems, etc.
chapters.definitionZH: complete mechanical 或 electrical 螺旋桨， pumps， motors， governor， alternators， 和 这些 装置 和 部件 外部 至 或 integral 带有 发动机 用于 控制 螺旋桨 blade angle。包括螺旋桨 spinner synchronizers。还包括propulsor duct 组件， including aerodynamic fairing 的 mechanical 部件， stators， vectoring 系统， 等。

chapters.definitionEN: Rotor head assembly(ies) and rotor blades, including the swashplate assembly(ies) and the rotor shaft unit(s) if not an integral part of the gear box(es). Does not include the rotor anti-icing system which is dealt with in [Chapter (System) 30]
chapters.definitionZH: 旋翼桨毂 组件(ies) 和 旋翼桨叶， including 自动倾斜器 组件(ies) 和 旋翼 shaft unit(s) 如果 not an integral part 的 gear box(es)。不包括旋翼 anti-icing 系统 其 is dealt 带有 在 [Chapter (系统) 30]。

chapters.definitionEN: Includes all components transmitting power to the rotor(s) : engine coupling components, drive shaft(s), clutch and free wheel units, gear box(es), its (their) components, systems and securing elements.
chapters.definitionZH: 包括所有 部件 transmitting 功率/动力 至 旋翼(s)： 发动机 coupling 部件， drive shaft(s)， clutch 和 free wheel 装置， gear box(es)， 其 (their) 部件， 系统 和 securing elements。

chapters.definitionEN: Assembly that rotates in a plane nearly parallel to the symmetry plane and delivers a thrust opposing to the main rotor torque thus ensuring yaw control. Includes the rotor blades and rotor head. Does not include the rotor anti-icing system which is dealt with in [Chapter (System) 30]
chapters.definitionZH: 组件 该 rotates 在 a plane nearly parallel 至 symmetry plane 和 delivers a 推力 opposing 至 主 旋翼 torque thus ensuring 偏航控制。包括旋翼桨叶 和 旋翼桨毂。不包括旋翼 anti-icing 系统 其 is dealt 带有 在 [Chapter (系统) 30]。

chapters.definitionEN: Includes all the components transmitting power to the tail rotor : drive shafts, bearings, gearboxes.
chapters.definitionZH: 包括所有 部件 transmitting 功率/动力 至 尾桨： drive shafts， bearings， gearboxes。

chapters.definitionEN: The whole of the system ensuring automatic or manual folding and spreading of the rotor blades and/or tail pylon.
chapters.definitionZH: whole 的 系统 ensuring 自动 或 手册 folding 和 spreading 的 旋翼桨叶 和/或 尾梁。
chapters.noteEN: NOTE: Such rigging also affects the components described in other chapters
chapters.noteZH: NOTE： Such rigging also affects 部件 described 在 other chapters。

chapters.definitionEN: The system which provides means of manually controlling the flight attitude of the helicopter. Includes items such as control linkage and control cables for collective pitch, cyclic pitch, directional control, servo-controls and corresponding system. The trim system and the indicating and monitoring system.
chapters.definitionZH: 系统 用于提供 means 的 manually controlling flight 姿态 的 直升机。包括控制 linkage 和 控制 钢索/电缆 用于 总距， 周期变距， directional 控制， 伺服控制 和 corresponding 系统等。trim 系统 和 指示 和 监控 系统。
chapters.noteEN: NOTE: This chapter includes the complete rigging of rotor control including the associated items not described under this system, such | as auto-pilot, servo-control unit, automatic trim (ch. 22), blade pitch change rod (ch. 63), swashplate.
chapters.noteZH: NOTE： 该 chapter 包括 complete rigging 的 旋翼 控制 including associated items not described under 该 系统， such。 作为 auto-pilot， servo-控制 unit， 自动配平 (ch。 22)， blade pitch change rod (ch。 63)， 自动倾斜器。

chapters.definitionEN: (Ref. [Subject 3-1-5]).
chapters.definitionZH: (Ref。[Subject 3-1-5])。

chapters.definitionEN: The overall power package inclusive of engine, air intake, mount, cowling, scoops, cowl flaps.
chapters.definitionZH: overall 功率/动力 package inclusive 的 发动机， 进气道， mount， 发动机罩/整流罩， scoops， 整流罩襟片。

chapters.titleEN: ENGINE TURBINE/TURBO PROP DUCTED FAN/UNDUCTED FAN
chapters.titleZH: 涡轮/涡桨/涵道风扇/非涵道风扇发动机

chapters.definitionEN: For turbine engines, those units and components and associated mechanical systems or electrical circuits which furnish or control fuel to the engine beyond the main fuel quick disconnect; and thrust augmentor, fuel flow rate sensing, transmitting and/or indicating units whether the units are before or beyond the quick disconnect. Includes coordinator or equivalent, engine driven fuel pump and filter assembly, main and thrust augmentor fuel controls, electronic temperature datum control, temperature datum valve, fuel manifold, fuel nozzles, fuel enrichment system, speed sensitive switch, relay box assembly, solenoid drip valve, burner drain valve, etc. For reciprocating engines, those units and components which deliver metered fuel and air to the engine. The fuel portion includes the carburetor/master control from the inlet side to the discharge nozzle(s), injection pumps, carburetor, injection nozzles and fuel primer. The air portion includes units from the scoop inlet to the vapor vent return, and the impeller chamber.
chapters.definitionZH: 用于 涡轮 engines， 这些 装置 和 部件 和 associated mechanical 系统 或 electrical circuits 用于提供 或 控制 fuel 至 发动机 beyond 主 燃油快卸接头； 和 推力 augmentor， 燃油流量 sensing， transmitting 和/或 指示 装置 whether 装置 are before 或 beyond quick disconnect。包括coordinator 或 equivalent， 发动机 driven fuel pump 和 filter 组件， 主 和 推力 augmentor fuel 控制装置， electronic 温度 datum 控制， 温度 datum valve， fuel manifold， fuel nozzles， fuel enrichment 系统， 速度 sensitive switch， relay box 组件， solenoid drip valve， burner drain valve， 等 用于 reciprocating engines， 这些 装置 和 部件 其 输送 metered fuel 和 air 至 发动机。fuel portion 包括 carburetor/master 控制 从 inlet side 至 discharge nozzle(s)， injection pumps， carburetor， injection nozzles 和 fuel primer。air portion 包括 装置 从 scoop inlet 至 vapor vent return， 和 impeller chamber。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components which generate, control, furnish, or distribute an electrical current to ignite the fuel air mixture in the cylinders of reciprocating engines or in the combustion chambers or thrust augmentors of turbine engines. Includes induction vibrators, magnetos, switches, lead filters, distributors, harnesses, plugs, ignition relays, exciters, and the electrical portion of spark advance.
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于产生， 控制， furnish， 或 分配/输送 an 电流 至 ignite fuel air mixture 在 cylinders 的 reciprocating engines 或 在 燃烧 chambers 或 推力 augmentors 的 涡轮 engines的装置和部件。包括induction vibrators， 磁电机， 开关， lead filters， distributors， harnesses， plugs， 点火 继电器， exciters， 和 electrical portion 的 spark advance。

chapters.definitionEN: For turbine engines, those external units and components and integral basic engine parts which go together to conduct air to various portions of the engine and to the extension shaft and torquemeter, assembly, if any. Includes compressor bleed systems used to control flow of air through the engine, cooling air systems and heated air systems for engine anti-icing. Does not include aircraft anti-icing, engine starting systems, nor exhaust supplementary air systems.
chapters.definitionZH: 用于 涡轮 engines， 这些 外部 装置 和 部件 和 integral basic 发动机 parts 其 go together 至 conduct air 至 various portions 的 发动机 和 至 extension shaft 和 torquemeter， 组件， 如果 any。包括压气机 bleed 系统 用于 控制 flow 的 air through 发动机， cooling air 系统 和 heated air 系统 用于 发动机防冰。不包括飞机防冰， 发动机 起动 系统， nor exhaust supplementary air 系统。

chapters.definitionEN: Those controls which govern operation of the engine. Includes units and components which are interconnected for emergency shutdown. For turbo-prop engines, includes linkages and controls to the coordinator or equivalent to the propeller governor, fuel control unit or other units being controlled. For reciprocating engines, includes controls for blowers. Does not include units or components which are specifically included in other chapters.
chapters.definitionZH: 这些 控制装置 其 govern 操作/工作 的 发动机。包括装置 和 部件 其 are interconnected 用于 应急 shutdown。用于 turbo-prop engines， 包括 连杆机构 和 控制装置 至 coordinator 或 equivalent 至 螺旋桨 governor， 燃油控制 unit 或 other 装置 being controlled。用于 reciprocating engines， 包括 控制装置 用于 blowers。不包括装置 或 部件 其 are specifically included 在 other chapters。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units, components and associated systems which indicate engine operation. Includes indicators, transmitters, analyzers, etc. For turbo- prop engines includes phase detectors. Does not include systems or items which are specifically included in other chapters except when indication is accomplished as part of an integrated engine instrument system (ref. [Chapter (System) 77-40]).
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于指示 发动机 操作/工作的装置、部件和相关系统。包括指示器， 传感/发送器， analyzers， 等 用于 turbo- prop engines 包括 phase detectors。不包括系统 或 items 其 are specifically included 在 other chapters except when indication is accomplished 作为 part 的 an 综合发动机仪表系统 (ref。[Chapter (系统) 77-40])。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components which direct the engine exhaust gases overboard. For turbine engines, includes units external to the basic engine such as thrust reverser and noise suppressor. For reciprocating engines, includes augmentors, stacks, clamps, etc. Excludes exhaust-driven turbines.
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于direct 发动机 排气 overboard的装置和部件。用于 涡轮 engines， 包括 装置 外部 至 basic 发动机 例如 反推装置 和 消声器。用于 reciprocating engines， 包括 augmentors， stacks， clamps， 等 Excludes exhaust-driven turbines。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components external to the engine concerned with storing and delivering lubricating oil to and from the engine. Covers all units and components from the lubricating oil engine outlet to the inlet, including the inlet and outlet fittings, tank, radiator, by-pass valve, etc., and auxiliary oil systems.
chapters.definitionZH: 这些 装置 和 部件 外部 至 发动机 concerned 带有 storing 和 delivering 润滑油 至 和 从 发动机。盖板 所有 装置 和 部件 从 润滑油 发动机 outlet 至 inlet， including inlet 和 outlet 接头/支架， tank， radiator， 由-pass valve， 等， 和 辅助 oil 系统。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units, components and associated systems used for starting the engine. Includes electrical, inertia air or other starter systems. Does not include ignition systems which are covered in [Chapter (System) 74].
chapters.definitionZH: 这些 装置， 部件 和 associated 系统 used 用于 起动 发动机。包括electrical， inertia air 或 other 起动机 系统。不包括点火 系统 其 are covered 在 [Chapter (系统) 74]。

chapters.definitionEN: For reciprocating engines only. Includes power recovery turbine assembly and turbo-supercharger unit when external to the engine.
chapters.definitionZH: 用于 reciprocating engines only。包括动力回收涡轮 组件 和 涡轮增压器 unit when 外部 至 发动机。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components which furnish, meter and inject water or water mixtures into the induction system, includes tanks, pumps, regulators, etc.
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于furnish， meter 和 inject water 或 water mixtures into induction 系统， 包括 tanks， pumps， regulators， 等的装置和部件。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components which are remotely installed and connected to the engine by a drive shaft and which drive multiple types of accessories. Does not include those accessory drives which are bolted to and are immediately adjacent to the engine. The latter item shall be covered under [Chapter (System) 72].
chapters.definitionZH: 指用于are remotely installed 和 connected 至 发动机 由 a drive shaft 和 其 drive multiple types 的 accessories的装置和部件。不包括这些 accessory drives 其 are bolted 至 和 are immediately adjacent 至 发动机。latter item shall be covered under [Chapter (系统) 72]。

chapters.definitionEN: Those units and components that, independent of the primary propulsion system, furnish additional thrust of short duration. Includes solid or liquid propellents, controls, indicators, etc.
chapters.definitionZH: 这些 装置 和 部件 该， 独立 的 primary propulsion 系统， furnish additional 推力 的 short duration。包括solid 或 liquid propellents， 控制装置， 指示器， 等。

chapters.definitionEN: Miscellaneous charts not applicable to any particular system, such as spare wire charts, junction box charts, disconnect plug charts, conduit and wire routing charts, rigid tube charts, flexible hose charts and control cables
chapters.definitionZH: Miscellaneous charts not applicable 至 any particular 系统， 例如 spare wire charts， junction box charts， disconnect plug charts， conduit 和 wire routing charts， rigid tube charts， flexible hose charts 和 控制 钢索/电缆。

chapters.definitionEN: Systems required for simulator operations
chapters.definitionZH: 用于simulator 运行/操作的系统。

chapters.definitionEN: Simulator systems that provide perceptual cues to the crew in training.
chapters.definitionZH: 用于provide perceptual cues 至 机组 在 training的模拟机系统。
chapters.noteEN: For subsystem / section assignments and descriptions, Ref. [IATA Sim. Doc. Req.]
chapters.noteZH: 用于 子系统 / 段/章节 assignments 和 descriptions， Ref。[IATA Sim。Doc。Req。]。

entries.definitionEN: Those manufacturer recommended time limits for inspections, maintenance and overhaul of the aircraft, its systems and units, and life of parts. For engine manufacturers this will include the flight cycle lives of major rotating components and other items designated critical.
entries.definitionZH: 制造商建议的飞机、飞机系统和部件的检查、维修、翻修时限以及零部件寿命。对于发动机制造商，还包括主要旋转部件的飞行循环寿命以及其他指定为关键的项目。

entries.definitionEN: Those manufacturer recommended maintenance checks and inspections of the aircraft, its systems and units dictated by the time limits specified in -10 above. This section shall list in more detail the items which are outlined on the airline job forms (usually by title only), and shall cross-reference the detailed procedures included in the individual Maintenance Practices.
entries.definitionZH: 由上述-10时限决定的、制造商建议的飞机及其系统和部件维修检查和检验。本节应更详细列出航空公司工作单上通常仅以标题列出的项目，并交叉引用各具体维修施工中包含的详细程序。

entries.definitionEN: Reserved for use in those cases where the number of breakouts provided by the fourth digit of the -20 breakout is not sufficient to cover all of the maintenance checks dictated by subsystem -10 above.
entries.definitionZH: 当-20细分的第四位数字不足以覆盖上述-10子系统规定的全部维修检查时，本项预留使用。
entries.noteEN: NOTE: Inclusion of the data described in -10 through -40 above, in any manual or manual publication is specifically prohibited | unless required by government regulation. Airlines desire the manufacturer's recommended time limits and scheduled | maintenance checks but these should be provided in a separate document.
entries.noteZH: NOTE： Inclusion 的 数据 described 在 -10 through -40 上述， 在 any 手册 或 手册出版物 is specifically 禁止。 unless 要求的 由 government 规章。Airlines desire 制造商建议的 时限 和 计划。 维修检查 但 这些 should be provided 在 a 单独文件。

entries.definitionEN: Those maintenance checks and inspections on the aircraft, its systems and units which are dictated by special or unusual conditions which are not related to the time limits specified in -10 above. Includes inspections and checks such as hard landing, overweight landing, bird strike, turbulent air, lightning strike, slush ingestion, radioactive contamination, maintenance checks prior to engine-out ferry, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 由特殊或异常情况决定、且与上述-10时限无关的飞机及其系统和部件维修检查和检验。包括检查 和 checks 例如 重着陆， 超重着陆， 鸟击， 颠簸气流， 雷击， 吸入融雪/雪浆， 放射性污染， 维修检查 prior 至 单发/失效发动机调机飞行， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Provides information relative to jack points, adapters, tail supports, balance weights, jacks and jacking procedures utilized during aircraft maintenance and repair.
entries.definitionZH: Provides information 有关 顶升点， 适配器， 尾撑， 配重， 千斤顶 和 顶升程序 utilized during 飞机维修和修理。

entries.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to support the aircraft during maintenance and repair. Includes information on shoring materials and equipment, contour dimensions, shoring locations, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 指为支撑飞机 during 维修和修理所必需的说明和程序。包括information 在 支撑材料 和 equipment， 外形尺寸， 支撑位置， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Those units or components dedicated to the specific function of recording, storing or computing weight and balance data.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 装置 或 部件 dedicated 至 specific function 的 recording， storing 或 computing weight 和 balance 数据。

entries.definitionEN: Provides information relative to those units or components dedicated to the specific function of leveling the aircraft.
entries.definitionZH: Provides information 有关 这些 装置 或 部件 dedicated 至 specific function 的 leveling 飞机。

entries.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to tow or push the aircraft in normal or other conditions such as towing with engines removed, etc. Shall include equipment and materials required such as towing vehicles, tow bars, towing cables, etc.; procedures to be used such as ground turning techniques, use of interphone and brakes, connection of electrical power, etc.; precautions and limitations such as use of landing gear and control surface locks, minimum turning radius, maximum towing and pushing loads on nose landing gear, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 指为tow 或 push 飞机 在 正常或其他情况 例如 towing 拆除发动机时， 等 应包括 equipment 和 materials 要求的 例如 牵引车， 牵引杆， 牵引索， 等； 程序 至 be used 例如 地面转弯技术， use 的 interphone 和 刹车， 接通电源， 等； 注意事项和限制 例如 use 的 起落架和操纵面锁， 最小转弯半径， maximum towing 和 pushing loads 在 前起落架， 等所必需的说明和程序。

entries.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to taxi the aircraft in normal or abnormal conditions such as adverse weather conditions, etc. Shall include procedures to be used such as use of engines, interphone and brakes, ground turning techniques, etc.; precautions and limitations such as jet intake and exhaust danger areas, minimum turning radius, friction coefficients for various ground conditions, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 指为taxi 飞机 在 正常或非正常情况 例如 不利天气条件， 等 应包括 程序 至 be used 例如 use 的 engines， interphone 和 刹车， 地面转弯技术， 等； 注意事项和限制 例如 喷气进气和排气危险区， 最小转弯半径， 摩擦系数 用于 various 地面条件， 等所必需的说明和程序。

entries.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to park or store the aircraft in normal or abnormal conditions such as with engines removed, or aircraft damaged for short or long terms. Shall include equipment and materials required such as landing gear and control surface locks, wheel chocks, blanking plugs and covers, cocooning materials, etc; procedures such as periodic engine running, control or drainage of fluid systems, static grounding, etc; precautions and limitations, such as landing gear strut pressures and wheel rotation, control of lifted equipment, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 指为park 或 储存 飞机 在 正常或非正常情况 例如 拆除发动机时， 或 飞机 damaged 用于 short 或 long terms所必需的说明和程序。应包括equipment 和 materials 要求的 例如 起落架和操纵面锁， 轮挡， 堵头和盖板， 封存材料， 等； 程序 例如 定期发动机运转， 控制 或 drainage 的 液体系统， 静电接地， 等； 注意事项和限制， 例如 起落架支柱压力 和 机轮转动， 控制 的 lifted equipment， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to moor or picket the aircraft in normal or abnormal conditions or with engines removed, etc.; for short or long terms in extremes of weather conditions. Shall include equipment and materials required such as wheel chocks, mooring blocks, mooring cables, etc.; procedures such as ballasting, etc.; precautions and limitations such as control in high wind conditions, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 指为moor 或 picket 飞机 在 正常或非正常情况 或 拆除发动机时， 等； 用于 short 或 long terms 在 extremes 的 weather 情况所必需的说明和程序。应包括equipment 和 materials 要求的 例如 轮挡， mooring blocks， 系留索， 等； 程序 例如 ballasting， 等； 注意事项和限制 例如 大风条件下的控制， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to prepare the aircraft for operation following mooring, parking, or a period of storage.
entries.definitionZH: 指为prepare 飞机 用于 之后运行 mooring， parking， 或 a 存放期所必需的说明和程序。

entries.definitionEN: This sub-system/section breakdown reserved for airline use.
entries.definitionZH: 该 子系统/段/章节 breakdown reserved 用于 airline use。

entries.definitionEN: Those placards and markings required for ground servicing instructions, inspections, cautions, warnings, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 placards 和 markings 要求的 用于 地面勤务 说明， 检查， 注意事项， 警告， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Those placards, markings, self-illuminating signs, etc. required for interior general and emergency information, instructions, cautions, warnings, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 placards， markings， self-illuminating signs， 等 要求的 用于 interior 通用/概述 和 应急 information， 说明， 注意事项， 警告， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary for the replenishment of fuel, oil, hydraulic fluid, water, other fluids, tire pressure, etc. Tank and reservoir capacities in U.S., imperial and metric measure, shall be included. ANA or other standard specification number and grade (if applicable) of fuel, oil, fluid, and other material used shall be given. Specifications and grades should be shown grouped on one page to facilitate revisions. For fuel, give expansion volume, total fuel capacity, sump capacity, net fuel capacity (as applicable) for each tank. For oil, give allowance for expansion.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 说明 必要的 用于 replenishment 的 fuel， oil， 液压油， water， other fluids， 轮胎压力， 等 Tank 和 reservoir capacities 在 美制、英制和公制单位， shall be included。ANA 或 other 标准规范号和等级 (如果 applicable) 的 fuel， oil， fluid， 和 other material used shall be given。Specifications 和 grades should be shown grouped 在 one page 至 facilitate revisions。用于 fuel， give 膨胀容积， 燃油总容量， 集油槽容量， 净燃油容量 (作为 applicable) 用于 each tank。用于 oil， give 膨胀余量。

entries.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to carry out servicing that may be scheduled. Includes instructions such as those for periodic lubrication of components, radioactivity decontamination, aircraft external and internal cleaning, disinfection of aircraft, sanitization of drinking water, etc. Shall not include lubrication procedures required for the accomplishment of maintenance practices.
entries.definitionZH: 指为carry out servicing 该 may be 计划所必需的说明和程序。包括说明 例如 这些 用于 定期润滑 的 部件， radioactivity 去污， 飞机 外部和内部清洁， 消毒 的 飞机， 饮用水消毒， 等 Shall not include lubrication 程序 要求的 用于 accomplishment 的 维修施工。

entries.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to carry out servicing that is normally unscheduled. Includes instructions such as those for ice and snow removal from parked aircraft, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 指为carry out servicing 该 is normally 非计划所必需的说明和程序。包括说明 例如 这些 用于 除冰除雪 从 停放飞机， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to monitor, measure, diagnose and locate sources of vibration in dynamic and structural components. The instructions shall cover related maintenance procedures such as main rotor tracking, tail rotor balancing, main rotor head absorber tuning/checking, general airframe vibration monitoring, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 指为monitor， measure， diagnose 和 locate sources 的 vibration 在 dynamic 和 结构的 部件所必需的说明和程序。说明 shall cover related 维修 程序 例如 主 旋翼 tracking， 尾桨 balancing， 主 旋翼桨毂 absorber tuning/checking， 通用/概述 机体 vibration 监控， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to monitor, measure, diagnose and locate sources of noise in dynamic and structural components.
entries.definitionZH: 指为monitor， measure， diagnose 和 locate sources 的 noise 在 dynamic 和 结构的 部件所必需的说明和程序。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system and its controls which supplies compressed air. Includes items such as controls and indicating systems related to the compressors, wiring, etc. Does not include the pressure control and indicating system for the cabin pressurization.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 和 其 控制装置 其 supplies compressed air。包括控制装置 和 指示系统 相关的 compressors， 导线/布线， 等 不包括 压力 控制 和 指示 系统 用于 cabin pressurization等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to induct and distribute air. Includes equipment rack cooling systems and items such as blowers, scoops, ducting, inlets, check valves, wiring, etc. Does not include valves which are part of pressurization and temperature control.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于induct 和 分配/输送 air的部分。包括equipment rack cooling 系统 和 items 例如 blowers， scoops， ducting， inlets， check 活门， 导线/布线， 等 不包括 活门 其 are part 的 pressurization 和 温度 控制。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to control the pressure within the fuselage. Includes items such as control valves, relief valves, indicators, switches, amplifiers, wiring, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制 压力 在。内 机身的部分。包括控制 活门， relief 活门， 指示器， 开关， 放大器， 导线/布线， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system and its controls which supply heated air. Includes items such as heater panels and other units, fuel system and control, ignition, indicating systems related to heater operation, wiring, etc. Does not include temperature control and indicating systems.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 和 其 控制装置 其 供给 heated air。包括heater panels 和 other 装置， 燃油系统 和 控制， 点火， 指示系统 相关的 heater 操作/工作， 导线/布线， 等 不包括 温度 控制 和 指示系统等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system and its controls which supply cooled air. Includes items such as the cooling unit, indicating systems related to the cooler operation, wiring, etc. Does not include temperature control and indicating systems.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 和 其 控制装置 其 供给 cooled air。包括cooling unit， 指示系统 相关的 cooler 操作/工作， 导线/布线， 等 不包括 温度 控制 和 指示系统等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to control the temperature of the air. Includes items such as control valves, thermal sensing devices, switches, indicators, amplifiers, wiring, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制 温度 的 air的部分。包括控制 活门， thermal sensing devices， 开关， 指示器， 放大器， 导线/布线， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to control moisture in the air, to control ozone concentrations, to filter radioactive debris from conditioned air, and to treat the air with deodorizers, insecticides, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制 moisture 在 air， 至 控制 ozone concentrations， 至 filter radioactive debris 从 conditioned air， 和 至 treat air 带有 deodorizers， insecticides， 等的部分。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system that uses radio/radar signals, directional and vertical references, air data pitot-static, computed flight path data, or manually induced inputs to the system to automatically control the flight path of the aircraft through adjustment to the pitch/roll/yaw axis or wing lift characteristics and provide visual cues for flight path guidance, i.e.: Integrated Flight Director. This includes power source devices, interlocking devices and amplifying, computing, integrating, controlling, actuating, indicating and warning devices such as computers, servos, control panels, indicators, warning lights, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 该 uses radio/radar signals， directional 和 vertical references， air 数据 pitot-static， computed flight path 数据， 或 manually induced inputs 至 系统 至 automatically 控制 flight path 的 飞机 through adjustment 至 pitch/roll/yaw axis 或 wing lift characteristics 和 provide visual cues 用于 flight path guidance， 即： 综合 飞行指引仪。该 包括 功率/动力 source devices， interlocking devices 和 amplifying， computing， integrating， controlling， actuating， 指示 和 warning devices 例如 计算机， servos， 控制面板， 指示器， 警告灯， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system that automatically maintains safe flight conditions by correcting for effects of speed and out-of-trim conditions by such means as automatic trim, mach trim or speed stability and mach feel. This includes sensing, computing, actuating, indicating, internal monitoring, and warning devices, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 该 automatically maintains safe flight 情况 由 correcting 用于 effects 的 速度 和 out-的-trim 情况 由 such means 作为 自动配平， 马赫配平 或 速度稳定性 和 马赫感力。该 包括 sensing， computing， actuating， 指示， 内部 监控， 和 warning devices， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system that automatically controls the position of the throttles to properly manage engine power during all phases of flight/attitude. This includes engaging, sensing, computing, amplifying, controlling, actuating and warning devices such as amplifiers, computers, servos, limit switches, clutches, gear boxes, warning lights, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 该 automatically 控制装置 position 的 throttles 至 properly manage 发动机 功率/动力 during 所有 phases 的 flight/姿态。该 包括 engaging， sensing， computing， amplifying， controlling， actuating 和 warning devices 例如 放大器， 计算机， servos， limit 开关， clutches， gear boxes， 警告灯， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That which provides separate or external monitoring/remote readout (for maintenance or other purposes) not directly related to the internal system monitoring (for system integrity flight crew warning). This includes sensing, computing, indicating and warning devices, control panels, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 用于提供 separate 或 外部 监控/remote readout (用于 维修 或 other purposes) not directly 相关的 内部 系统 监控 (用于 系统 integrity 飞行机组 warning)。该 包括 sensing， computing， 指示 和 warning devices， 控制面板， 等。

entries.definitionEN: The system or portion of the system that automatically corrects/provides for gust loading/upset, aerodynamic augmentation/alleviation/suppression, ride control, etc. This includes sensing, computing, actuating, indicating internal monitoring, warning devices, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统 或 portion 的 系统 该 automatically corrects/provides 用于 gust loading/upset， aerodynamic augmentation/alleviation/suppression， ride 控制， 等 该 包括 sensing， computing， actuating， 指示 内部 监控， warning devices， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which utilizes voice modulated electromagnetic waves to transmit and/or receive messages from air to air, or air to ground installations. Includes H.F., V.H.F., U.H.F., etc., inflight telephone, communication transmitting & receiving equipment. Passenger air-to-ground communications now in [Chapter (System) 44-30]
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 utilizes voice modulated electromagnetic waves 至 transmit 和/或 receive messages 从 air 至 air， 或 air 至 ground installations。包括H。F， V。H。F， U。H。F， 等， inflight telephone， communication transmitting和receiving equipment。Passenger air-至-ground 通信 now 在 [Chapter (系统) 44-30]。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which utilizes satellite communication systems (SATCOM).
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 utilizes satellite communication 系统 (SATCOM)。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which presents information derived from pulse coded transmissions. Includes Teleprinter, Selcal, Calsel, ACARS, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 presents information derived 从 pulse coded transmissions。包括Teleprinter， Selcal， Calsel， ACARS， 等。

entries.titleZH: 旅客广播、娱乐和舒适性
entries.definitionEN: Available This sub-system now included in [Chapter (System) 44]
entries.definitionZH: 可用；该 子系统 now included 在 [Chapter (系统) 44]。

entries.definitionEN: Available Interphone now included in Chapters 23-50 (Cockpit) and 44-10 (Cabin)
entries.definitionZH: 可用；Interphone now included 在 Chapters 23-50 (Cockpit) 和 44-10 (Cabin)。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which controls the output of the communications and navigation receivers into the flight crew headphones and speakers and the output of the flight crew microphones into the communications transmitters. Also includes the flight to ground personnel communications. Includes items such as audio selector control panel, micro-phones, headphones, cockpit loudspeakers, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制output 的 通信 和 导航 receivers into 飞行机组 headphones 和 speakers 和 output 的 飞行机组 microphones into 通信 传感/发送器的部分。还包括flight 至 地面人员 通信。包括audio selector 控制 panel， micro-phones， headphones， cockpit loudspeakers， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to dissipate static electricity.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于dissipate static electricity的部分。

entries.definitionEN: Those installations that record, or monitor crew conversation or movement, or provide external monitoring, for security or safety purposes. Includes externally mounted cameras, voice and/or video recorders, etc., used for aircraft operations.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 installations 该 record， 或 monitor 机组 conversation 或 movement， 或 provide 外部 监控， 用于 security 或 safety purposes。包括externally mounted cameras， voice 和/或 视频记录器， 等， used 用于 飞机 运行/操作。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which maintains integrated control of the operating frequencies of communication and navigation transmitter/receivers after either a manually inserted command or a preprogrammed integrated flight system command. Includes such items as integrated frequency selector panels, digital frequency control computers, integrated frequency display panels, etc
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 maintains 综合 控制 的 operating frequencies 的 communication 和 导航 transmitter/receivers after either a manually inserted command 或 a preprogrammed 综合 flight 系统 command。包括综合 frequency selector panels， 数字 frequency 控制 计算机， 综合 frequency display panels， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Mechanical devices that drive the generators at a desired RPM. Includes items such as oil system, connecting devices, indicating and warning systems for the drive, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 用于drive generators at a desired RPM的机械装置。包括滑油系统， connecting devices， 指示 和 警告系统 用于 drive， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the systems used to generate, regulate, control, and indicate AC electrical power. Includes items such as inverters, AC generators/ alternators, control and regulating components, indicating systems, etc., all wiring to but not including main busses.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于产生， 调节， 控制， 和 指示 交流电源的部分。包括inverters， AC generators/ alternators， 控制 和 regulating 部件， 指示系统， 等， 所有 导线/布线 至 但 not including 主汇流条等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the systems used to generate, regulate, control and indicate DC electrical power. Includes items such as generators/ alternators, transformers, rectifiers, batteries, control and regulating components, indicating systems, etc., all wiring to but not including main busses.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于产生， 调节， 控制 和 指示 直流电源的部分。包括generators/ alternators， transformers， rectifiers， batteries， 控制 和 regulating 部件， 指示系统， 等， 所有 导线/布线 至 但 not including 主汇流条等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system within the aircraft which connects external electrical power to the aircraft's electrical system. Includes items such as receptacles, relays, switches, wiring, warning lights, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 在。内 飞机 其 connects 外部 电源 至 飞机's electrical 系统。包括receptacles， 继电器， 开关， 导线/布线， 警告灯， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which provides for connection of AC power to using systems. Includes items such as AC main and secondary busses, main system circuit breakers, power system devices, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供用于 connection 的 交流电源 至 using 系统的部分。包括AC 主 和 二级汇流条， 主 系统 断路器， 功率/动力 系统 devices， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which provides for connection of DC power to using systems. Includes items such as DC main and secondary busses, main system circuit breakers, power system devices, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供用于 connection 的 直流电源 至 using 系统的部分。包括DC 主 和 二级汇流条， 主 系统 断路器， 功率/动力 系统 devices， 等。

entries.definitionEN: The compartment above the floor and between the forward passenger partition and the forward pressure dome. Includes items such as flight crew seats, tables, pilot check lists and food containers, wardrobes, curtains, manuals, electronic equipment rack, spare bulbs, fuses, etc. Does not include cargo compartments.
entries.definitionZH: compartment 上述 floor 和 between forward passenger partition 和 forward 增压隔框。包括飞行机组 seats， tables， pilot check lists 和 food containers， wardrobes， curtains， manuals， electronic equipment rack， spare bulbs， fuses， 等 不包括 cargo compartments等。

entries.definitionEN: The areas in which the passengers are seated. Includes lounges but not dressing rooms. Includes items such as seats, berths, overhead storage compartments, curtains, wall coverings, carpets, magazine racks, wardrobes, movable partitions, wall-type thermometers, spare bulbs, fuses, etc.
entries.definitionZH: areas 在 其 旅客 are seated。包括lounges 但 not dressing rooms。包括seats， berths， overhead storage compartments， curtains， wall coverings， carpets， magazine racks， wardrobes， movable partitions， wall-type thermometers， spare bulbs， fuses， 等。

entries.definitionEN: The areas in which food and beverages are stored and prepared. Includes items such as removable and fixed cabinets, ovens, refrigerators, garbage containers, dish racks, coffee maker and dispensers, containers, electrical outlets, wiring, etc.
entries.definitionZH: areas 在 其 food 和 beverages are 储存 和 prepared。包括removable 和 fixed cabinets， ovens， refrigerators， garbage containers， dish racks， coffee maker 和 dispensers， containers， electrical outlets， 导线/布线， 等。

entries.definitionEN: The toilet and dressing room areas containing wash basins, dressing tables, and water closet. Includes items such as mirrors, seats, cabinets, dispensing equipment, electrical outlets, wiring, etc. Wash basins and water closets are included in [Chapter (System) 38].
entries.definitionZH: 厕所 和 dressing room areas containing wash basins， dressing tables， 和 water closet。包括mirrors， seats， cabinets， dispensing equipment， electrical outlets， 导线/布线， 等 Wash basins 和 water closets are included 在 [Chapter (系统) 38]等。

entries.definitionEN: Those additional compartments for the use of passengers and/or crew. Includes such compartments as crew rest compartments, sleeping compartments etc.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 additional compartments 用于 use 的 旅客 和/或 机组。包括such compartments 作为 机组 rest compartments， sleeping compartments 等。

entries.definitionEN: Those items of equipment carried for use in emergency procedures. Includes items such as evacuation equipment, life rafts, jackets, emergency locator transmitters, underwater locator devices, first aid kit, incubators, oxygen tents, medical stretchers, landing and signal flares, drag parachutes, evacuation signaling systems, etc. Does not include fire extinguishers, oxygen equipment or masks.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 items 的 equipment carried 用于 应急 程序。包括撤离设备， 救生筏， jackets， 应急定位发射机， 水下定位装置， 急救包， incubators， 氧气 tents， medical stretchers， landing 和 signal flares， drag parachutes， evacuation signaling 系统， 等 不包括 灭火器， 氧气 equipment 或 masks等。

entries.definitionEN: Those insulation blankets which are used for heat and sound insulation. Includes flight compartments, passenger compartment and additional compartment insulation, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 insulation blankets 其 are used 用于 heat 和 sound insulation。包括flight compartments， 客舱 和 additional compartment insulation， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to sense and indicate the presence of overheat, smoke, or fire.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于sense 和 指示 presence 的 过热， 烟雾， 或 火警/火的部分。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of those fixed or portable systems which is used to extinguish fire.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 这些 fixed 或 便携式 系统 用于 extinguish 火警/火。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to sense, indicate and extinguish a flame propagating into the fuel vent or scoop to prevent an explosion in the fuel system.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于sense， 指示 和 extinguish a 火焰 propagating into fuel vent 或 scoop 至 防止 an explosion 在 燃油系统的部分。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the systems which controls the position and movement of the ailerons/elevons and tabs. Includes items such as the control wheels, cables, boosters, linkages, control surfaces, indicators, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制position 和 movement 的 ailerons/升降副翼 和 调整片的部分。包括控制 机轮， 钢索/电缆， boosters， 连杆机构， 操纵面， 指示器， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the systems which controls the position and movement of the rudder and rudder tabs. Includes items such as the rudder pedals, tab control wheel, cables, boosters, linkages, control surfaces, position indicators, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制position 和 movement 的 方向舵 和 方向舵 调整片的部分。包括方向舵 pedals， tab 控制 wheel， 钢索/电缆， boosters， 连杆机构， 操纵面， 位置指示器， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the systems which controls the position and movement of the elevator/elevon and tabs. Includes items such as the control column, stickshaker units, automatic stall recovery devices, tab control wheels, cables, boosters, linkages, control surfaces, position indicators, stall warning systems, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制position 和 movement 的 升降舵/elevon 和 调整片的部分。包括控制 column， stickshaker 装置， 自动 stall recovery devices， tab 控制 机轮， 钢索/电缆， boosters， 连杆机构， 操纵面， 位置指示器， stall 警告系统， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which controls the position and movement of the horizontal stabilizer/canard. Includes items such as control handle, cables, jackscrews, motors, warning systems, linkages, control surfaces, position indicators, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制position 和 movement 的 水平安定面/canard的部分。包括控制 handle， 钢索/电缆， jackscrews， motors， 警告系统， 连杆机构， 操纵面， 位置指示器， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the systems which controls the position and movement of the trailing edge flaps. Includes items such as control handles, cables, actuators, warning systems, linkages, control surfaces, position indicators, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制position 和 movement 的 后缘 襟翼的部分。包括控制 handles， 钢索/电缆， 作动器， 警告系统， 连杆机构， 操纵面， 位置指示器， 等。

entries.titleEN: Spoiler, Drag Devices and Variable Aerodynamic Fairings
entries.titleZH: 扰流板、阻力装置和可变气动整流罩
entries.definitionEN: That portion of the systems which controls the position and movement of the spoilers, drag devices and variable aerodynamic fairings. Includes fairings. Includes items such as control handles, cables, warning systems, linkages, spoilers, drag devices, position indicators, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制position 和 movement 的 扰流板， drag devices 和 variable aerodynamic 整流罩的部分。包括整流罩。包括控制 handles， 钢索/电缆， 警告系统， 连杆机构， 扰流板， drag devices， 位置指示器， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the systems which protects the control surfaces from movement by wind while the aircraft is on the ground. Does not include locking the control by means of flight control boost system.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 protects 操纵面 从 movement 由 wind while 飞机 is 在 ground。不包括locking 控制 由 means 的 flight 控制 boost 系统。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the systems which controls the position and movement of variable opening wings slots, leading edge wing flaps, and other similar auxiliary devices used for increasing aerodynamic lift. Includes items such as control handles, cables, actuators, linkages, warning systems, control surfaces, position indicators, etc. Does not include trailing edge flaps.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制position 和 movement 的 variable opening 机翼 slots， 前缘 wing 襟翼， 和 other similar 辅助 devices used 用于 increasing aerodynamic lift的部分。包括控制 handles， 钢索/电缆， 作动器， 连杆机构， 警告系统， 操纵面， 位置指示器， 等 不包括 后缘 襟翼等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which stores fuel. Includes tank sealing, bladder type cells, ventilating system, cell and tank inter-connectors, over wing filler necks and caps, etc. Also includes reservoir feed pumping systems and reservoirs within the tanks which are not part of the distribution system.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 stores fuel。包括tank sealing， bladder type cells， ventilating 系统， cell 和 tank inter-connectors， over wing filler necks 和 caps， 等 Also 包括 reservoir feed pumping 系统 和 reservoirs 在。内 tanks 其 are not part 的 分配 系统。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to distribute fuel from the filler connector to the storage system and from the storage system to and including the power plant fuel quick disconnect. Includes items such as plumbing, pumps, valves, controls, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于分配/输送 fuel 从 filler connector 至 storage 系统 和 从 storage 系统 至 和 including 动力装置 燃油快卸接头的部分。包括管路， pumps， 活门， 控制装置， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to dump fuel overboard during flight. Includes items such as plumbing, valves, controls, chutes, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于dump fuel overboard during flight的部分。包括管路， 活门， 控制装置， chutes， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to indicate the quantity, temperature, and pressure of the fuel. Includes pressure warning systems for pumping systems within the tank, etc. Does not include engine fuel flow or pressure.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示fuel的数量、温度和压力的部分。包括压力警告系统 用于 pumping 系统 在。内 tank， 等 不包括 发动机燃油流量 或 压力。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to store and deliver hydraulic fluid to using systems. Includes items such as tanks, accumulators, valves, pumps, levers, switches, cables, plumbing, wiring, external connectors, etc. Does not include the supply valves to the using systems.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于储存 和 输送 液压油 至 using 系统的部分。包括tanks， accumulators， 活门， pumps， 手柄/杆， 开关， 钢索/电缆， 管路， 导线/布线， 外部 connectors， 等 不包括 供给 活门 至 using 系统等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is classified as auxiliary, emergency or standby, and which is used to supplement or take the place of the main hydraulic system. Includes items such as tanks and accumulators which are separate from the main system, hand pumps, auxiliary pumps, valves, plumbing, wiring, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 is classified 作为 辅助， 应急 或 备用， 和 用于 supplement 或 take place 的 主 hydraulic 系统。包括tanks 和 accumulators 其 are separate 从 主 系统， hand pumps， 辅助 pumps， 活门， 管路， 导线/布线， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to indicate the quantity, temperature and pressure of the hydraulic fluid. Includes items such as transmitters, indicators, wiring, warning systems, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示液压油的数量、温度和压力的部分。包括传感/发送器， 指示器， 导线/布线， 警告系统， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on all airfoil surfaces. Includes wings, airfoil sections of the empennage, and pylons.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于消除或防止所有翼面结冰的部分。包括机翼， 翼面部分 的 尾翼， 和 吊挂。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice in or around air intakes. Includes power plant cowling anti-icing.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于消除或防止进气道内或周围结冰的部分。包括动力装置 发动机罩/整流罩 anti-icing。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on the pitot and static systems.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于消除或防止皮托和静压 系统结冰的部分。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice, frost or rain on the Windows, windshields and doors.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于消除 或 防止 结冰， 霜 或 雨水 在 窗， 风挡 和 门的部分。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on antennas and radomes.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于消除或防止天线 和 雷达罩结冰的部分。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on propellers or rotors. Includes all components up to but not including rotating assembly.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于消除或防止螺旋桨 或 旋翼结冰的部分。包括所有 部件 直到但不包括 旋转组件。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to prevent the formation of ice in water supply and drain lines.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于防止供水和排水管路结冰的部分。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to detect and indicate the formation of ice.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于探测和指示结冰的部分。

entries.definitionEN: Coverage of all panels fixed or movable with their replaceable components such as instruments, switches, circuit breakers, fuses, etc. Also includes general coverage of instrument panel vibrators and other panel accessories.
entries.definitionZH: 涵盖所有 panels fixed 或 movable 带有 their replaceable 部件 例如 instruments， 开关， 断路器， fuses， 等 Also 包括 通用/概述 coverage 的 instrument panel vibrators 和 other panel accessories。

entries.definitionEN: Those instruments, units and components which are not related to specific systems. Includes items such as inclinometers, clocks, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 instruments， 装置 和 部件 其 are 不属于 specific 系统。包括inclinometers， clocks， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Those systems and components used for recording data not related to specific systems. Includes items such as flight recorders, performance or maintenance recorders, VG recorders, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 系统 和 部件 used 用于 recording 数据 不属于 specific 系统。包括飞行记录器， performance 或 维修记录器， VG recorders， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Those systems and components used for computing data from a number of different sources without a preponderance of functions in any one system. Includes items such as Digital Core Avionic System (DCAS), stored check list, emergency procedures, company regulations, etc., for call up on a display, integrated instrument systems such as engine, airplane power and central warning indicators when combined into a central display.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 系统 和 部件 used 用于 computing 数据 从 a 数量 different sources without a preponderance 的 functions 在 any one 系统。包括数字 Core Avionic 系统 (DCAS)， 储存 check list， 应急 程序， company regulations， 等， 用于 call up 在 a display， 综合 instrument 系统 例如 发动机， 飞机 功率/动力 和 central warning 指示器 when combined into a central display等。

entries.definitionEN: Those systems and components which give audible or visual warning of conditions in unrelated systems. Includes items such as master warning or flight warning systems, central instrument warning, or caution and warning systems, tone generators, annunciators, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 系统 和 部件 其 give audible 或 visual warning 的 情况 在 unrelated 系统。包括master warning 或 flight 警告系统， central instrument warning， 或 caution 和 警告系统， tone generators， annunciators， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Those systems and components which give visual display of conditions in unrelated systems.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 系统 和 部件 其 give visual display 的 情况 在 unrelated 系统。

entries.definitionEN: Those systems and components used for collating and computing data from unrelated systems and transmitting same automatically. Includes ASDAR systems and components.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 系统 和 部件 used 用于 collating 和 computing 数据 从 unrelated 系统 和 transmitting same automatically。包括ASDAR 系统 和 部件。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which provides the major support for the aircraft while on the ground. Includes items such as shock struts, bogie axles, drag struts, doors, linkages, attach bolts, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供major support 用于 飞机 while 在 ground的部分。包括减震支柱， 小车架轴， 阻力撑杆， 门， 连杆机构， attach bolts， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which supports the nose of the aircraft while the aircraft is on the ground. Includes items such as shock struts, drag struts, doors, linkages, attach bolts, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 supports nose 的 飞机 while 飞机 is 在 ground。包括减震支柱， 阻力撑杆， 门， 连杆机构， attach bolts， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to extend and retract the landing gear and open and close the landing gear doors. Includes items such as actuating mechanisms, bogie trim, bungees, up and down latches, operating controls, valves and motors, cables, wiring, plumbing, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于extend 和 retract 起落架 和 open 和 close 起落架舱门的部分。包括actuating mechanisms， bogie trim， bungees， up 和 down latches， operating 控制装置， 活门 和 motors， 钢索/电缆， 导线/布线， 管路， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which provides for rolling and stopping the aircraft while on the ground and stopping wheel rotation after retraction. Includes items such as bearings, tires, valves, de-boosters, swivel glands, anti-skid devices, pressure indicators, plumbing, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供用于 rolling 和 stopping 飞机 while 在 ground 和 stopping 机轮转动 after retraction的部分。包括bearings， 轮胎， 活门， de-boosters， swivel glands， anti-skid devices， 压力 指示器， 管路， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to control the direction of movement of the aircraft on the ground. Includes items such as actuating cylinders, controls, bogie swivel unlock, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制 方向 的 movement 的 飞机 在 ground的部分。包括actuating cylinders， 控制装置， bogie swivel unlock， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to indicate and warn of the position of the landing gear/doors. Includes items such as switches, relays, lights, indicators, horns, wiring, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示 和 warn 的 position 的 起落架/门的部分。包括开关， 继电器， 灯， 指示器， 喇叭， 导线/布线， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Devices used to stabilize the aircraft while on the ground and prevent damage by ground contact. Includes items such as shock strut, skid block, wheels, etc.
entries.definitionZH: Devices 用于 stabilize 飞机 while 在 ground 和 防止 damage 由 ground contact。包括shock strut， skid block， 机轮， 等。

entries.definitionEN: The lighting sub-systems in the compartment above the floor and between the forward passenger partition and the forward pressure dome. Does not include cargo compartment. Includes direct and indirect illumination of work areas, panels, and instruments. Includes master warning light and warning light dimming systems, where not integrated with a central audio or visual system under 31-50.
entries.definitionZH: lighting sub-系统 在 compartment 上述 floor 和 between forward passenger partition 和 forward 增压隔框。不包括货舱。包括direct 和 indirect illumination 的 work areas， panels， 和 instruments。包括master warning light 和 warning light dimming 系统， 其中 not 综合 带有 a central audio 或 visual 系统 under 31-50。

entries.definitionEN: The lighting sub-systems in the areas in which the passengers are seated and in buffet/galley, lavatories, lounges and coat rooms. Includes items such as direct and indirect illumination, passenger call system, lighted signs, etc.
entries.definitionZH: lighting sub-系统 在 areas 在 其 旅客 are seated 和 在 buffet/厨房， lavatories， lounges 和 coat rooms。包括direct 和 indirect illumination， passenger call 系统， lighted signs， 等。

entries.definitionEN: The lighting sub-systems in the compartments for stowage of cargo and the housing of various components of accessories.
entries.definitionZH: lighting sub-系统 在 compartments 用于 stowage 的 cargo 和 housing 的 various 部件 的 accessories。

entries.definitionEN: The lighting sub-systems used to provide illumination outside of the aircraft. Includes lights such as landing, navigation, position indicating, wing illumination, rotating, courtesy, taxi, etc.
entries.definitionZH: lighting sub-系统 用于 provide illumination outside 的 飞机。包括灯 例如 landing， 导航， position 指示， wing illumination， rotating， courtesy， taxi， 等。

entries.definitionEN: The separate and independent sub-system used to provide illumination in case of primary electrical power failure. Includes items such as inertia flashlights, lanterns, etc.
entries.definitionZH: separate 和 独立 子系统 用于 provide illumination 在 case 的 primary 电源 failure。包括inertia flashlights， lanterns， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which senses environmental conditions and uses the data to influence navigation. Includes such items as Central Air Data Computers, pitot/static systems, air temperature, rate-of-climb, airspeed, high speed warning, altitude, altitude reporting, altimeter correction system, air disturbance detection system, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 senses environmental 情况 和 uses 数据 至 influence 导航。包括中央大气数据计算机， 皮托/静压 系统， air 温度， rate-的-climb， airspeed， high 速度 warning， 高度， 高度 reporting， altimeter correction 系统， air disturbance detection 系统， 等。

entries.definitionEN: The portion of the system which uses magnetic or inertia forces to sense and display the direction or attitude of the aircraft. This includes sensing, computing, indicating and warning devices such as magnetic compasses, vertical and directional references, magnetic heading systems, attitude director systems, symbol generators, turn and bank, rate of turn, amplifiers, indicators, etc. Includes Flight Director when it is not integral with the auto pilot computation.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中使用magnetic 或 inertia forces 至 sense 和 display 方向 或 姿态 的 飞机的部分。该 包括 sensing， computing， 指示 和 warning devices 例如 magnetic compasses， vertical 和 directional references， magnetic 航向 系统， 姿态指引系统， symbol generators， turn 和 bank， rate 的 turn， 放大器， 指示器， 等 包括 飞行指引仪 when it is not integral 带有 auto pilot computation。
