entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which provides guidance during approach, landing and taxiing. Includes items such as localizer, glide slope, ILS, markers, paravisual director ground guidance systems, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供guidance during approach， landing 和 taxiing的部分。包括localizer， glide slope， ILS， markers， paravisual director ground guidance 系统， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which provides information to determine position and is mainly independent of ground installations or orbital satellites. Includes items such as inertial guidance systems, weather radar, doppler, proximity warning, collision avoidance, star tracker, etc. Also includes sextants/octants, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供information 至 determine position 和 is mainly 独立 的 ground installations 或 orbital satellites的部分。包括inertial guidance 系统， weather radar， doppler， proximity warning， collision avoidance， star tracker， 等 Also 包括 sextants/octants， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which provides information to determine position and is mainly dependent on ground installations or orbital satellites. Includes items such as DME, transponders, radio compass, LORAN, VOR, ADF, OMEGA, GLOBAL POSITIONING, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供information 至 determine position 和 is mainly 依赖式 在 ground installations 或 orbital satellites的部分。包括DME， transponders， radio compass， LORAN， VOR， ADF， OMEGA， GLOBAL POSITIONING， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which combines navigational data to compute or manage the aircraft's geographical position or theoretical flight path. Includes items such as course computers, flight management computers, performance data computers, and associated control display units, warning annunciators, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 combines navigational 数据 至 compute 或 manage 飞机's geographical position 或 theoretical flight path。包括course 计算机， flight management 计算机， performance 数据 计算机， 和 associated 控制 显示组件， warning annunciators， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which furnishes oxygen to the crew.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供氧气 至 机组的部分。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which furnishes oxygen to the passengers.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供氧气 至 旅客的部分。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which has an independent oxygen supply and which can be transported about the airplane.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 has an 独立 氧气 供给 和 其 can be transported about 飞机。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to distribute high or low pressure air to using systems. Includes items such as ducts, valves, actuators, heat exchangers, controls, etc. Does not include the supply valves to the using systems.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于分配/输送 high 或 low 压力 air 至 using 系统的部分。包括管道， 活门， 作动器， heat exchangers， 控制装置， 等 不包括 供给 活门 至 using 系统等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to indicate temperature and pressure of the pneumatic system. Includes temperature and pressure warning systems.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示 温度和压力 的 pneumatic 系统的部分。包括温度和压力 警告系统。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to distribute negative pressure air to using systems.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于分配/输送 negative 压力 air 至 using 系统的部分。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to indicate pressure. Includes pressure warning system.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示 压力的部分。包括压力 warning 系统。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to store and deliver fresh drinking water. Includes wash water system if the potable water is also used for washing.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于储存 和 输送 饮用水的部分。包括洗涤水 系统 如果 potable water is also used 用于 washing。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to store and deliver wash water which is not potable.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于储存 和 输送 洗涤水 其 is not potable的部分。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used for disposal of water and waste. Includes items such as wash basins, water closets, flushing systems, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 is used 用于 disposal 的 water 和 废水/污物。包括wash basins， water closets， flushing 系统， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system common to more than one sub-system which is used for pressurizing supply tanks to insure fluid flow.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 common 至 more than one 子系统 其 is used 用于 pressurizing 供给 tanks 至 insure fluid flow。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which stores water solely for the purpose of providing airship ballast. Includes removable tanks (bladder cells), interconnecting balance pipes, filler valves, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 stores water solely 用于 providing airship ballast。包括removable tanks (bladder cells)， interconnecting balance pipes， filler 活门， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to dump water ballast during flight. Includes valves, remote/direct, manual/automatic controls, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于dump 水压载 during flight的部分。包括活门， remote/direct， 手册/自动 控制装置， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to indicate quantity, condition and relative distribution of the water ballast.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示 数量、状态和相对分布 的 水压载的部分。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to accomplish the integrated functional control, operation, testing and monitoring of cabin systems and to increase cabin comfort (such as active noise control). Includes items such as controllers, cabin control panels, handsets, signs, loudspeakers, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于accomplish 综合 functional 控制， 操作/工作， 测试 和 监控 的 cabin 系统 和 至 increase cabin comfort (例如 active noise 控制)的部分。包括controllers， cabin 控制面板， handsets， signs， loudspeakers， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to entertain the passengers with music, video, information,, games, etc. Includes items such as controllers, cabin control panels, audio and video equipment, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于entertain 旅客 带有 music， video， information，， games， 等 包括 controllers， cabin 控制面板， audio 和 video equipment， 等的部分。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system used by System passengers and cabin crew to transmit and/or receive data/messages from air to air or from air to ground installations. Includes items such as telephones, telefaxes, modems, AM/FM radio units, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 used 由 系统 旅客 和 客舱机组 至 transmit 和/或 receive 数据/messages 从 air 至 air 或 从 air 至 ground installations。包括telephones， telefaxes， modems， AM/FM radio 装置， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to store and process cabin related data, such as systems configuration data, multimedia programs, etc. Includes items such as controllers, terminals, keyboards, disk drives, printers, modems, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于储存 和 process cabin related 数据， 例如 系统 configuration 数据， multimedia programs， 等 包括 controllers， terminals， keyboards， disk drives， printers， modems， 等的部分。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to monitor parts of the cabin area. Includes items such as surveillance cameras, monitors, etc. Does not include external anti-hijack devices or external video monitoring which are covered in [Chapter (System) 23].
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于monitor parts 的 cabin area的部分。包括surveillance cameras， monitors， 等 不包括 外部 anti-hijack devices 或 外部 video 监控 其 are covered 在 [Chapter (系统) 23]等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to support miscellaneous cabin functions.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于support miscellaneous cabin functions的部分。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the onboard information system that supports the flight deck systems, flight deck crew and flight operations
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 onboard information 系统 该 supports 驾驶舱 系统， 驾驶舱 机组 和 flight 运行/操作。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the onboard flight information system that supports all onboard maintenance system functions, maintenance technicians, and any ground based maintenance activity.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 onboard flight information 系统 该 supports 所有 onboard 维修 系统 functions， 维修人员， 和 any ground based 维修 activity。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the onboard information system that supports the passenger cabin, cabin operations, and flight attendants.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 onboard information 系统 该 supports 客舱， cabin 运行/操作， 和 flight attendants。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the onboard information system that supports other functions, as defined by the user, that cannot be related to the flight deck, passenger cabin, or maintenance.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 onboard information 系统 该 supports other functions， 作为 defined 由 user， 该 cannot be 相关的 驾驶舱， 客舱， 或 维修。

entries.definitionZH: 用于 definitions see [Chapter (系统) 71]。

entries.definitionZH: 用于 definitions see [Chapter (系统) 72]。

entries.definitionZH: 用于 definitions see [Chapter (系统) 74] 和 [Chapter (系统) 80]。

entries.definitionZH: 用于 definitions see [Chapter (系统) 75]。

entries.definitionZH: 用于 definitions see [Chapter (系统) 76]。

entries.definitionZH: 或 definitions see [Chapter (系统) 77]。

entries.definitionZH: 用于 definitions see [Chapter (系统) 78]。

entries.definitionEN: For definitions see [Chapter (System) 79].
entries.definitionZH: 用于 definitions see [Chapter (系统) 79]。

entries.definitionEN: Those compartments for storage of cargo.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 compartments 用于 storage 的 cargo。

entries.definitionEN: Those systems which have components which are or can be mounted on the aircraft and used to load/unload, restrain, guide or service cargo. Includes drive systems, rollers, latches, restraint nets etc.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 系统 其 have 部件 其 are 或 can be mounted 在 飞机 和 用于 load/unload， restrain， guide 或 service cargo。包括drive 系统， rollers， latches， restraint nets 等。

entries.definitionEN: Those systems which are related to loading/unloading of cargo. Includes aircraft levelling, loader alignment systems etc. Does not include Cargo Loading Systems.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 系统 其 are 相关的 loading/unloading 的 cargo。包括飞机 levelling， loader alignment 系统 等 不包括 Cargo Loading 系统。

entries.definitionEN: Those compartments used for the housing of various components and accessories. Includes wheel wells, tail-hydraulic-electrical/electronic equipment racks, main battery structure etc.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 compartments used 用于 housing 的 various 部件 和 accessories。包括wheel wells， tail-hydraulic-electrical/electronic equipment racks， 主 battery 结构 等。

entries.definitionEN: Those insulation blankets which are used for heat and sound insulation. Includes cargo compartments and accessory compartments, insulation, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 insulation blankets 其 are used 用于 heat 和 sound insulation。包括cargo compartments 和 accessory compartments， insulation， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Airplane major structural breakdown diagram. Primary and secondary structure diagram. Principal area and dimensional data. Restricted area diagram. Zoning diagram. Access door and panel identification. Glossary.
entries.definitionZH: 飞机 major 结构的 breakdown diagram。Primary 和 secondary 结构 diagram。Principal area 和 dimensional 数据。Restricted area diagram。Zoning diagram。Access door 和 panel identification。Glossary。

entries.titleZH: 检查、清理和气动光顺性
entries.definitionEN: Definition of damage classifications. Cleanup of dents, cracks, scratches, corrosion, etc. Aerodynamic smoothness requirements for the airplane, and permissible contour variations, gaps, and mis-match data.
entries.definitionZH: Definition 的 damage classifications。Cleanup 的 dents， cracks， scratches， corrosion， 等 Aerodynamic smoothness requirements 用于 飞机， 和 permissible contour variations， gaps， 和 mis-match 数据。

entries.definitionEN: Special processes for use in the repair of the airplane. Will not include general engineering practices unless specific deviations are required. Unique processes such as welding specifications, etc., relative to a single repair shall be incorporated in the repair and only referenced here.
entries.definitionZH: Special processes 用于 repair 的 飞机。Will not include 通用/概述 engineering practices unless specific deviations are 要求的。Unique processes 例如 welding specifications， 等， 有关 a single repair shall be incorporated 在 repair 和 only referenced here。

entries.definitionEN: Description of materials (metallic and non-metallic) including extrusions, formed sections, sheet, sealants, adhesives, and special materials used in airplane repair. Where possible, permissible substitutes and sources of supply will be given.
entries.definitionZH: 对materials (metallic 和 non-metallic) including extrusions， formed sections， sheet， sealants， adhesives， 和 special materials used 在 飞机 repair的说明。其中 possible， permissible substitutes 和 sources 的 供给 will be given。

entries.definitionEN: Description of fastener types, materials, and sizes. Procedures for fastener installation and removal including hole preparation. Fastener strength values and substitution data.
entries.definitionZH: 对fastener types， materials， 和 sizes的说明。用于fastener installation 和 removal including hole preparation的程序。Fastener strength values 和 substitution 数据。

entries.titleEN: Support of Airplane for Repair and Alignment Check Procedures
entries.titleZH: 维修支撑和对准检查程序
entries.definitionEN: Procedure for supporting the airplane to relieve loads during repairs. Includes locations for supports and contour dimensions for required ground equipment.
entries.definitionZH: 用于supporting 飞机 至 relieve loads during repairs的程序。包括locations 用于 supports 和 外形尺寸 用于 要求的 ground equipment。

entries.definitionEN: Procedures for adjusting the mass balance of control surfaces after repair. Where applicable, individual repairs will contain their own balancing instructions.
entries.definitionZH: 用于adjusting mass balance 的 操纵面 after repair的程序。其中 applicable， 单独的 repairs will contain their own balancing 说明。

entries.definitionEN: Typical repairs suitable for general use, not limited to one ATA Chapter.
entries.definitionZH: Typical repairs suitable 用于 通用/概述 use， not limited 至 one ATA Chapter。

entries.definitionEN: Topics concerning the electrical bonding of aircraft structure as well as electrical bonding of subsystems to aircraft structure.
entries.definitionZH: 关于electrical bonding 的 飞机 结构 作为 well 作为 electrical bonding 的 子系统 至 飞机 结构的主题。

entries.definitionEN: Doors used for entrance and exit of the passengers and crew to and from the aircraft. Includes items such as structure, latching mechanisms, locking units, handles, insulation, lining, controls, integral steps, ramps, handrails, attach/attached fittings, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 门 used 用于 entrance 和 exit 的 旅客 和 机组 至 和 从 飞机。包括结构， latching mechanisms， locking 装置， handles， insulation， lining， 控制装置， integral steps， ramps， handrails， 连接接头， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Exit doors used to facilitate evacuation that are not normally used for exit. Includes items such as structure, latching mechanisms, locking units, handles, insulation, lining, controls, attach/attached fittings, etc.
entries.definitionZH: Exit 门 用于 facilitate evacuation 该 are not normally used 用于 exit。包括结构， latching mechanisms， locking 装置， handles， insulation， lining， 控制装置， 连接接头， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Exterior doors used primarily to gain access to cargo compartments. Includes items such as structure, latching mechanisms, motors, handles, insulation, lining, controls, integral steps, ramps, handrails, attach/attached fittings, etc.
entries.definitionZH: Exterior 门 used primarily 至 gain access 至 cargo compartments。包括结构， latching mechanisms， motors， handles， insulation， lining， 控制装置， integral steps， ramps， handrails， 连接接头， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Exterior doors used primarily to gain access for servicing aircraft systems and equipment and miscellaneous exterior doors used to fulfill system functions. Includes items such as structure, latching mechanisms, handles, insulation, lining, controls, integral steps, handrails, attach/attached fittings, etc.
entries.definitionZH: Exterior 门 used primarily 至 gain access 用于 servicing 飞机 系统 和 equipment 和 miscellaneous exterior 门 用于 fulfill 系统 functions。包括结构， latching mechanisms， handles， insulation， lining， 控制装置， integral steps， handrails， 连接接头， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Doors inside the fuselage installed in fixed partitions. Includes items such as structure, latching mechanisms, handles, lining, attach/attached fittings, etc. Does not include doors installed in movable partitions which are covered in [Chapter (System) 25].
entries.definitionZH: 门 inside 机身 installed 在 fixed partitions。包括结构， latching mechanisms， handles， lining， 连接接头， 等 不包括 门 installed 在 movable partitions 其 are covered 在 [Chapter (系统) 25]等。

entries.definitionEN: Stairs which operate in conjunction with but are not an integral part of entrance doors. Stairs whose primary structure is a door shall be covered under the appropriate topic. Includes items such as structure, actuating mechanisms and controls, handrails, attach/attached fittings, etc.
entries.definitionZH: Stairs 其 operate 在 conjunction 带有 但 are not an integral part 的 entrance 门。Stairs whose primary 结构 is a door shall be covered under appropriate topic。包括结构， actuating mechanisms 和 控制装置， handrails， 连接接头， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used for the powered operation of the doors and/or to indicate whether the doors are closed and properly latched. Includes items such as as motors, computers, sensors, switches, lights, bells, horns, etc. Does not include landing gear door warning which is covered in [Chapter (System) 32].
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 is used 用于 powered 操作/工作 的 门 和/或 至 指示 whether 门 are closed 和 properly latched。包括作为 motors， 计算机， 传感器， 开关， 灯， 铃， 喇叭， 等 不包括 起落架 door warning 其 is covered 在 [Chapter (系统) 32]等。

entries.definitionEN: Structure of the doors used to enclose the landing gear compartments. Includes items such as structure, latching mechanisms, handles, insulation, lining, controls, attach/attached fittings, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 结构 的 门 用于 enclose 起落架 compartments。包括结构， latching mechanisms， handles， insulation， lining， 控制装置， 连接接头， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Skins, main structure, secondary structure, and fairings of the complete fuselage with any structural differences grouped together and highlighted by fuselage section location. The section locations shall be defined by manufacturing joints or other suitable demarcations in sequence from front to rear. Does not include movable partitions covered in [Chapter (System) 25] nor the functional and maintenance aspects of variable aerodynamic fairings covered in [Chapter (System) 27].
entries.definitionZH: 蒙皮、主 结构， secondary 结构， 和 整流罩 的 complete 机身 带有 any 结构的 differences grouped together 和 highlighted 由 机身 段/章节 location。段/章节 locations shall be defined 由 manufacturing joints 或 other suitable demarcations 在 sequence 从 front 至 rear。不包括movable partitions covered 在 [Chapter (系统) 25] nor functional 和 维修 aspects 的 variable aerodynamic 整流罩 covered 在 [Chapter (系统) 27]。

entries.definitionEN: Skins, primary structure, secondary structure, fillets, and fairings of a complete nacelle with any structural differences grouped together and highlighted by specific nacelle designator. The section locations shall be defined by manufacturing joints or other suitable demarcations in a logical sequence.
entries.definitionZH: 蒙皮、primary 结构， secondary 结构， 整流过渡段， 和 整流罩 的 a complete nacelle 带有 any 结构的 differences grouped together 和 highlighted 由 specific nacelle designator。段/章节 locations shall be defined 由 manufacturing joints 或 other suitable demarcations 在 a logical sequence。

entries.definitionEN: Skins, primary structure, secondary structure, fillets, and fairings of a complete pylon with any structure differences grouped together and highlighted by specific pylon designator. The section locations shall be defined by manufacturing joints or other suitable demarcations in a logical sequence.
entries.definitionZH: 蒙皮、primary 结构， secondary 结构， 整流过渡段， 和 整流罩 的 a complete pylon 带有 any 结构 differences grouped together 和 highlighted 由 specific pylon designator。段/章节 locations shall be defined 由 manufacturing joints 或 other suitable demarcations 在 a logical sequence。

entries.definitionEN: The horizontal airfoil of the tail or nose section to which the elevator is attached. Includes items such as spars, ribs, stringers, skins, access covers, tips, attach/attached fittings, etc.
entries.definitionZH: horizontal airfoil 的 tail 或 nose 段/章节 至 其 升降舵 is attached。包括梁， 肋， 桁条， 蒙皮， access 盖板， tips， 连接接头， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Removable airfoil which is attached to the horizontal stabilizer or canard and used for pitch control. Includes items such as spars, ribs, stringers, skins, access covers, tabs, balance devices, attach/ attached fittings, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 可拆卸翼面，is attached 至 水平安定面 或 canard 和 used 用于 pitch 控制。包括梁， 肋， 桁条， 蒙皮， access 盖板， 调整片， balance devices， attach/ attached 接头/支架， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Vertical airfoil to which the rudder is attached. Includes items such as spars, ribs, stringers, skins, access covers, tips, attach/attached fittings, etc.
entries.definitionZH: Vertical airfoil 至 其 方向舵 is attached。包括梁， 肋， 桁条， 蒙皮， access 盖板， tips， 连接接头， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Removable airfoil which is attached to the vertical stabilizer and used for yaw control. Includes items such as spars, ribs, stringers, skins, access covers, tabs, balance devices, attach/attached fittings, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 可拆卸翼面，is attached 至 垂直安定面 和 used 用于 偏航控制。包括梁， 肋， 桁条， 蒙皮， access 盖板， 调整片， balance devices， 连接接头， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Compartment above the floor and between the forward passenger partition and the forward pressure dome. Includes items such as the transparent material and its frame of sliding and fixed windows and windshields, handles, latching mechanisms, etc. Does not include door or inspection/observation windows.
entries.definitionZH: Compartment 上述 floor 和 between forward passenger partition 和 forward 增压隔框。包括transparent material 和 其 frame 的 sliding 和 fixed 窗 和 风挡， handles， latching mechanisms， 等 不包括 door 或 检查/observation 窗等。

entries.definitionEN: Area in which the passengers are seated. Includes lounges, lavatories, buffets/galleys and coatrooms. Includes items such as transparent material, its frame, frost shield, etc.
entries.definitionZH: Area 在 其 旅客 are seated。包括lounges， lavatories， buffets/galleys 和 coatrooms。包括transparent material， 其 frame， 霜 shield， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Doors used for entrance and exit of the passengers, flight crew and service personnel to and from the airplane. Includes items such as transparent material, its frame, etc. Does not include emergency exit windows.
entries.definitionZH: 门 used 用于 entrance 和 exit 的 旅客， 飞行机组 和 service personnel 至 和 从 飞机。包括transparent material， 其 frame， 等 不包括 应急出口 窗等。

entries.definitionEN: Windows used for examining compartments and equipment in and about the airplane, and astrodomes used for celestial navigation. Includes items such as transparent material, its frame, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 窗 used 用于 examining compartments 和 equipment 在 和 about 飞机， 和 astrodomes used 用于 celestial 导航。包括transparent material， 其 frame， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Skins, primary structure, fillets, and fairings of the center wing, and attach/attached fittings.
entries.definitionZH: 蒙皮、primary 结构， 整流过渡段， 和 整流罩 的 center wing， 和 连接接头。

entries.definitionEN: Skins, primary structure, fillets, and fairings of the outer wing, and attach/attached fittings.
entries.definitionZH: 蒙皮、primary 结构， 整流过渡段， 和 整流罩 的 outer wing， 和 连接接头。

entries.definitionEN: Skins and structure of the wing tip and attached fittings.
entries.definitionZH: 蒙皮 和 结构 的 wing tip 和 attached 接头/支架。

entries.titleEN: Leading Edge and Leading Edge Devices
entries.definitionEN: Skins and structure of the wing leading edge and removable leading edge airfoils such as flaps, slats, attach/attached fittings, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 蒙皮 和 结构 的 wing 前缘 和 removable 前缘 airfoils 例如 襟翼， 缝翼， 连接接头， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Skins and structure of the wing and trailing edge and removable edge airfoils such as flaps and attach/attached fittings.
entries.definitionZH: 蒙皮 和 结构 的 wing 和 后缘 和 removable edge airfoils 例如 襟翼 和 连接接头。

entries.definitionEN: Skins and structure of ailerons and tabs including balancing devices and attach/attached fittings.
entries.definitionZH: 蒙皮 和 结构 的 ailerons 和 调整片 including balancing devices 和 连接接头。

entries.definitionEN: Skins and structure of wing-mounted spoilers, airbrakes, lift dumpers, attach/attached fittings, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 蒙皮 和 结构 的 wing-mounted 扰流板， airbrakes， lift dumpers， 连接接头， 等。

entries.definitionEN: System that controls the on-ground movement of any portion of the main wing structure. Includes mechanisms, linkages, actuators, locks, indicating/warning systems, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统 该 控制装置 在-ground movement 的 any portion 的 主 wing 结构。包括mechanisms， 连杆机构， 作动器， locks， 指示/警告系统， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which rotates except the engine propeller shaft. Includes items such as blades, dome, hub, spinner, slip ring, deicer boot, distributor valve, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 rotates except 发动机 螺旋桨 shaft。包括blades， dome， hub， spinner， slip ring， deicer boot， distributor valve， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which controls the pitch of the propeller blades. Includes items such as governor synchronizers, switches, wiring, cables, levers, etc. Does not include any parts which rotate with the propeller assembly. Also includes all those units and components provided for the propulsor vector drive system. Includes flight deck control, drive motors, gearboxes, drive shafts, synchronizing shafts, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制pitch 的 螺旋桨 blades的部分。包括governor synchronizers， 开关， 导线/布线， 钢索/电缆， 手柄/杆， 等 不包括 any parts 其 rotate 带有 螺旋桨 组件等。还包括所有 这些 装置 和 部件 provided 用于 propulsor vector drive 系统。包括驾驶舱 控制， drive motors， gearboxes， drive shafts， synchronizing shafts， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to decrease run-down time or stop propeller rotation during engine power-off conditions. Includes brake mechanisms, levers, pulleys, cables, switches, wiring, plumbing, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于decrease run-down time 或 stop 螺旋桨 rotation during 发动机 功率/动力-off 情况的部分。包括brake mechanisms， 手柄/杆， 滑轮， 钢索/电缆， 开关， 导线/布线， 管路， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to indicate operation or activation of propeller/propulsor systems. Includes items such as light, switches, wiring etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示 操作/工作 或 activation 的 螺旋桨/propulsor 系统的部分。包括light， 开关， 导线/布线 等。

entries.definitionEN: The complete duct assembly including vector drive attachment, fairings, stators, gearbox covers, etc.
entries.definitionZH: complete duct 组件 including vector drive attachment， 整流罩， stators， gearbox 盖板， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Rotor blade assemblies, including the heating mate (electrical resistors) for anti-icing.
entries.definitionZH: 旋翼 blade 组件， including heating mate (electrical resistors) 用于 anti-icing。

entries.definitionEN: Complete rotor head(s), including blade folding system(s). Includes sleeves, spindles, dampers, rotor head fairing(s) as well as rotor shaft(s) and swashplate(s) if the rotor head and shaft constitute a non dissociable assembly.
entries.definitionZH: Complete 旋翼桨毂(s)， including blade folding 系统(s)。包括sleeves， spindles， dampers， 旋翼桨毂 fairing(s) 作为 well 作为 旋翼 shaft(s) 和 自动倾斜器(s) 如果 旋翼桨毂 和 shaft constitute a non dissociable 组件。

entries.titleZH: 旋翼轴/自动倾斜器组件
entries.definitionEN: If not included in 20
entries.definitionZH: 如果 not included 在 20。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which indicates operation or activation of rotor systems. Includes items such as lights, gauges, switches, wiring, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 指示 操作/工作 或 activation 的 旋翼 系统。包括灯， gauges， 开关， 导线/布线， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Drive shaft(s) between engine(s) and main gear box(es) and, if applicable, clutch and free wheel unit(s).
entries.definitionZH: Drive shaft(s) between 发动机(s) 和 主 gear box(es) 和， 如果 applicable， clutch 和 free wheel unit(s)。

entries.definitionEN: Part of the system driving the rotor(s). Includes the mechanical power take-off(s) and accessory drives but does not include the accessories themselves (alternators, hydraulic pumps, etc.). Includes the G.B. lubricating system(s) and the rotor brake(s) if the latter form(s) part of the G.B.(s).
entries.definitionZH: Part 的 系统 driving 旋翼(s)。包括mechanical 功率/动力 take-off(s) 和 accessory drives 但 不包括 accessories themselves (alternators， hydraulic pumps， 等)。包括G。B。 lubricating 系统(s) 和 旋翼 brake(s) 如果 latter form(s) part 的 G。B。(s)。

entries.definitionEN: Suspension bars, vibration damping system providing attachment of the G.B.(s) to the airframe.
entries.definitionZH: Suspension bars， vibration damping 系统 providing attachment 的 G。B。(s) 至 机体。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which indicates operation or activation of rotor systems. Includes items such as lights, gauges, switches, wiring, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 指示 操作/工作 或 activation 的 旋翼 系统。包括灯， gauges， 开关， 导线/布线， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Blade assemblies, including the heating mats (electrical resistors) for anti-icing.
entries.definitionZH: Blade 组件， including heating mats (electrical resistors) 用于 anti-icing。

entries.definitionEN: Tail rotor head
entries.definitionZH: Tail 旋翼桨毂。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which indicates operation or activation of rotor systems. Includes items such as lights, gauges, switches, wiring, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 指示 操作/工作 或 activation 的 旋翼 系统。包括灯， gauges， 开关， 导线/布线， 等。
entries.noteEN: NOTE: Coverage shall be limited to front matter and Chapters 50 through 59. | NOTE: For an integral unit, only one section will be used.
entries.noteZH: NOTE： Coverage shall be limited 至 front matter 和 Chapters 50 through 59。 NOTE： 用于 an integral unit， only one 段/章节 will be used。

entries.definitionEN: Drive shafts, bearings, flexible couplings.
entries.definitionZH: Drive shafts， bearings， flexible couplings。

entries.definitionEN: Intermediate gearbox. Tail gearbox.
entries.definitionZH: Intermediate gearbox。Tail gearbox。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which indicates operation or activation of rotor systems. Includes items such as lights, gauges, switches, wiring, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 指示 操作/工作 或 activation 的 旋翼 系统。包括灯， gauges， 开关， 导线/布线， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Part of the system ensuring rotor blade folding and spreading; includes the mechanical, hydraulic and electrical means permanently fitted on the aircraft.
entries.definitionZH: Part 的 系统 ensuring 旋翼 blade folding 和 spreading； 包括 mechanical， hydraulic 和 electrical means permanently fitted 在 飞机。

entries.definitionEN: Part of system ensuring tail pylon folding and spreading; includes mechanical, hydraulic and electrical means permanently fitted on the aircraft.
entries.definitionZH: Part 的 系统 ensuring 尾梁 folding 和 spreading； 包括 mechanical， hydraulic 和 electrical means permanently fitted 在 飞机。

entries.definitionEN: Part of the system intended for controlling folding/spreading sequences and for indicating the system operation. Includes the control units, caption lights, indicators, wiring, etc.
entries.definitionZH: Part 的 系统 intended 用于 controlling folding/spreading sequences 和 用于 指示 系统 操作/工作。包括控制 装置， caption 灯， 指示器， 导线/布线， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which controls the attitude by the angle of attack of the rotor blades. Includes items such as collective pitch lever, cyclic pitch stick and corresponding linkage and cable controls, coupling and mixing units, and artificial feel unit system. Also includes the control position indicating system.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制姿态 由 angle 的 attack 的 旋翼桨叶的部分。包括总距 lever， 周期变距 stick 和 corresponding linkage 和 cable 控制装置， coupling 和 mixing 装置， 和 artificial feel unit 系统等。还包括控制 position 指示 系统。

entries.titleZH: 反扭矩旋翼操纵（偏航控制）
entries.definitionEN: That portion of the controls which control the direction of the helicopter (yaw control). Includes items such as tail rotor control pedals, relevant linkage and cable controls, bellcranks constituting the yaw control channel and the control position indicating system.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 控制装置 其 控制 方向 的 直升机 (偏航控制)。包括尾桨 控制 pedals， relevant linkage 和 cable 控制装置， bellcranks constituting 偏航控制 channel 和 控制 position 指示 系统等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which from a power source ensures distribution to the rotor servo-control system. Includes items such as pressure relief valves, electro valves, check valves, accumulators and equipment needed for the operation of the servo control system, the servo controls, the systems used for monitoring and indicating the operation of the servo control system.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 从 a 功率/动力 source ensures 分配 至 旋翼 servo-控制 系统。包括压力 relief 活门， electro 活门， check 活门， accumulators 和 equipment needed 用于 操作/工作 的 servo 控制 系统， servo 控制装置， 系统 used 用于 监控 和 指示 操作/工作 的 servo 控制 系统等。

entries.definitionEN: This topic shall include general information, limits and procedures. In the maintenance manual this section shall cover subjects such as engine changes, run-up, externally-mounted spare power plants, etc. In the overhaul manual, this section shall cover subjects such as power plant build-up, teardown, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 本主题应包括通用/概述 information， limits 和 程序。在 维修手册 该 段/章节 shall cover subjects 例如 发动机 changes， run-up， externally-mounted spare 功率/动力 plants， 等 在 翻修手册， 该 段/章节 shall cover subjects 例如 动力装置 build-up， teardown， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Those removable coverings which extend over and around the power plant assembly. Includes the functioning and maintenance aspects of items such as accessory section cowls, cowl flaps, cowling supports, and attach and locking mechanisms, etc. Does not include the structure integral with the airframe which shall be covered in the applicable Structures chapter.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 removable coverings 其 extend over 和 周围 动力装置 组件。包括functioning 和 维修 aspects 的 items 例如 accessory 段/章节 cowls， 整流罩襟片， 发动机罩/整流罩 supports， 和 attach 和 locking mechanisms， 等 不包括 结构 integral 带有 机体 其 shall be covered 在 applicable Structures chapter。

entries.definitionEN: The framework, either of build-up construction or forgings which support the engine and attach it to the nacelle or pylon. Includes items such as engine mounts, vibration dampeners, support links, mounting bolts, etc.
entries.definitionZH: framework， either 的 build-up construction 或 forgings 其 support 发动机 和 attach it 至 nacelle 或 pylon。包括发动机 mounts， vibration dampeners， support links， mounting bolts， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Those fire-resistant partitions and seals mounted on or about the power package for the purpose of isolating areas subject to fire. Does not include those fire-walls which are included in [Chapter (System) 54].
entries.definitionZH: 这些 火警/火-resistant partitions 和 seals mounted 在 或 about 功率/动力 package 用于 isolating areas subject 至 火警/火。不包括这些 火警/火-walls 其 are included 在 [Chapter (系统) 54]。

entries.definitionEN: Those fittings and brackets which are used for the support of equipment in and about the power package.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 接头/支架 和 brackets 其 are used 用于 support 的 equipment 在 和 about 功率/动力 package。

entries.definitionEN: Those electrical cables, conduits, plugs, sockets, etc., which serve several power plant systems, but which are banded together to facilitate removal and installation of the power plant. Does not include the wiring which is specifically covered under another system.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 electrical 钢索/电缆， conduits， plugs， sockets， 等， 其 serve several 动力装置 系统， 但 其 are banded together 至 facilitate removal 和 installation 的 动力装置。不包括导线/布线 其 is specifically covered under another 系统。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the power plant system which directs and may or may not vary the mass air flow to the engine. Includes items such as nose ring cowls, scoops, compressor fan cowls, buried engine ducts, vortex generators, actuators, control handles, cables, wiring, plumbing, linkages, doors, warning systems, position indicators, etc. Does not include integral structure with the airframe, which shall be included in the applicable Structures chapter.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 动力装置 系统 其 directs 和 may 或 may not vary mass air flow 至 发动机。包括nose ring cowls， scoops， 压气机 fan cowls， buried 发动机 管道， vortex generators， 作动器， 控制 handles， 钢索/电缆， 导线/布线， 管路， 连杆机构， 门， 警告系统， 位置指示器， 等 不包括 integral 结构 带有 机体， 其 shall be included 在 applicable Structures chapter等。

entries.definitionEN: Those components and manifold assemblies which are used to drain off excess fluids from the power plant and its accessories. Includes drainlines, manifolds, tanks, flame arrestors, vents, and their supporting brackets, etc. Also includes components that are an integral part of, or fitted to the power plant cowling.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 部件 和 manifold 组件 用于 drain off excess fluids 从 动力装置 和 其 accessories。包括drainlines， manifolds， tanks， 火焰 arrestors， vents， 和 their supporting brackets， 等 Also 包括 部件 该 are an integral part 的， 或 fitted 至 动力装置 发动机罩/整流罩。

entries.definitionEN: This topic is intended to cover general information, limits and procedures. In the engine overhaul manual this section would include such subjects as tear down, cleaning, inspection, assembly, testing, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 本主题用于涵盖通用/概述 information， limits 和 程序。在 发动机 翻修手册 该 段/章节 would include such subjects 作为 tear down， cleaning， 检查， 组件， 测试， 等。

entries.titleEN: Reduction Gear, Shaft Section (Turbo-Prop and/or Front Mounted Gear Driven Propulsor)
entries.titleZH: 减速齿轮和轴段（涡桨和/或前置齿轮驱动推进器）
entries.definitionEN: The section of the engine which contains the propeller shafts and reduction gears. Includes items such as drives for hose mounted accessories, etc. If applicable, the section of the engine which uses mechanical force, through a gear-driven system, to drive front mounted propulsors which provide the majority of the energy generated. Includes items such as Propulsor Blades, Actuation Systems, Reduction Gears, Drive-Shafts, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 段/章节 的 发动机 其 contains 螺旋桨 shafts 和 reduction gears。包括drives 用于 hose mounted accessories， 等 如果 applicable， 段/章节 的 发动机 其 uses mechanical force， through a gear-driven 系统， 至 drive front mounted propulsors 用于提供 majority 的 energy generated等。包括Propulsor Blades， Actuation 系统， Reduction Gears， Drive-Shafts， 等。

entries.definitionEN: The section of the engine through which the air enters the compressor section. Includes items such as guide vanes, shrouds, cases, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 段/章节 的 发动机 through 其 air enters 压气机 段/章节。包括guide vanes， shrouds， cases， 等。

entries.definitionEN: The section of the engine in which the the air is compressed. Includes items such as cases, vanes, shrouds, rotors, diffusers, etc. Also includes the maintenance and overhaul of stator blades but not the operation of variable stator blades which is covered under [Chapter (System) 75 - 30]. Does not include compressor bleed system.
entries.definitionZH: 段/章节 的 发动机 在 其 air is compressed。包括cases， vanes， shrouds， 旋翼， diffusers， 等 Also 包括 维修和翻修 的 stator blades 但 not 操作/工作 的 variable stator blades 其 is covered under [Chapter (系统) 75 - 30]等。不包括压气机 bleed 系统。

entries.definitionEN: The section of the engine in which the air and fuel are combined and burned. Includes items such as burner cans, cases, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 段/章节 的 发动机 在 其 air 和 fuel are combined 和 burned。包括burner cans， cases， 等。

entries.definitionEN: The section of the engine containing the turbines. Includes items such as turbine nozzles, turbine rotors, cases, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 段/章节 的 发动机 containing turbines。包括涡轮 nozzles， 涡轮 旋翼， cases， 等。

entries.definitionEN: The mechanical power take-offs to drive accessories. Includes items such as engine-mounted gear boxes, gears, seals, pumps, etc. Does not include remotely installed gear boxes which are covered in [Chapter (System) 83].
entries.definitionZH: mechanical 功率/动力 take-offs 至 drive accessories。包括发动机-mounted gear boxes， gears， seals， pumps， 等 不包括 remotely installed gear boxes 其 are covered 在 [Chapter (系统) 83]等。

entries.definitionEN: The section of the engine which by-passes a portion of the normal engine airflow (either ram or compressed air) for the prime purpose of adding to engine thrust or reducing specific fuel consumption.
entries.definitionZH: 段/章节 的 发动机 其 由-passes a portion 的 normal 发动机 airflow (either ram 或 compressed air) 用于 prime purpose 的 adding 至 发动机 推力 或 reducing specific fuel consumption。

entries.definitionEN: The section of the engine which contains a propulsor(s) and provides the majority of the energy generated. The propulsor may be turbine-driven or gear-driven. Includes such items as propulsor turbines, propulsor blades, blade actuation, and frames (rotating and/or stationary).
entries.definitionZH: 段/章节 的 发动机 其 contains a propulsor(s) 和 provides majority 的 energy generated。propulsor may be 涡轮-driven 或 gear-driven。包括propulsor turbines， propulsor blades， blade actuation， 和 frames (rotating 和/或 stationary)等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system from the main quick disconnect to the engine, which distributes fuel to the engine burner section and the thrust augmentor. Includes items such as plumbing, pumps, temperature regulators, valves, filters, manifold, nozzles, etc. Does not include the main or thrust augmentor fuel control.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 从 主 quick disconnect 至 发动机， 其 distributes fuel 至 发动机 burner 段/章节 和 推力 augmentor。包括管路， pumps， 温度 regulators， 活门， filters， manifold， nozzles， 等 不包括 主 或 推力 augmentor 燃油控制等。

entries.definitionEN: The main fuel control which meters fuel to the engine and to the thrust augmentor. Includes items such as hydromechanical or electronic fuel control, levers, actuators, cables, pulleys, linkages, sensors, valves, etc. which are components of the fuel control units.
entries.definitionZH: 主 燃油控制 其 meters fuel 至 发动机 和 至 推力 augmentor。包括hydromechanical 或 electronic 燃油控制， 手柄/杆， 作动器， 钢索/电缆， 滑轮， 连杆机构， 传感器， 活门， 等 其 are 部件 的 燃油控制 装置等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to indicate the flow rate, temperature and pressure of the fuel. Includes items such as transmitters, indicators, wiring, etc. Does not include indication, if indication is accomplished as part of an integrated engine instrument system (Ref. [Chapter (System) 77-40]).
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示 flow rate， 温度和压力 的 fuel的部分。包括传感/发送器， 指示器， 导线/布线， 等 不包括 indication， 如果 indication is accomplished 作为 part 的 an 综合发动机仪表系统 (Ref等。[Chapter (系统) 77-40])。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which generates electrical current for the purpose of igniting the fuel mixture in the combustion chambers and thrust augmentors. Includes items such as magnetos, distributors, booster coils, exciters, transformers, storage capacitors and compositors, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 generates 电流 用于 igniting fuel mixture 在 燃烧 chambers 和 推力 augmentors。包括磁电机， distributors， booster coils， exciters， transformers， storage capacitors 和 compositors， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which conducts high or low voltage electricity from the electrical power supply to the spark plugs, or igniters. Includes wiring between magneto and distributor in those systems where they are separate units. Includes items such as ignition harness, high tension leads, coils as used in "low tension" systems, spark plugs, igniters, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 conducts high 或 low voltage electricity 从 电源 供给 至 火花塞， 或 点火器。包括导线/布线 between magneto 和 distributor 在 这些 系统 其中 they are separate 装置。包括点火 harness， high tension leads， coils 作为 used 在 "low tension" 系统， 火花塞， 点火器， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which provides a means of rendering the electrical power supply inoperative. Includes items such as ignition switches, wiring, connectors, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供a means 的 rendering 电源 供给 inoperative的部分。包括点火 开关， 导线/布线， connectors， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to eliminate and prevent the formation of ice by bleed air in all parts of the engine, excluding power plant cowling which is covered under [Chapter (System) 30]. Includes items such as valves, plumbing, wiring, regulators, etc. Electrical anti-icing is covered in [Chapter (System) 30].
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于消除 和 防止 结冰 由 bleed air 在 所有 parts 的 发动机， excluding 动力装置 发动机罩/整流罩 其 is covered under [Chapter (系统) 30]的部分。包括活门， 管路， 导线/布线， regulators， 等 电防冰 is covered 在 [Chapter (系统) 30]等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to ventilate the engine and accessories. Includes items such as valves, plumbing, wiring, jet pumps, vortex spoilers, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于ventilate 发动机 和 accessories的部分。包括活门， 管路， 导线/布线， jet pumps， vortex 扰流板， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to control the flow of air through the engine. Includes items such as governors, valves, actuators, linkages, etc. Also includes the operation of variable stator blades, but not the maintenance and overhaul, which shall be covered under [Chapter (System) 72-30].
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制 flow 的 air through 发动机的部分。包括governors， 活门， 作动器， 连杆机构， 等 Also 包括 操作/工作 的 variable stator blades， 但 not 维修和翻修， 其 shall be covered under [Chapter (系统) 72-30]等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to indicate temperature, pressure, control positions, etc. of the air systems. Includes items such as transmitters, indicators, wiring, etc
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示 温度， 压力， 控制 positions， 等 的 air 系统的部分。包括传感/发送器， 指示器， 导线/布线， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which furnishes a means of controlling the main fuel control or coordinator. Includes controls to the propeller regulator on turboprop engines. Includes items such as linkages, cables, levers, pulleys, switches, wiring, etc. Does not include the units themselves.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供a means 的 controlling 主 燃油控制 或 coordinator的部分。包括控制装置 至 螺旋桨 regulator 在 turboprop engines。包括连杆机构， 钢索/电缆， 手柄/杆， 滑轮， 开关， 导线/布线， 等 不包括 装置 themselves等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which furnishes a means of controlling the flow of fluids to and from the engine during emergency procedures. Includes items such as levers, cables, pulleys, linkages, switches, wiring, etc. Does not include the units themselves.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供a means 的 controlling flow 的 fluids 至 和 从 发动机 during 应急 程序的部分。包括手柄/杆， 钢索/电缆， 滑轮， 连杆机构， 开关， 导线/布线， 等 不包括 装置 themselves等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which directly or indirectly indicates power or thrust. Includes items such as BMEP, pressure-ratio, RPM, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 directly 或 indirectly 指示 功率/动力 或 推力。包括BMEP， 压力-ratio， RPM， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which indicates temperatures in the engine. Includes items such as cylinder head, exhaust (turbine inlet), etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 指示 temperatures 在 发动机。包括cylinder head， exhaust (涡轮 inlet)， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to analyze engine performance or condition by means of instruments or devices such as oscilloscopes, etc. Includes items such as generators, wiring, amplifiers, oscilloscopes, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于analyze 发动机 performance 或 condition 由 means 的 instruments 或 devices 例如 oscilloscopes， 等 包括 generators， 导线/布线， 放大器， oscilloscopes， 等的部分。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is an integrated concept receives several/all engine operating parameters and transmits this to a central processor for crew presentation. Includes items such as display units, transmitters, receivers, computers, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 is an 综合 concept receives several/所有 发动机 operating parameters 和 transmits 该 至 a central processor 用于 机组 presentation。包括显示组件， 传感/发送器， receivers， 计算机， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which collects the exhaust gases from the cylinders or turbines and conducts them overboard. Includes items such as collector rings, exhaust and thrust augmentor ducts, variable nozzles, actuators, plumbing, linkages, wiring, position indicators, warning systems, etc. Does not include power recovery turbines, turbo-superchargers, etc., not noise suppressors or thrust reversers where they are not an integral part of the nozzle system.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 collects 排气 从 cylinders 或 turbines 和 conducts them overboard。包括collector rings， exhaust 和 推力 augmentor 管道， variable nozzles， 作动器， 管路， 连杆机构， 导线/布线， 位置指示器， 警告系统， 等 不包括 功率/动力 recovery turbines， turbo-superchargers， 等， not noise suppressors 或 推力 reversers 其中 they are not an integral part 的 nozzle 系统等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which reduces the noise generated by the exhaust gases. Includes items such as pipes, baffles, shields, actuators, plumbing linkages, wiring, position indicators, warning systems, etc. Use -10 where integral part of nozzle system.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 reduces noise generated 由 排气。包括pipes， baffles， shields， 作动器， 管路 连杆机构， 导线/布线， 位置指示器， 警告系统， 等 Use -10 其中 integral part 的 nozzle 系统等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to change the direction of the exhaust gases for reverse thrust. Includes items such as clamshells, linkages, levers, actuators, plumbing, wiring, indicators, warning systems, etc. Use -10 where integral part of nozzle system.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于change 方向 的 排气 用于 reverse 推力的部分。包括clamshells， 连杆机构， 手柄/杆， 作动器， 管路， 导线/布线， 指示器， 警告系统， 等 Use -10 其中 integral part 的 nozzle 系统等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which varies and controls supplementary air flow of the exhaust system. Includes items such as tertiary air doors, actuators, linkages, springs, plumbing, wiring, position indicators, warning systems, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 varies 和 控制装置 supplementary air flow 的 exhaust 系统。包括tertiary air 门， 作动器， 连杆机构， springs， 管路， 导线/布线， 位置指示器， 警告系统， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system used for storage of oil. Includes items such as tanks, filling systems, internal hoppers, baffles, tank sump and drain, etc. Does not include tanks which are an integral portion of the engine.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 used 用于 storage 的 oil。包括tanks， filling 系统， 内部 hoppers， baffles， tank sump 和 drain， 等 不包括 tanks 其 are an integral portion 的 发动机等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to conduct oil from and to the engine. Includes items such as plumbing, valves, temperature regulator, control systems, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于conduct oil 从 和 至 发动机的部分。包括管路， 活门， 温度 regulator， 控制 系统， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to indicate the quantity, temperature and pressure of the oil. Includes items such as transmitters, indicators, wiring, warning systems, etc. Does not include indication if indication is accomplished as part of an integrated engine instrument system (ref. [Chapter (System) 77-40]).
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示oil的数量、温度和压力的部分。包括传感/发送器， 指示器， 导线/布线， 警告系统， 等 不包括 indication 如果 indication is accomplished 作为 part 的 an 综合发动机仪表系统 (ref等。[Chapter (系统) 77-40])。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to perform the cranking portion of the starting operation. Includes items such as plumbing, valves, wiring, starters, switches, relays, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于perform cranking portion 的 起动 操作/工作的部分。包括管路， 活门， 导线/布线， starters， 开关， 继电器， 等。

entries.definitionEN: The turbines which extract energy from the exhaust gases and are coupled to the crankshaft.
entries.definitionZH: turbines 其 extract energy 从 排气 和 are coupled 至 crankshaft。

entries.definitionEN: The turbines which extract energy from the exhaust gases and drive an air compressor.
entries.definitionZH: turbines 其 extract energy 从 排气 和 drive an air 压气机。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used for the storage of water or water mixtures. Includes tank sealing, attachment of bladder type cells, ventilating system, cell and tank interconnectors, filling systems, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 is used 用于 storage 的 water 或 water mixtures。包括tank sealing， attachment 的 bladder type cells， ventilating 系统， cell 和 tank interconnectors， filling 系统， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to conduct water or water mixtures from the tanks or cells to the engine. Includes items such as plumbing, crossfeed system, pumps, valves, controls, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于conduct water 或 water mixtures 从 tanks 或 cells 至 发动机的部分。包括管路， crossfeed 系统， pumps， 活门， 控制装置， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to dump injection water and to purge the system. Includes items such as plumbing, valves, controls, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于dump injection water 和 至 purge 系统的部分。包括管路， 活门， 控制装置， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to indicate the quantity, temperature and pressure of the water mixtures. Includes items such as transmitters, indicators, wiring, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示water mixtures的数量、温度和压力的部分。包括传感/发送器， 指示器， 导线/布线， 等。

entries.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to conduct power from the engine to the gearbox. Includes items such as drive shaft, adapters, seals, etc.
entries.definitionZH: 系统中用于conduct 功率/动力 从 发动机 至 gearbox的部分。包括drive shaft， 适配器， seals， 等。

entries.definitionEN: The case which contains the gear trains and shafts. Includes items such as gears, shafts, seals, oil pumps, coolers, etc.
entries.definitionZH: case 其 contains gear trains 和 shafts。包括gears， shafts， seals， oil pumps， coolers， 等。

entries.definitionEN: Those units or components dedicated to jet assist takeoff (JATO) systems.
entries.definitionZH: 这些 装置 或 部件 dedicated 至 jet assist takeoff (JATO) 系统。

expanded.definitionEN: Those manufacturer recommended time limits for inspections, maintenance and overhaul of the aircraft, its systems and units, and life of parts. For engine manufacturers this will include the flight cycle lives of major rotating components and other items designated critical.
expanded.definitionZH: 制造商建议的飞机、飞机系统和部件的检查、维修、翻修时限以及零部件寿命。对于发动机制造商，还包括主要旋转部件的飞行循环寿命以及其他指定为关键的项目。

expanded.definitionEN: Those manufacturer recommended maintenance checks and inspections of the aircraft, its systems and units dictated by the time limits specified in -10 above. This section shall list in more detail the items which are outlined on the airline job forms (usually by title only), and shall cross-reference the detailed procedures included in the individual Maintenance Practices.
expanded.definitionZH: 由上述-10时限决定的、制造商建议的飞机及其系统和部件维修检查和检验。本节应更详细列出航空公司工作单上通常仅以标题列出的项目，并交叉引用各具体维修施工中包含的详细程序。

expanded.definitionEN: Reserved for use in those cases where the number of breakouts provided by the fourth digit of the -20 breakout is not sufficient to cover all of the maintenance checks dictated by subsystem -10 above.
expanded.definitionZH: 当-20细分的第四位数字不足以覆盖上述-10子系统规定的全部维修检查时，本项预留使用。
expanded.noteEN: NOTE: Inclusion of the data described in -10 through -40 above, in any manual or manual publication is specifically prohibited | unless required by government regulation. Airlines desire the manufacturer's recommended time limits and scheduled | maintenance checks but these should be provided in a separate document.
expanded.noteZH: NOTE： Inclusion 的 数据 described 在 -10 through -40 上述， 在 any 手册 或 手册出版物 is specifically 禁止。 unless 要求的 由 government 规章。Airlines desire 制造商建议的 时限 和 计划。 维修检查 但 这些 should be provided 在 a 单独文件。

expanded.definitionEN: Reserved for use in those cases where the number of breakouts provided by the fourth digit of the -20 breakout is not sufficient to cover all of the maintenance checks dictated by subsystem -10 above.
expanded.definitionZH: 当-20细分的第四位数字不足以覆盖上述-10子系统规定的全部维修检查时，本项预留使用。
expanded.noteEN: NOTE: Inclusion of the data described in -10 through -40 above, in any manual or manual publication is specifically prohibited | unless required by government regulation. Airlines desire the manufacturer's recommended time limits and scheduled | maintenance checks but these should be provided in a separate document.
expanded.noteZH: NOTE： Inclusion 的 数据 described 在 -10 through -40 上述， 在 any 手册 或 手册出版物 is specifically 禁止。 unless 要求的 由 government 规章。Airlines desire 制造商建议的 时限 和 计划。 维修检查 但 这些 should be provided 在 a 单独文件。

expanded.definitionEN: Those maintenance checks and inspections on the aircraft, its systems and units which are dictated by special or unusual conditions which are not related to the time limits specified in -10 above. Includes inspections and checks such as hard landing, overweight landing, bird strike, turbulent air, lightning strike, slush ingestion, radioactive contamination, maintenance checks prior to engine-out ferry, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 由特殊或异常情况决定、且与上述-10时限无关的飞机及其系统和部件维修检查和检验。包括检查 和 checks 例如 重着陆， 超重着陆， 鸟击， 颠簸气流， 雷击， 吸入融雪/雪浆， 放射性污染， 维修检查 prior 至 单发/失效发动机调机飞行， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Provides information relative to jack points, adapters, tail supports, balance weights, jacks and jacking procedures utilized during aircraft maintenance and repair.
expanded.definitionZH: Provides information 有关 顶升点， 适配器， 尾撑， 配重， 千斤顶 和 顶升程序 utilized during 飞机维修和修理。

expanded.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to support the aircraft during maintenance and repair. Includes information on shoring materials and equipment, contour dimensions, shoring locations, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 指为支撑飞机 during 维修和修理所必需的说明和程序。包括information 在 支撑材料 和 equipment， 外形尺寸， 支撑位置， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those units or components dedicated to the specific function of recording, storing or computing weight and balance data.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 装置 或 部件 dedicated 至 specific function 的 recording， storing 或 computing weight 和 balance 数据。

expanded.definitionEN: Provides information relative to those units or components dedicated to the specific function of leveling the aircraft.
expanded.definitionZH: Provides information 有关 这些 装置 或 部件 dedicated 至 specific function 的 leveling 飞机。

expanded.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to tow or push the aircraft in normal or other conditions such as towing with engines removed, etc. Shall include equipment and materials required such as towing vehicles, tow bars, towing cables, etc.; procedures to be used such as ground turning techniques, use of interphone and brakes, connection of electrical power, etc.; precautions and limitations such as use of landing gear and control surface locks, minimum turning radius, maximum towing and pushing loads on nose landing gear, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 指为tow 或 push 飞机 在 正常或其他情况 例如 towing 拆除发动机时， 等 应包括 equipment 和 materials 要求的 例如 牵引车， 牵引杆， 牵引索， 等； 程序 至 be used 例如 地面转弯技术， use 的 interphone 和 刹车， 接通电源， 等； 注意事项和限制 例如 use 的 起落架和操纵面锁， 最小转弯半径， maximum towing 和 pushing loads 在 前起落架， 等所必需的说明和程序。

expanded.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to taxi the aircraft in normal or abnormal conditions such as adverse weather conditions, etc. Shall include procedures to be used such as use of engines, interphone and brakes, ground turning techniques, etc.; precautions and limitations such as jet intake and exhaust danger areas, minimum turning radius, friction coefficients for various ground conditions, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 指为taxi 飞机 在 正常或非正常情况 例如 不利天气条件， 等 应包括 程序 至 be used 例如 use 的 engines， interphone 和 刹车， 地面转弯技术， 等； 注意事项和限制 例如 喷气进气和排气危险区， 最小转弯半径， 摩擦系数 用于 various 地面条件， 等所必需的说明和程序。

expanded.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to park or store the aircraft in normal or abnormal conditions such as with engines removed, or aircraft damaged for short or long terms. Shall include equipment and materials required such as landing gear and control surface locks, wheel chocks, blanking plugs and covers, cocooning materials, etc; procedures such as periodic engine running, control or drainage of fluid systems, static grounding, etc; precautions and limitations, such as landing gear strut pressures and wheel rotation, control of lifted equipment, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 指为park 或 储存 飞机 在 正常或非正常情况 例如 拆除发动机时， 或 飞机 damaged 用于 short 或 long terms所必需的说明和程序。应包括equipment 和 materials 要求的 例如 起落架和操纵面锁， 轮挡， 堵头和盖板， 封存材料， 等； 程序 例如 定期发动机运转， 控制 或 drainage 的 液体系统， 静电接地， 等； 注意事项和限制， 例如 起落架支柱压力 和 机轮转动， 控制 的 lifted equipment， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to moor or picket the aircraft in normal or abnormal conditions or with engines removed, etc.; for short or long terms in extremes of weather conditions. Shall include equipment and materials required such as wheel chocks, mooring blocks, mooring cables, etc.; procedures such as ballasting, etc.; precautions and limitations such as control in high wind conditions, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 指为moor 或 picket 飞机 在 正常或非正常情况 或 拆除发动机时， 等； 用于 short 或 long terms 在 extremes 的 weather 情况所必需的说明和程序。应包括equipment 和 materials 要求的 例如 轮挡， mooring blocks， 系留索， 等； 程序 例如 ballasting， 等； 注意事项和限制 例如 大风条件下的控制， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to prepare the aircraft for operation following mooring, parking, or a period of storage.
expanded.definitionZH: 指为prepare 飞机 用于 之后运行 mooring， parking， 或 a 存放期所必需的说明和程序。

expanded.definitionEN: This sub-system/section breakdown reserved for airline use.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 子系统/段/章节 breakdown reserved 用于 airline use。

expanded.definitionEN: Those placards and markings required for ground servicing instructions, inspections, cautions, warnings, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 placards 和 markings 要求的 用于 地面勤务 说明， 检查， 注意事项， 警告， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those placards, markings, self-illuminating signs, etc. required for interior general and emergency information, instructions, cautions, warnings, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 placards， markings， self-illuminating signs， 等 要求的 用于 interior 通用/概述 和 应急 information， 说明， 注意事项， 警告， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary for the replenishment of fuel, oil, hydraulic fluid, water, other fluids, tire pressure, etc. Tank and reservoir capacities in U.S., imperial and metric measure, shall be included. ANA or other standard specification number and grade (if applicable) of fuel, oil, fluid, and other material used shall be given. Specifications and grades should be shown grouped on one page to facilitate revisions. For fuel, give expansion volume, total fuel capacity, sump capacity, net fuel capacity (as applicable) for each tank. For oil, give allowance for expansion.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 说明 必要的 用于 replenishment 的 fuel， oil， 液压油， water， other fluids， 轮胎压力， 等 Tank 和 reservoir capacities 在 美制、英制和公制单位， shall be included。ANA 或 other 标准规范号和等级 (如果 applicable) 的 fuel， oil， fluid， 和 other material used shall be given。Specifications 和 grades should be shown grouped 在 one page 至 facilitate revisions。用于 fuel， give 膨胀容积， 燃油总容量， 集油槽容量， 净燃油容量 (作为 applicable) 用于 each tank。用于 oil， give 膨胀余量。

expanded.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to carry out servicing that may be scheduled. Includes instructions such as those for periodic lubrication of components, radioactivity decontamination, aircraft external and internal cleaning, disinfection of aircraft, sanitization of drinking water, etc. Shall not include lubrication procedures required for the accomplishment of maintenance practices.
expanded.definitionZH: 指为carry out servicing 该 may be 计划所必需的说明和程序。包括说明 例如 这些 用于 定期润滑 的 部件， radioactivity 去污， 飞机 外部和内部清洁， 消毒 的 飞机， 饮用水消毒， 等 Shall not include lubrication 程序 要求的 用于 accomplishment 的 维修施工。

expanded.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to carry out servicing that is normally unscheduled. Includes instructions such as those for ice and snow removal from parked aircraft, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 指为carry out servicing 该 is normally 非计划所必需的说明和程序。包括说明 例如 这些 用于 除冰除雪 从 停放飞机， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to monitor, measure, diagnose and locate sources of vibration in dynamic and structural components. The instructions shall cover related maintenance procedures such as main rotor tracking, tail rotor balancing, main rotor head absorber tuning/checking, general airframe vibration monitoring, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 指为monitor， measure， diagnose 和 locate sources 的 vibration 在 dynamic 和 结构的 部件所必需的说明和程序。说明 shall cover related 维修 程序 例如 主 旋翼 tracking， 尾桨 balancing， 主 旋翼桨毂 absorber tuning/checking， 通用/概述 机体 vibration 监控， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those instructions necessary to monitor, measure, diagnose and locate sources of noise in dynamic and structural components.
expanded.definitionZH: 指为monitor， measure， diagnose 和 locate sources 的 noise 在 dynamic 和 结构的 部件所必需的说明和程序。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system and its controls which supplies compressed air. Includes items such as controls and indicating systems related to the compressors, wiring, etc. Does not include the pressure control and indicating system for the cabin pressurization.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 和 其 控制装置 其 supplies compressed air。包括控制装置 和 指示系统 相关的 compressors， 导线/布线， 等 不包括 压力 控制 和 指示 系统 用于 cabin pressurization等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to induct and distribute air. Includes equipment rack cooling systems and items such as blowers, scoops, ducting, inlets, check valves, wiring, etc. Does not include valves which are part of pressurization and temperature control.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于induct 和 分配/输送 air的部分。包括equipment rack cooling 系统 和 items 例如 blowers， scoops， ducting， inlets， check 活门， 导线/布线， 等 不包括 活门 其 are part 的 pressurization 和 温度 控制。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to control the pressure within the fuselage. Includes items such as control valves, relief valves, indicators, switches, amplifiers, wiring, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制 压力 在。内 机身的部分。包括控制 活门， relief 活门， 指示器， 开关， 放大器， 导线/布线， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system and its controls which supply heated air. Includes items such as heater panels and other units, fuel system and control, ignition, indicating systems related to heater operation, wiring, etc. Does not include temperature control and indicating systems.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 和 其 控制装置 其 供给 heated air。包括heater panels 和 other 装置， 燃油系统 和 控制， 点火， 指示系统 相关的 heater 操作/工作， 导线/布线， 等 不包括 温度 控制 和 指示系统等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system and its controls which supply cooled air. Includes items such as the cooling unit, indicating systems related to the cooler operation, wiring, etc. Does not include temperature control and indicating systems.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 和 其 控制装置 其 供给 cooled air。包括cooling unit， 指示系统 相关的 cooler 操作/工作， 导线/布线， 等 不包括 温度 控制 和 指示系统等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to control the temperature of the air. Includes items such as control valves, thermal sensing devices, switches, indicators, amplifiers, wiring, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制 温度 的 air的部分。包括控制 活门， thermal sensing devices， 开关， 指示器， 放大器， 导线/布线， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to control moisture in the air, to control ozone concentrations, to filter radioactive debris from conditioned air, and to treat the air with deodorizers, insecticides, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制 moisture 在 air， 至 控制 ozone concentrations， 至 filter radioactive debris 从 conditioned air， 和 至 treat air 带有 deodorizers， insecticides， 等的部分。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system that uses radio/radar signals, directional and vertical references, air data pitot-static, computed flight path data, or manually induced inputs to the system to automatically control the flight path of the aircraft through adjustment to the pitch/roll/yaw axis or wing lift characteristics and provide visual cues for flight path guidance, i.e.: Integrated Flight Director. This includes power source devices, interlocking devices and amplifying, computing, integrating, controlling, actuating, indicating and warning devices such as computers, servos, control panels, indicators, warning lights, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 该 uses radio/radar signals， directional 和 vertical references， air 数据 pitot-static， computed flight path 数据， 或 manually induced inputs 至 系统 至 automatically 控制 flight path 的 飞机 through adjustment 至 pitch/roll/yaw axis 或 wing lift characteristics 和 provide visual cues 用于 flight path guidance， 即： 综合 飞行指引仪。该 包括 功率/动力 source devices， interlocking devices 和 amplifying， computing， integrating， controlling， actuating， 指示 和 warning devices 例如 计算机， servos， 控制面板， 指示器， 警告灯， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system that automatically maintains safe flight conditions by correcting for effects of speed and out-of-trim conditions by such means as automatic trim, mach trim or speed stability and mach feel. This includes sensing, computing, actuating, indicating, internal monitoring, and warning devices, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 该 automatically maintains safe flight 情况 由 correcting 用于 effects 的 速度 和 out-的-trim 情况 由 such means 作为 自动配平， 马赫配平 或 速度稳定性 和 马赫感力。该 包括 sensing， computing， actuating， 指示， 内部 监控， 和 warning devices， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system that automatically controls the position of the throttles to properly manage engine power during all phases of flight/attitude. This includes engaging, sensing, computing, amplifying, controlling, actuating and warning devices such as amplifiers, computers, servos, limit switches, clutches, gear boxes, warning lights, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 该 automatically 控制装置 position 的 throttles 至 properly manage 发动机 功率/动力 during 所有 phases 的 flight/姿态。该 包括 engaging， sensing， computing， amplifying， controlling， actuating 和 warning devices 例如 放大器， 计算机， servos， limit 开关， clutches， gear boxes， 警告灯， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That which provides separate or external monitoring/remote readout (for maintenance or other purposes) not directly related to the internal system monitoring (for system integrity flight crew warning). This includes sensing, computing, indicating and warning devices, control panels, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 用于提供 separate 或 外部 监控/remote readout (用于 维修 或 other purposes) not directly 相关的 内部 系统 监控 (用于 系统 integrity 飞行机组 warning)。该 包括 sensing， computing， 指示 和 warning devices， 控制面板， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: The system or portion of the system that automatically corrects/provides for gust loading/upset, aerodynamic augmentation/alleviation/suppression, ride control, etc. This includes sensing, computing, actuating, indicating internal monitoring, warning devices, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统 或 portion 的 系统 该 automatically corrects/provides 用于 gust loading/upset， aerodynamic augmentation/alleviation/suppression， ride 控制， 等 该 包括 sensing， computing， actuating， 指示 内部 监控， warning devices， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which utilizes voice modulated electromagnetic waves to transmit and/or receive messages from air to air, or air to ground installations. Includes H.F., V.H.F., U.H.F., etc., inflight telephone, communication transmitting & receiving equipment. Passenger air-to-ground communications now in [Chapter (System) 44-30]
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 utilizes voice modulated electromagnetic waves 至 transmit 和/或 receive messages 从 air 至 air， 或 air 至 ground installations。包括H。F， V。H。F， U。H。F， 等， inflight telephone， communication transmitting和receiving equipment。Passenger air-至-ground 通信 now 在 [Chapter (系统) 44-30]。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which utilizes satellite communication systems (SATCOM).
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 utilizes satellite communication 系统 (SATCOM)。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which presents information derived from pulse coded transmissions. Includes Teleprinter, Selcal, Calsel, ACARS, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 presents information derived 从 pulse coded transmissions。包括Teleprinter， Selcal， Calsel， ACARS， 等。

expanded.titleZH: 旅客广播、娱乐和舒适性
expanded.definitionEN: Available This sub-system now included in [Chapter (System) 44]
expanded.definitionZH: 可用；该 子系统 now included 在 [Chapter (系统) 44]。

expanded.definitionEN: Available Interphone now included in Chapters 23-50 (Cockpit) and 44-10 (Cabin)
expanded.definitionZH: 可用；Interphone now included 在 Chapters 23-50 (Cockpit) 和 44-10 (Cabin)。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which controls the output of the communications and navigation receivers into the flight crew headphones and speakers and the output of the flight crew microphones into the communications transmitters. Also includes the flight to ground personnel communications. Includes items such as audio selector control panel, micro-phones, headphones, cockpit loudspeakers, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制output 的 通信 和 导航 receivers into 飞行机组 headphones 和 speakers 和 output 的 飞行机组 microphones into 通信 传感/发送器的部分。还包括flight 至 地面人员 通信。包括audio selector 控制 panel， micro-phones， headphones， cockpit loudspeakers， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to dissipate static electricity.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于dissipate static electricity的部分。

expanded.definitionEN: Those installations that record, or monitor crew conversation or movement, or provide external monitoring, for security or safety purposes. Includes externally mounted cameras, voice and/or video recorders, etc., used for aircraft operations.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 installations 该 record， 或 monitor 机组 conversation 或 movement， 或 provide 外部 监控， 用于 security 或 safety purposes。包括externally mounted cameras， voice 和/或 视频记录器， 等， used 用于 飞机 运行/操作。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which maintains integrated control of the operating frequencies of communication and navigation transmitter/receivers after either a manually inserted command or a preprogrammed integrated flight system command. Includes such items as integrated frequency selector panels, digital frequency control computers, integrated frequency display panels, etc
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 maintains 综合 控制 的 operating frequencies 的 communication 和 导航 transmitter/receivers after either a manually inserted command 或 a preprogrammed 综合 flight 系统 command。包括综合 frequency selector panels， 数字 frequency 控制 计算机， 综合 frequency display panels， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Mechanical devices that drive the generators at a desired RPM. Includes items such as oil system, connecting devices, indicating and warning systems for the drive, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 用于drive generators at a desired RPM的机械装置。包括滑油系统， connecting devices， 指示 和 警告系统 用于 drive， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the systems used to generate, regulate, control, and indicate AC electrical power. Includes items such as inverters, AC generators/ alternators, control and regulating components, indicating systems, etc., all wiring to but not including main busses.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于产生， 调节， 控制， 和 指示 交流电源的部分。包括inverters， AC generators/ alternators， 控制 和 regulating 部件， 指示系统， 等， 所有 导线/布线 至 但 not including 主汇流条等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the systems used to generate, regulate, control and indicate DC electrical power. Includes items such as generators/ alternators, transformers, rectifiers, batteries, control and regulating components, indicating systems, etc., all wiring to but not including main busses.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于产生， 调节， 控制 和 指示 直流电源的部分。包括generators/ alternators， transformers， rectifiers， batteries， 控制 和 regulating 部件， 指示系统， 等， 所有 导线/布线 至 但 not including 主汇流条等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system within the aircraft which connects external electrical power to the aircraft's electrical system. Includes items such as receptacles, relays, switches, wiring, warning lights, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 在。内 飞机 其 connects 外部 电源 至 飞机's electrical 系统。包括receptacles， 继电器， 开关， 导线/布线， 警告灯， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which provides for connection of AC power to using systems. Includes items such as AC main and secondary busses, main system circuit breakers, power system devices, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供用于 connection 的 交流电源 至 using 系统的部分。包括AC 主 和 二级汇流条， 主 系统 断路器， 功率/动力 系统 devices， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which provides for connection of DC power to using systems. Includes items such as DC main and secondary busses, main system circuit breakers, power system devices, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供用于 connection 的 直流电源 至 using 系统的部分。包括DC 主 和 二级汇流条， 主 系统 断路器， 功率/动力 系统 devices， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: The compartment above the floor and between the forward passenger partition and the forward pressure dome. Includes items such as flight crew seats, tables, pilot check lists and food containers, wardrobes, curtains, manuals, electronic equipment rack, spare bulbs, fuses, etc. Does not include cargo compartments.
expanded.definitionZH: compartment 上述 floor 和 between forward passenger partition 和 forward 增压隔框。包括飞行机组 seats， tables， pilot check lists 和 food containers， wardrobes， curtains， manuals， electronic equipment rack， spare bulbs， fuses， 等 不包括 cargo compartments等。

expanded.definitionEN: The areas in which the passengers are seated. Includes lounges but not dressing rooms. Includes items such as seats, berths, overhead storage compartments, curtains, wall coverings, carpets, magazine racks, wardrobes, movable partitions, wall-type thermometers, spare bulbs, fuses, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: areas 在 其 旅客 are seated。包括lounges 但 not dressing rooms。包括seats， berths， overhead storage compartments， curtains， wall coverings， carpets， magazine racks， wardrobes， movable partitions， wall-type thermometers， spare bulbs， fuses， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: The areas in which food and beverages are stored and prepared. Includes items such as removable and fixed cabinets, ovens, refrigerators, garbage containers, dish racks, coffee maker and dispensers, containers, electrical outlets, wiring, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: areas 在 其 food 和 beverages are 储存 和 prepared。包括removable 和 fixed cabinets， ovens， refrigerators， garbage containers， dish racks， coffee maker 和 dispensers， containers， electrical outlets， 导线/布线， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: The toilet and dressing room areas containing wash basins, dressing tables, and water closet. Includes items such as mirrors, seats, cabinets, dispensing equipment, electrical outlets, wiring, etc. Wash basins and water closets are included in [Chapter (System) 38].
expanded.definitionZH: 厕所 和 dressing room areas containing wash basins， dressing tables， 和 water closet。包括mirrors， seats， cabinets， dispensing equipment， electrical outlets， 导线/布线， 等 Wash basins 和 water closets are included 在 [Chapter (系统) 38]等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those additional compartments for the use of passengers and/or crew. Includes such compartments as crew rest compartments, sleeping compartments etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 additional compartments 用于 use 的 旅客 和/或 机组。包括such compartments 作为 机组 rest compartments， sleeping compartments 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those items of equipment carried for use in emergency procedures.
