Includes items such as evacuation equipment, life rafts, jackets, emergency locator transmitters, underwater locator devices, first aid kit, incubators, oxygen tents, medical stretchers, landing and signal flares, drag parachutes, evacuation signaling systems, etc. Does not include fire extinguishers, oxygen equipment or masks.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 items 的 equipment carried 用于 应急 程序。包括撤离设备， 救生筏， jackets， 应急定位发射机， 水下定位装置， 急救包， incubators， 氧气 tents， medical stretchers， landing 和 signal flares， drag parachutes， evacuation signaling 系统， 等 不包括 灭火器， 氧气 equipment 或 masks等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those insulation blankets which are used for heat and sound insulation. Includes flight compartments, passenger compartment and additional compartment insulation, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 insulation blankets 其 are used 用于 heat 和 sound insulation。包括flight compartments， 客舱 和 additional compartment insulation， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to sense and indicate the presence of overheat, smoke, or fire.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于sense 和 指示 presence 的 过热， 烟雾， 或 火警/火的部分。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of those fixed or portable systems which is used to extinguish fire.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 这些 fixed 或 便携式 系统 用于 extinguish 火警/火。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to sense, indicate and extinguish a flame propagating into the fuel vent or scoop to prevent an explosion in the fuel system.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于sense， 指示 和 extinguish a 火焰 propagating into fuel vent 或 scoop 至 防止 an explosion 在 燃油系统的部分。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the systems which controls the position and movement of the ailerons/elevons and tabs. Includes items such as the control wheels, cables, boosters, linkages, control surfaces, indicators, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制position 和 movement 的 ailerons/升降副翼 和 调整片的部分。包括控制 机轮， 钢索/电缆， boosters， 连杆机构， 操纵面， 指示器， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the systems which controls the position and movement of the rudder and rudder tabs. Includes items such as the rudder pedals, tab control wheel, cables, boosters, linkages, control surfaces, position indicators, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制position 和 movement 的 方向舵 和 方向舵 调整片的部分。包括方向舵 pedals， tab 控制 wheel， 钢索/电缆， boosters， 连杆机构， 操纵面， 位置指示器， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the systems which controls the position and movement of the elevator/elevon and tabs. Includes items such as the control column, stickshaker units, automatic stall recovery devices, tab control wheels, cables, boosters, linkages, control surfaces, position indicators, stall warning systems, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制position 和 movement 的 升降舵/elevon 和 调整片的部分。包括控制 column， stickshaker 装置， 自动 stall recovery devices， tab 控制 机轮， 钢索/电缆， boosters， 连杆机构， 操纵面， 位置指示器， stall 警告系统， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which controls the position and movement of the horizontal stabilizer/canard. Includes items such as control handle, cables, jackscrews, motors, warning systems, linkages, control surfaces, position indicators, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制position 和 movement 的 水平安定面/canard的部分。包括控制 handle， 钢索/电缆， jackscrews， motors， 警告系统， 连杆机构， 操纵面， 位置指示器， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the systems which controls the position and movement of the trailing edge flaps. Includes items such as control handles, cables, actuators, warning systems, linkages, control surfaces, position indicators, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制position 和 movement 的 后缘 襟翼的部分。包括控制 handles， 钢索/电缆， 作动器， 警告系统， 连杆机构， 操纵面， 位置指示器， 等。

expanded.titleEN: Spoiler, Drag Devices and Variable Aerodynamic Fairings
expanded.titleZH: 扰流板、阻力装置和可变气动整流罩
expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the systems which controls the position and movement of the spoilers, drag devices and variable aerodynamic fairings. Includes fairings. Includes items such as control handles, cables, warning systems, linkages, spoilers, drag devices, position indicators, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制position 和 movement 的 扰流板， drag devices 和 variable aerodynamic 整流罩的部分。包括整流罩。包括控制 handles， 钢索/电缆， 警告系统， 连杆机构， 扰流板， drag devices， 位置指示器， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the systems which protects the control surfaces from movement by wind while the aircraft is on the ground. Does not include locking the control by means of flight control boost system.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 protects 操纵面 从 movement 由 wind while 飞机 is 在 ground。不包括locking 控制 由 means 的 flight 控制 boost 系统。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the systems which controls the position and movement of variable opening wings slots, leading edge wing flaps, and other similar auxiliary devices used for increasing aerodynamic lift. Includes items such as control handles, cables, actuators, linkages, warning systems, control surfaces, position indicators, etc. Does not include trailing edge flaps.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制position 和 movement 的 variable opening 机翼 slots， 前缘 wing 襟翼， 和 other similar 辅助 devices used 用于 increasing aerodynamic lift的部分。包括控制 handles， 钢索/电缆， 作动器， 连杆机构， 警告系统， 操纵面， 位置指示器， 等 不包括 后缘 襟翼等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which stores fuel. Includes tank sealing, bladder type cells, ventilating system, cell and tank inter-connectors, over wing filler necks and caps, etc. Also includes reservoir feed pumping systems and reservoirs within the tanks which are not part of the distribution system.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 stores fuel。包括tank sealing， bladder type cells， ventilating 系统， cell 和 tank inter-connectors， over wing filler necks 和 caps， 等 Also 包括 reservoir feed pumping 系统 和 reservoirs 在。内 tanks 其 are not part 的 分配 系统。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to distribute fuel from the filler connector to the storage system and from the storage system to and including the power plant fuel quick disconnect. Includes items such as plumbing, pumps, valves, controls, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于分配/输送 fuel 从 filler connector 至 storage 系统 和 从 storage 系统 至 和 including 动力装置 燃油快卸接头的部分。包括管路， pumps， 活门， 控制装置， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to dump fuel overboard during flight. Includes items such as plumbing, valves, controls, chutes, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于dump fuel overboard during flight的部分。包括管路， 活门， 控制装置， chutes， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to indicate the quantity, temperature, and pressure of the fuel. Includes pressure warning systems for pumping systems within the tank, etc. Does not include engine fuel flow or pressure.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示fuel的数量、温度和压力的部分。包括压力警告系统 用于 pumping 系统 在。内 tank， 等 不包括 发动机燃油流量 或 压力。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to store and deliver hydraulic fluid to using systems. Includes items such as tanks, accumulators, valves, pumps, levers, switches, cables, plumbing, wiring, external connectors, etc. Does not include the supply valves to the using systems.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于储存 和 输送 液压油 至 using 系统的部分。包括tanks， accumulators， 活门， pumps， 手柄/杆， 开关， 钢索/电缆， 管路， 导线/布线， 外部 connectors， 等 不包括 供给 活门 至 using 系统等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is classified as auxiliary, emergency or standby, and which is used to supplement or take the place of the main hydraulic system. Includes items such as tanks and accumulators which are separate from the main system, hand pumps, auxiliary pumps, valves, plumbing, wiring, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 is classified 作为 辅助， 应急 或 备用， 和 用于 supplement 或 take place 的 主 hydraulic 系统。包括tanks 和 accumulators 其 are separate 从 主 系统， hand pumps， 辅助 pumps， 活门， 管路， 导线/布线， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to indicate the quantity, temperature and pressure of the hydraulic fluid. Includes items such as transmitters, indicators, wiring, warning systems, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示液压油的数量、温度和压力的部分。包括传感/发送器， 指示器， 导线/布线， 警告系统， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on all airfoil surfaces. Includes wings, airfoil sections of the empennage, and pylons.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于消除或防止所有翼面结冰的部分。包括机翼， 翼面部分 的 尾翼， 和 吊挂。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice in or around air intakes. Includes power plant cowling anti-icing.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于消除或防止进气道内或周围结冰的部分。包括动力装置 发动机罩/整流罩 anti-icing。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on the pitot and static systems.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于消除或防止皮托和静压 系统结冰的部分。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice, frost or rain on the Windows, windshields and doors.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于消除 或 防止 结冰， 霜 或 雨水 在 窗， 风挡 和 门的部分。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on antennas and radomes.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于消除或防止天线 和 雷达罩结冰的部分。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on propellers or rotors. Includes all components up to but not including rotating assembly.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于消除或防止螺旋桨 或 旋翼结冰的部分。包括所有 部件 直到但不包括 旋转组件。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to prevent the formation of ice in water supply and drain lines.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于防止供水和排水管路结冰的部分。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to detect and indicate the formation of ice.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于探测和指示结冰的部分。

expanded.definitionEN: Coverage of all panels fixed or movable with their replaceable components such as instruments, switches, circuit breakers, fuses, etc. Also includes general coverage of instrument panel vibrators and other panel accessories.
expanded.definitionZH: 涵盖所有 panels fixed 或 movable 带有 their replaceable 部件 例如 instruments， 开关， 断路器， fuses， 等 Also 包括 通用/概述 coverage 的 instrument panel vibrators 和 other panel accessories。

expanded.definitionEN: Those instruments, units and components which are not related to specific systems. Includes items such as inclinometers, clocks, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 instruments， 装置 和 部件 其 are 不属于 specific 系统。包括inclinometers， clocks， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those systems and components used for recording data not related to specific systems. Includes items such as flight recorders, performance or maintenance recorders, VG recorders, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 系统 和 部件 used 用于 recording 数据 不属于 specific 系统。包括飞行记录器， performance 或 维修记录器， VG recorders， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those systems and components used for computing data from a number of different sources without a preponderance of functions in any one system. Includes items such as Digital Core Avionic System (DCAS), stored check list, emergency procedures, company regulations, etc., for call up on a display, integrated instrument systems such as engine, airplane power and central warning indicators when combined into a central display.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 系统 和 部件 used 用于 computing 数据 从 a 数量 different sources without a preponderance 的 functions 在 any one 系统。包括数字 Core Avionic 系统 (DCAS)， 储存 check list， 应急 程序， company regulations， 等， 用于 call up 在 a display， 综合 instrument 系统 例如 发动机， 飞机 功率/动力 和 central warning 指示器 when combined into a central display等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those systems and components which give audible or visual warning of conditions in unrelated systems. Includes items such as master warning or flight warning systems, central instrument warning, or caution and warning systems, tone generators, annunciators, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 系统 和 部件 其 give audible 或 visual warning 的 情况 在 unrelated 系统。包括master warning 或 flight 警告系统， central instrument warning， 或 caution 和 警告系统， tone generators， annunciators， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those systems and components which give visual display of conditions in unrelated systems.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 系统 和 部件 其 give visual display 的 情况 在 unrelated 系统。

expanded.definitionEN: Those systems and components used for collating and computing data from unrelated systems and transmitting same automatically. Includes ASDAR systems and components.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 系统 和 部件 used 用于 collating 和 computing 数据 从 unrelated 系统 和 transmitting same automatically。包括ASDAR 系统 和 部件。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which provides the major support for the aircraft while on the ground. Includes items such as shock struts, bogie axles, drag struts, doors, linkages, attach bolts, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供major support 用于 飞机 while 在 ground的部分。包括减震支柱， 小车架轴， 阻力撑杆， 门， 连杆机构， attach bolts， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which supports the nose of the aircraft while the aircraft is on the ground. Includes items such as shock struts, drag struts, doors, linkages, attach bolts, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 supports nose 的 飞机 while 飞机 is 在 ground。包括减震支柱， 阻力撑杆， 门， 连杆机构， attach bolts， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to extend and retract the landing gear and open and close the landing gear doors. Includes items such as actuating mechanisms, bogie trim, bungees, up and down latches, operating controls, valves and motors, cables, wiring, plumbing, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于extend 和 retract 起落架 和 open 和 close 起落架舱门的部分。包括actuating mechanisms， bogie trim， bungees， up 和 down latches， operating 控制装置， 活门 和 motors， 钢索/电缆， 导线/布线， 管路， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which provides for rolling and stopping the aircraft while on the ground and stopping wheel rotation after retraction. Includes items such as bearings, tires, valves, de-boosters, swivel glands, anti-skid devices, pressure indicators, plumbing, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供用于 rolling 和 stopping 飞机 while 在 ground 和 stopping 机轮转动 after retraction的部分。包括bearings， 轮胎， 活门， de-boosters， swivel glands， anti-skid devices， 压力 指示器， 管路， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to control the direction of movement of the aircraft on the ground. Includes items such as actuating cylinders, controls, bogie swivel unlock, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制 方向 的 movement 的 飞机 在 ground的部分。包括actuating cylinders， 控制装置， bogie swivel unlock， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to indicate and warn of the position of the landing gear/doors. Includes items such as switches, relays, lights, indicators, horns, wiring, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示 和 warn 的 position 的 起落架/门的部分。包括开关， 继电器， 灯， 指示器， 喇叭， 导线/布线， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Devices used to stabilize the aircraft while on the ground and prevent damage by ground contact. Includes items such as shock strut, skid block, wheels, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: Devices 用于 stabilize 飞机 while 在 ground 和 防止 damage 由 ground contact。包括shock strut， skid block， 机轮， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: The lighting sub-systems in the compartment above the floor and between the forward passenger partition and the forward pressure dome. Does not include cargo compartment. Includes direct and indirect illumination of work areas, panels, and instruments. Includes master warning light and warning light dimming systems, where not integrated with a central audio or visual system under 31-50.
expanded.definitionZH: lighting sub-系统 在 compartment 上述 floor 和 between forward passenger partition 和 forward 增压隔框。不包括货舱。包括direct 和 indirect illumination 的 work areas， panels， 和 instruments。包括master warning light 和 warning light dimming 系统， 其中 not 综合 带有 a central audio 或 visual 系统 under 31-50。

expanded.definitionEN: The lighting sub-systems in the areas in which the passengers are seated and in buffet/galley, lavatories, lounges and coat rooms. Includes items such as direct and indirect illumination, passenger call system, lighted signs, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: lighting sub-系统 在 areas 在 其 旅客 are seated 和 在 buffet/厨房， lavatories， lounges 和 coat rooms。包括direct 和 indirect illumination， passenger call 系统， lighted signs， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: The lighting sub-systems in the compartments for stowage of cargo and the housing of various components of accessories.
expanded.definitionZH: lighting sub-系统 在 compartments 用于 stowage 的 cargo 和 housing 的 various 部件 的 accessories。

expanded.definitionEN: The lighting sub-systems used to provide illumination outside of the aircraft. Includes lights such as landing, navigation, position indicating, wing illumination, rotating, courtesy, taxi, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: lighting sub-系统 用于 provide illumination outside 的 飞机。包括灯 例如 landing， 导航， position 指示， wing illumination， rotating， courtesy， taxi， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: The separate and independent sub-system used to provide illumination in case of primary electrical power failure. Includes items such as inertia flashlights, lanterns, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: separate 和 独立 子系统 用于 provide illumination 在 case 的 primary 电源 failure。包括inertia flashlights， lanterns， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which senses environmental conditions and uses the data to influence navigation. Includes such items as Central Air Data Computers, pitot/static systems, air temperature, rate-of-climb, airspeed, high speed warning, altitude, altitude reporting, altimeter correction system, air disturbance detection system, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 senses environmental 情况 和 uses 数据 至 influence 导航。包括中央大气数据计算机， 皮托/静压 系统， air 温度， rate-的-climb， airspeed， high 速度 warning， 高度， 高度 reporting， altimeter correction 系统， air disturbance detection 系统， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: The portion of the system which uses magnetic or inertia forces to sense and display the direction or attitude of the aircraft. This includes sensing, computing, indicating and warning devices such as magnetic compasses, vertical and directional references, magnetic heading systems, attitude director systems, symbol generators, turn and bank, rate of turn, amplifiers, indicators, etc. Includes Flight Director when it is not integral with the auto pilot computation.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中使用magnetic 或 inertia forces 至 sense 和 display 方向 或 姿态 的 飞机的部分。该 包括 sensing， computing， 指示 和 warning devices 例如 magnetic compasses， vertical 和 directional references， magnetic 航向 系统， 姿态指引系统， symbol generators， turn 和 bank， rate 的 turn， 放大器， 指示器， 等 包括 飞行指引仪 when it is not integral 带有 auto pilot computation。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which provides guidance during approach, landing and taxiing. Includes items such as localizer, glide slope, ILS, markers, paravisual director ground guidance systems, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供guidance during approach， landing 和 taxiing的部分。包括localizer， glide slope， ILS， markers， paravisual director ground guidance 系统， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which provides information to determine position and is mainly independent of ground installations or orbital satellites. Includes items such as inertial guidance systems, weather radar, doppler, proximity warning, collision avoidance, star tracker, etc. Also includes sextants/octants, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供information 至 determine position 和 is mainly 独立 的 ground installations 或 orbital satellites的部分。包括inertial guidance 系统， weather radar， doppler， proximity warning， collision avoidance， star tracker， 等 Also 包括 sextants/octants， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which provides information to determine position and is mainly dependent on ground installations or orbital satellites. Includes items such as DME, transponders, radio compass, LORAN, VOR, ADF, OMEGA, GLOBAL POSITIONING, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供information 至 determine position 和 is mainly 依赖式 在 ground installations 或 orbital satellites的部分。包括DME， transponders， radio compass， LORAN， VOR， ADF， OMEGA， GLOBAL POSITIONING， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which combines navigational data to compute or manage the aircraft's geographical position or theoretical flight path. Includes items such as course computers, flight management computers, performance data computers, and associated control display units, warning annunciators, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 combines navigational 数据 至 compute 或 manage 飞机's geographical position 或 theoretical flight path。包括course 计算机， flight management 计算机， performance 数据 计算机， 和 associated 控制 显示组件， warning annunciators， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which furnishes oxygen to the crew.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供氧气 至 机组的部分。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which furnishes oxygen to the passengers.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供氧气 至 旅客的部分。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which has an independent oxygen supply and which can be transported about the airplane.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 has an 独立 氧气 供给 和 其 can be transported about 飞机。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to distribute high or low pressure air to using systems. Includes items such as ducts, valves, actuators, heat exchangers, controls, etc. Does not include the supply valves to the using systems.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于分配/输送 high 或 low 压力 air 至 using 系统的部分。包括管道， 活门， 作动器， heat exchangers， 控制装置， 等 不包括 供给 活门 至 using 系统等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to indicate temperature and pressure of the pneumatic system. Includes temperature and pressure warning systems.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示 温度和压力 的 pneumatic 系统的部分。包括温度和压力 警告系统。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to distribute negative pressure air to using systems.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于分配/输送 negative 压力 air 至 using 系统的部分。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to indicate pressure. Includes pressure warning system.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示 压力的部分。包括压力 warning 系统。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to store and deliver fresh drinking water. Includes wash water system if the potable water is also used for washing.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于储存 和 输送 饮用水的部分。包括洗涤水 系统 如果 potable water is also used 用于 washing。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to store and deliver wash water which is not potable.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于储存 和 输送 洗涤水 其 is not potable的部分。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used for disposal of water and waste. Includes items such as wash basins, water closets, flushing systems, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 is used 用于 disposal 的 water 和 废水/污物。包括wash basins， water closets， flushing 系统， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system common to more than one sub-system which is used for pressurizing supply tanks to insure fluid flow.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 common 至 more than one 子系统 其 is used 用于 pressurizing 供给 tanks 至 insure fluid flow。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which stores water solely for the purpose of providing airship ballast. Includes removable tanks (bladder cells), interconnecting balance pipes, filler valves, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 stores water solely 用于 providing airship ballast。包括removable tanks (bladder cells)， interconnecting balance pipes， filler 活门， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to dump water ballast during flight. Includes valves, remote/direct, manual/automatic controls, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于dump 水压载 during flight的部分。包括活门， remote/direct， 手册/自动 控制装置， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to indicate quantity, condition and relative distribution of the water ballast.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示 数量、状态和相对分布 的 水压载的部分。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to accomplish the integrated functional control, operation, testing and monitoring of cabin systems and to increase cabin comfort (such as active noise control). Includes items such as controllers, cabin control panels, handsets, signs, loudspeakers, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于accomplish 综合 functional 控制， 操作/工作， 测试 和 监控 的 cabin 系统 和 至 increase cabin comfort (例如 active noise 控制)的部分。包括controllers， cabin 控制面板， handsets， signs， loudspeakers， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to entertain the passengers with music, video, information,, games, etc. Includes items such as controllers, cabin control panels, audio and video equipment, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于entertain 旅客 带有 music， video， information，， games， 等 包括 controllers， cabin 控制面板， audio 和 video equipment， 等的部分。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system used by System passengers and cabin crew to transmit and/or receive data/messages from air to air or from air to ground installations. Includes items such as telephones, telefaxes, modems, AM/FM radio units, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 used 由 系统 旅客 和 客舱机组 至 transmit 和/或 receive 数据/messages 从 air 至 air 或 从 air 至 ground installations。包括telephones， telefaxes， modems， AM/FM radio 装置， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to store and process cabin related data, such as systems configuration data, multimedia programs, etc. Includes items such as controllers, terminals, keyboards, disk drives, printers, modems, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于储存 和 process cabin related 数据， 例如 系统 configuration 数据， multimedia programs， 等 包括 controllers， terminals， keyboards， disk drives， printers， modems， 等的部分。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to monitor parts of the cabin area. Includes items such as surveillance cameras, monitors, etc. Does not include external anti-hijack devices or external video monitoring which are covered in [Chapter (System) 23].
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于monitor parts 的 cabin area的部分。包括surveillance cameras， monitors， 等 不包括 外部 anti-hijack devices 或 外部 video 监控 其 are covered 在 [Chapter (系统) 23]等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to support miscellaneous cabin functions.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于support miscellaneous cabin functions的部分。

expanded.definitionEN: Those compartments for storage of cargo.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 compartments 用于 storage 的 cargo。

expanded.definitionEN: Those systems which have components which are or can be mounted on the aircraft and used to load/unload, restrain, guide or service cargo. Includes drive systems, rollers, latches, restraint nets etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 系统 其 have 部件 其 are 或 can be mounted 在 飞机 和 用于 load/unload， restrain， guide 或 service cargo。包括drive 系统， rollers， latches， restraint nets 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those systems which are related to loading/unloading of cargo. Includes aircraft levelling, loader alignment systems etc. Does not include Cargo Loading Systems.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 系统 其 are 相关的 loading/unloading 的 cargo。包括飞机 levelling， loader alignment 系统 等 不包括 Cargo Loading 系统。

expanded.definitionEN: Those compartments used for the housing of various components and accessories. Includes wheel wells, tail-hydraulic-electrical/electronic equipment racks, main battery structure etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 compartments used 用于 housing 的 various 部件 和 accessories。包括wheel wells， tail-hydraulic-electrical/electronic equipment racks， 主 battery 结构 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those insulation blankets which are used for heat and sound insulation. Includes cargo compartments and accessory compartments, insulation, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 insulation blankets 其 are used 用于 heat 和 sound insulation。包括cargo compartments 和 accessory compartments， insulation， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Airplane major structural breakdown diagram. Primary and secondary structure diagram. Principal area and dimensional data. Restricted area diagram. Zoning diagram. Access door and panel identification. Glossary.

expanded.definitionEN: Definition of damage classifications. Cleanup of dents, cracks, scratches, corrosion, etc. Aerodynamic smoothness requirements for the airplane, and permissible contour variations, gaps, and mis-match data.
expanded.definitionZH: Definition 的 damage classifications。Cleanup 的 dents， cracks， scratches， corrosion， 等 Aerodynamic smoothness requirements 用于 飞机， 和 permissible contour variations， gaps， 和 mis-match 数据。

expanded.definitionEN: Special processes for use in the repair of the airplane. Will not include general engineering practices unless specific deviations are required. Unique processes such as welding specifications, etc., relative to a single repair shall be incorporated in the repair and only referenced here.
expanded.definitionZH: Special processes 用于 repair 的 飞机。Will not include 通用/概述 engineering practices unless specific deviations are 要求的。Unique processes 例如 welding specifications， 等， 有关 a single repair shall be incorporated 在 repair 和 only referenced here。

expanded.definitionEN: Description of materials (metallic and non-metallic) including extrusions, formed sections, sheet, sealants, adhesives, and special materials used in airplane repair. Where possible, permissible substitutes and sources of supply will be given.
expanded.definitionZH: 对materials (metallic 和 non-metallic) including extrusions， formed sections， sheet， sealants， adhesives， 和 special materials used 在 飞机 repair的说明。其中 possible， permissible substitutes 和 sources 的 供给 will be given。

expanded.definitionEN: Description of fastener types, materials, and sizes. Procedures for fastener installation and removal including hole preparation. Fastener strength values and substitution data.
expanded.definitionZH: 对fastener types， materials， 和 sizes的说明。用于fastener installation 和 removal including hole preparation的程序。Fastener strength values 和 substitution 数据。

expanded.titleEN: Support of Airplane for Repair and Alignment Check Procedures
expanded.titleZH: 维修支撑和对准检查程序
expanded.definitionEN: Procedure for supporting the airplane to relieve loads during repairs. Includes locations for supports and contour dimensions for required ground equipment.
expanded.definitionZH: 用于supporting 飞机 至 relieve loads during repairs的程序。包括locations 用于 supports 和 外形尺寸 用于 要求的 ground equipment。

expanded.definitionEN: Procedures for adjusting the mass balance of control surfaces after repair. Where applicable, individual repairs will contain their own balancing instructions.
expanded.definitionZH: 用于adjusting mass balance 的 操纵面 after repair的程序。其中 applicable， 单独的 repairs will contain their own balancing 说明。

expanded.definitionEN: Typical repairs suitable for general use, not limited to one ATA Chapter.
expanded.definitionZH: Typical repairs suitable 用于 通用/概述 use， not limited 至 one ATA Chapter。

expanded.definitionEN: Topics concerning the electrical bonding of aircraft structure as well as electrical bonding of subsystems to aircraft structure.
expanded.definitionZH: 关于electrical bonding 的 飞机 结构 作为 well 作为 electrical bonding 的 子系统 至 飞机 结构的主题。

expanded.definitionEN: Doors used for entrance and exit of the passengers and crew to and from the aircraft. Includes items such as structure, latching mechanisms, locking units, handles, insulation, lining, controls, integral steps, ramps, handrails, attach/attached fittings, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 门 used 用于 entrance 和 exit 的 旅客 和 机组 至 和 从 飞机。包括结构， latching mechanisms， locking 装置， handles， insulation， lining， 控制装置， integral steps， ramps， handrails， 连接接头， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Exit doors used to facilitate evacuation that are not normally used for exit. Includes items such as structure, latching mechanisms, locking units, handles, insulation, lining, controls, attach/attached fittings, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: Exit 门 用于 facilitate evacuation 该 are not normally used 用于 exit。包括结构， latching mechanisms， locking 装置， handles， insulation， lining， 控制装置， 连接接头， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Exterior doors used primarily to gain access to cargo compartments. Includes items such as structure, latching mechanisms, motors, handles, insulation, lining, controls, integral steps, ramps, handrails, attach/attached fittings, etc.

expanded.definitionEN: Exterior doors used primarily to gain access for servicing aircraft systems and equipment and miscellaneous exterior doors used to fulfill system functions. Includes items such as structure, latching mechanisms, handles, insulation, lining, controls, integral steps, handrails, attach/attached fittings, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: Exterior 门 used primarily 至 gain access 用于 servicing 飞机 系统 和 equipment 和 miscellaneous exterior 门 用于 fulfill 系统 functions。包括结构， latching mechanisms， handles， insulation， lining， 控制装置， integral steps， handrails， 连接接头， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Doors inside the fuselage installed in fixed partitions. Includes items such as structure, latching mechanisms, handles, lining, attach/attached fittings, etc. Does not include doors installed in movable partitions which are covered in [Chapter (System) 25].
expanded.definitionZH: 门 inside 机身 installed 在 fixed partitions。包括结构， latching mechanisms， handles， lining， 连接接头， 等 不包括 门 installed 在 movable partitions 其 are covered 在 [Chapter (系统) 25]等。

expanded.definitionEN: Stairs which operate in conjunction with but are not an integral part of entrance doors. Stairs whose primary structure is a door shall be covered under the appropriate topic. Includes items such as structure, actuating mechanisms and controls, handrails, attach/attached fittings, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: Stairs 其 operate 在 conjunction 带有 但 are not an integral part 的 entrance 门。Stairs whose primary 结构 is a door shall be covered under appropriate topic。包括结构， actuating mechanisms 和 控制装置， handrails， 连接接头， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used for the powered operation of the doors and/or to indicate whether the doors are closed and properly latched. Includes items such as as motors, computers, sensors, switches, lights, bells, horns, etc. Does not include landing gear door warning which is covered in [Chapter (System) 32].

expanded.definitionEN: Structure of the doors used to enclose the landing gear compartments. Includes items such as structure, latching mechanisms, handles, insulation, lining, controls, attach/attached fittings, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 结构 的 门 用于 enclose 起落架 compartments。包括结构， latching mechanisms， handles， insulation， lining， 控制装置， 连接接头， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: The horizontal airfoil of the tail or nose section to which the elevator is attached. Includes items such as spars, ribs, stringers, skins, access covers, tips, attach/attached fittings, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: horizontal airfoil 的 tail 或 nose 段/章节 至 其 升降舵 is attached。包括梁， 肋， 桁条， 蒙皮， access 盖板， tips， 连接接头， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Removable airfoil which is attached to the horizontal stabilizer or canard and used for pitch control. Includes items such as spars, ribs, stringers, skins, access covers, tabs, balance devices, attach/ attached fittings, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 可拆卸翼面，is attached 至 水平安定面 或 canard 和 used 用于 pitch 控制。包括梁， 肋， 桁条， 蒙皮， access 盖板， 调整片， balance devices， attach/ attached 接头/支架， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Vertical airfoil to which the rudder is attached. Includes items such as spars, ribs, stringers, skins, access covers, tips, attach/attached fittings, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: Vertical airfoil 至 其 方向舵 is attached。包括梁， 肋， 桁条， 蒙皮， access 盖板， tips， 连接接头， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Removable airfoil which is attached to the vertical stabilizer and used for yaw control. Includes items such as spars, ribs, stringers, skins, access covers, tabs, balance devices, attach/attached fittings, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 可拆卸翼面，is attached 至 垂直安定面 和 used 用于 偏航控制。包括梁， 肋， 桁条， 蒙皮， access 盖板， 调整片， balance devices， 连接接头， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Compartment above the floor and between the forward passenger partition and the forward pressure dome. Includes items such as the transparent material and its frame of sliding and fixed windows and windshields, handles, latching mechanisms, etc. Does not include door or inspection/observation windows.
expanded.definitionZH: Compartment 上述 floor 和 between forward passenger partition 和 forward 增压隔框。包括transparent material 和 其 frame 的 sliding 和 fixed 窗 和 风挡， handles， latching mechanisms， 等 不包括 door 或 检查/observation 窗等。

expanded.definitionEN: Area in which the passengers are seated. Includes lounges, lavatories, buffets/galleys and coatrooms. Includes items such as transparent material, its frame, frost shield, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: Area 在 其 旅客 are seated。包括lounges， lavatories， buffets/galleys 和 coatrooms。包括transparent material， 其 frame， 霜 shield， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Doors used for entrance and exit of the passengers, flight crew and service personnel to and from the airplane. Includes items such as transparent material, its frame, etc. Does not include emergency exit windows.
expanded.definitionZH: 门 used 用于 entrance 和 exit 的 旅客， 飞行机组 和 service personnel 至 和 从 飞机。包括transparent material， 其 frame， 等 不包括 应急出口 窗等。

expanded.definitionEN: Windows used for examining compartments and equipment in and about the airplane, and astrodomes used for celestial navigation. Includes items such as transparent material, its frame, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 窗 used 用于 examining compartments 和 equipment 在 和 about 飞机， 和 astrodomes used 用于 celestial 导航。包括transparent material， 其 frame， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Skins, primary structure, fillets, and fairings of the center wing, and attach/attached fittings.
expanded.definitionZH: 蒙皮、primary 结构， 整流过渡段， 和 整流罩 的 center wing， 和 连接接头。

expanded.definitionEN: Skins, primary structure, fillets, and fairings of the outer wing, and attach/attached fittings.
expanded.definitionZH: 蒙皮、primary 结构， 整流过渡段， 和 整流罩 的 outer wing， 和 连接接头。

expanded.definitionEN: Skins and structure of the wing tip and attached fittings.
expanded.definitionZH: 蒙皮 和 结构 的 wing tip 和 attached 接头/支架。

expanded.titleEN: Leading Edge and Leading Edge Devices
expanded.definitionEN: Skins and structure of the wing leading edge and removable leading edge airfoils such as flaps, slats, attach/attached fittings, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 蒙皮 和 结构 的 wing 前缘 和 removable 前缘 airfoils 例如 襟翼， 缝翼， 连接接头， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Skins and structure of the wing and trailing edge and removable edge airfoils such as flaps and attach/attached fittings.
expanded.definitionZH: 蒙皮 和 结构 的 wing 和 后缘 和 removable edge airfoils 例如 襟翼 和 连接接头。

expanded.definitionEN: Skins and structure of ailerons and tabs including balancing devices and attach/attached fittings.
expanded.definitionZH: 蒙皮 和 结构 的 ailerons 和 调整片 including balancing devices 和 连接接头。

expanded.definitionEN: Skins and structure of wing-mounted spoilers, airbrakes, lift dumpers, attach/attached fittings, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 蒙皮 和 结构 的 wing-mounted 扰流板， airbrakes， lift dumpers， 连接接头， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: System that controls the on-ground movement of any portion of the main wing structure. Includes mechanisms, linkages, actuators, locks, indicating/warning systems, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统 该 控制装置 在-ground movement 的 any portion 的 主 wing 结构。包括mechanisms， 连杆机构， 作动器， locks， 指示/警告系统， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which rotates except the engine propeller shaft. Includes items such as blades, dome, hub, spinner, slip ring, deicer boot, distributor valve, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 rotates except 发动机 螺旋桨 shaft。包括blades， dome， hub， spinner， slip ring， deicer boot， distributor valve， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which controls the pitch of the propeller blades. Includes items such as governor synchronizers, switches, wiring, cables, levers, etc. Does not include any parts which rotate with the propeller assembly. Also includes all those units and components provided for the propulsor vector drive system. Includes flight deck control, drive motors, gearboxes, drive shafts, synchronizing shafts, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制pitch 的 螺旋桨 blades的部分。包括governor synchronizers， 开关， 导线/布线， 钢索/电缆， 手柄/杆， 等 不包括 any parts 其 rotate 带有 螺旋桨 组件等。还包括所有 这些 装置 和 部件 provided 用于 propulsor vector drive 系统。包括驾驶舱 控制， drive motors， gearboxes， drive shafts， synchronizing shafts， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to decrease run-down time or stop propeller rotation during engine power-off conditions. Includes brake mechanisms, levers, pulleys, cables, switches, wiring, plumbing, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于decrease run-down time 或 stop 螺旋桨 rotation during 发动机 功率/动力-off 情况的部分。包括brake mechanisms， 手柄/杆， 滑轮， 钢索/电缆， 开关， 导线/布线， 管路， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system used to indicate operation or activation of propeller/propulsor systems. Includes items such as light, switches, wiring etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示 操作/工作 或 activation 的 螺旋桨/propulsor 系统的部分。包括light， 开关， 导线/布线 等。

expanded.definitionEN: The complete duct assembly including vector drive attachment, fairings, stators, gearbox covers, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: complete duct 组件 including vector drive attachment， 整流罩， stators， gearbox 盖板， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Rotor blade assemblies, including the heating mate (electrical resistors) for anti-icing.
expanded.definitionZH: 旋翼 blade 组件， including heating mate (electrical resistors) 用于 anti-icing。

expanded.definitionEN: Complete rotor head(s), including blade folding system(s). Includes sleeves, spindles, dampers, rotor head fairing(s) as well as rotor shaft(s) and swashplate(s) if the rotor head and shaft constitute a non dissociable assembly.
expanded.definitionZH: Complete 旋翼桨毂(s)， including blade folding 系统(s)。包括sleeves， spindles， dampers， 旋翼桨毂 fairing(s) 作为 well 作为 旋翼 shaft(s) 和 自动倾斜器(s) 如果 旋翼桨毂 和 shaft constitute a non dissociable 组件。

expanded.titleZH: 旋翼轴/自动倾斜器组件
expanded.definitionEN: If not included in 20
expanded.definitionZH: 如果 not included 在 20。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which indicates operation or activation of rotor systems. Includes items such as lights, gauges, switches, wiring, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 指示 操作/工作 或 activation 的 旋翼 系统。包括灯， gauges， 开关， 导线/布线， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Drive shaft(s) between engine(s) and main gear box(es) and, if applicable, clutch and free wheel unit(s).
expanded.definitionZH: Drive shaft(s) between 发动机(s) 和 主 gear box(es) 和， 如果 applicable， clutch 和 free wheel unit(s)。

expanded.definitionEN: Part of the system driving the rotor(s). Includes the mechanical power take-off(s) and accessory drives but does not include the accessories themselves (alternators, hydraulic pumps, etc.). Includes the G.B. lubricating system(s) and the rotor brake(s) if the latter form(s) part of the G.B.(s).
expanded.definitionZH: Part 的 系统 driving 旋翼(s)。包括mechanical 功率/动力 take-off(s) 和 accessory drives 但 不包括 accessories themselves (alternators， hydraulic pumps， 等)。包括G。B。 lubricating 系统(s) 和 旋翼 brake(s) 如果 latter form(s) part 的 G。B。(s)。

expanded.definitionEN: Suspension bars, vibration damping system providing attachment of the G.B.(s) to the airframe.
expanded.definitionZH: Suspension bars， vibration damping 系统 providing attachment 的 G。B。(s) 至 机体。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which indicates operation or activation of rotor systems. Includes items such as lights, gauges, switches, wiring, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 指示 操作/工作 或 activation 的 旋翼 系统。包括灯， gauges， 开关， 导线/布线， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Blade assemblies, including the heating mats (electrical resistors) for anti-icing.
expanded.definitionZH: Blade 组件， including heating mats (electrical resistors) 用于 anti-icing。

expanded.definitionEN: Tail rotor head
expanded.definitionZH: Tail 旋翼桨毂。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which indicates operation or activation of rotor systems. Includes items such as lights, gauges, switches, wiring, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 指示 操作/工作 或 activation 的 旋翼 系统。包括灯， gauges， 开关， 导线/布线， 等。
expanded.noteEN: NOTE: Coverage shall be limited to front matter and Chapters 50 through 59. | NOTE: For an integral unit, only one section will be used.
expanded.noteZH: NOTE： Coverage shall be limited 至 front matter 和 Chapters 50 through 59。 NOTE： 用于 an integral unit， only one 段/章节 will be used。

expanded.definitionEN: Drive shafts, bearings, flexible couplings.
expanded.definitionZH: Drive shafts， bearings， flexible couplings。

expanded.definitionEN: Intermediate gearbox. Tail gearbox.
expanded.definitionZH: Intermediate gearbox。Tail gearbox。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which indicates operation or activation of rotor systems. Includes items such as lights, gauges, switches, wiring, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 指示 操作/工作 或 activation 的 旋翼 系统。包括灯， gauges， 开关， 导线/布线， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Part of the system ensuring rotor blade folding and spreading; includes the mechanical, hydraulic and electrical means permanently fitted on the aircraft.
expanded.definitionZH: Part 的 系统 ensuring 旋翼 blade folding 和 spreading； 包括 mechanical， hydraulic 和 electrical means permanently fitted 在 飞机。

expanded.definitionEN: Part of system ensuring tail pylon folding and spreading; includes mechanical, hydraulic and electrical means permanently fitted on the aircraft.
expanded.definitionZH: Part 的 系统 ensuring 尾梁 folding 和 spreading； 包括 mechanical， hydraulic 和 electrical means permanently fitted 在 飞机。

expanded.definitionEN: Part of the system intended for controlling folding/spreading sequences and for indicating the system operation. Includes the control units, caption lights, indicators, wiring, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: Part 的 系统 intended 用于 controlling folding/spreading sequences 和 用于 指示 系统 操作/工作。包括控制 装置， caption 灯， 指示器， 导线/布线， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which controls the attitude by the angle of attack of the rotor blades. Includes items such as collective pitch lever, cyclic pitch stick and corresponding linkage and cable controls, coupling and mixing units, and artificial feel unit system. Also includes the control position indicating system.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制姿态 由 angle 的 attack 的 旋翼桨叶的部分。包括总距 lever， 周期变距 stick 和 corresponding linkage 和 cable 控制装置， coupling 和 mixing 装置， 和 artificial feel unit 系统等。还包括控制 position 指示 系统。

expanded.titleZH: 反扭矩旋翼操纵（偏航控制）
expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the controls which control the direction of the helicopter (yaw control). Includes items such as tail rotor control pedals, relevant linkage and cable controls, bellcranks constituting the yaw control channel and the control position indicating system.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 控制装置 其 控制 方向 的 直升机 (偏航控制)。包括尾桨 控制 pedals， relevant linkage 和 cable 控制装置， bellcranks constituting 偏航控制 channel 和 控制 position 指示 系统等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which from a power source ensures distribution to the rotor servo-control system. Includes items such as pressure relief valves, electro valves, check valves, accumulators and equipment needed for the operation of the servo control system, the servo controls, the systems used for monitoring and indicating the operation of the servo control system.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 从 a 功率/动力 source ensures 分配 至 旋翼 servo-控制 系统。包括压力 relief 活门， electro 活门， check 活门， accumulators 和 equipment needed 用于 操作/工作 的 servo 控制 系统， servo 控制装置， 系统 used 用于 监控 和 指示 操作/工作 的 servo 控制 系统等。

expanded.definitionEN: This topic shall include general information, limits and procedures. In the maintenance manual this section shall cover subjects such as engine changes, run-up, externally-mounted spare power plants, etc. In the overhaul manual, this section shall cover subjects such as power plant build-up, teardown, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 本主题应包括通用/概述 information， limits 和 程序。在 维修手册 该 段/章节 shall cover subjects 例如 发动机 changes， run-up， externally-mounted spare 功率/动力 plants， 等 在 翻修手册， 该 段/章节 shall cover subjects 例如 动力装置 build-up， teardown， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those removable coverings which extend over and around the power plant assembly. Includes the functioning and maintenance aspects of items such as accessory section cowls, cowl flaps, cowling supports, and attach and locking mechanisms, etc. Does not include the structure integral with the airframe which shall be covered in the applicable Structures chapter.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 removable coverings 其 extend over 和 周围 动力装置 组件。包括functioning 和 维修 aspects 的 items 例如 accessory 段/章节 cowls， 整流罩襟片， 发动机罩/整流罩 supports， 和 attach 和 locking mechanisms， 等 不包括 结构 integral 带有 机体 其 shall be covered 在 applicable Structures chapter。

expanded.definitionEN: The framework, either of build-up construction or forgings which support the engine and attach it to the nacelle or pylon. Includes items such as engine mounts, vibration dampeners, support links, mounting bolts, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: framework， either 的 build-up construction 或 forgings 其 support 发动机 和 attach it 至 nacelle 或 pylon。包括发动机 mounts， vibration dampeners， support links， mounting bolts， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those fire-resistant partitions and seals mounted on or about the power package for the purpose of isolating areas subject to fire. Does not include those fire-walls which are included in [Chapter (System) 54].
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 火警/火-resistant partitions 和 seals mounted 在 或 about 功率/动力 package 用于 isolating areas subject 至 火警/火。不包括这些 火警/火-walls 其 are included 在 [Chapter (系统) 54]。

expanded.definitionEN: Those fittings and brackets which are used for the support of equipment in and about the power package.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 接头/支架 和 brackets 其 are used 用于 support 的 equipment 在 和 about 功率/动力 package。

expanded.definitionEN: Those electrical cables, conduits, plugs, sockets, etc., which serve several power plant systems, but which are banded together to facilitate removal and installation of the power plant. Does not include the wiring which is specifically covered under another system.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 electrical 钢索/电缆， conduits， plugs， sockets， 等， 其 serve several 动力装置 系统， 但 其 are banded together 至 facilitate removal 和 installation 的 动力装置。不包括导线/布线 其 is specifically covered under another 系统。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the power plant system which directs and may or may not vary the mass air flow to the engine. Includes items such as nose ring cowls, scoops, compressor fan cowls, buried engine ducts, vortex generators, actuators, control handles, cables, wiring, plumbing, linkages, doors, warning systems, position indicators, etc. Does not include integral structure with the airframe, which shall be included in the applicable Structures chapter.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 动力装置 系统 其 directs 和 may 或 may not vary mass air flow 至 发动机。包括nose ring cowls， scoops， 压气机 fan cowls， buried 发动机 管道， vortex generators， 作动器， 控制 handles， 钢索/电缆， 导线/布线， 管路， 连杆机构， 门， 警告系统， 位置指示器， 等 不包括 integral 结构 带有 机体， 其 shall be included 在 applicable Structures chapter等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those components and manifold assemblies which are used to drain off excess fluids from the power plant and its accessories. Includes drainlines, manifolds, tanks, flame arrestors, vents, and their supporting brackets, etc. Also includes components that are an integral part of, or fitted to the power plant cowling.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 部件 和 manifold 组件 用于 drain off excess fluids 从 动力装置 和 其 accessories。包括drainlines， manifolds， tanks， 火焰 arrestors， vents， 和 their supporting brackets， 等 Also 包括 部件 该 are an integral part 的， 或 fitted 至 动力装置 发动机罩/整流罩。

expanded.definitionEN: This topic is intended to cover general information, limits and procedures. In the engine overhaul manual this section would include such subjects as tear down, cleaning, inspection, assembly, testing, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 本主题用于涵盖通用/概述 information， limits 和 程序。在 发动机 翻修手册 该 段/章节 would include such subjects 作为 tear down， cleaning， 检查， 组件， 测试， 等。

expanded.titleEN: Reduction Gear, Shaft Section (Turbo-Prop and/or Front Mounted Gear Driven Propulsor)
expanded.titleZH: 减速齿轮和轴段（涡桨和/或前置齿轮驱动推进器）
expanded.definitionEN: The section of the engine which contains the propeller shafts and reduction gears. Includes items such as drives for hose mounted accessories, etc. If applicable, the section of the engine which uses mechanical force, through a gear-driven system, to drive front mounted propulsors which provide the majority of the energy generated. Includes items such as Propulsor Blades, Actuation Systems, Reduction Gears, Drive-Shafts, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 段/章节 的 发动机 其 contains 螺旋桨 shafts 和 reduction gears。包括drives 用于 hose mounted accessories， 等 如果 applicable， 段/章节 的 发动机 其 uses mechanical force， through a gear-driven 系统， 至 drive front mounted propulsors 用于提供 majority 的 energy generated等。包括Propulsor Blades， Actuation 系统， Reduction Gears， Drive-Shafts， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: The section of the engine through which the air enters the compressor section. Includes items such as guide vanes, shrouds, cases, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 段/章节 的 发动机 through 其 air enters 压气机 段/章节。包括guide vanes， shrouds， cases， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: The section of the engine in which the the air is compressed. Includes items such as cases, vanes, shrouds, rotors, diffusers, etc. Also includes the maintenance and overhaul of stator blades but not the operation of variable stator blades which is covered under [Chapter (System) 75 - 30]. Does not include compressor bleed system.
expanded.definitionZH: 段/章节 的 发动机 在 其 air is compressed。包括cases， vanes， shrouds， 旋翼， diffusers， 等 Also 包括 维修和翻修 的 stator blades 但 not 操作/工作 的 variable stator blades 其 is covered under [Chapter (系统) 75 - 30]等。不包括压气机 bleed 系统。

expanded.definitionEN: The section of the engine in which the air and fuel are combined and burned. Includes items such as burner cans, cases, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 段/章节 的 发动机 在 其 air 和 fuel are combined 和 burned。包括burner cans， cases， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: The section of the engine containing the turbines. Includes items such as turbine nozzles, turbine rotors, cases, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 段/章节 的 发动机 containing turbines。包括涡轮 nozzles， 涡轮 旋翼， cases， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: The mechanical power take-offs to drive accessories. Includes items such as engine-mounted gear boxes, gears, seals, pumps, etc. Does not include remotely installed gear boxes which are covered in [Chapter (System) 83].
expanded.definitionZH: mechanical 功率/动力 take-offs 至 drive accessories。包括发动机-mounted gear boxes， gears， seals， pumps， 等 不包括 remotely installed gear boxes 其 are covered 在 [Chapter (系统) 83]等。

expanded.definitionEN: The section of the engine which by-passes a portion of the normal engine airflow (either ram or compressed air) for the prime purpose of adding to engine thrust or reducing specific fuel consumption.
expanded.definitionZH: 段/章节 的 发动机 其 由-passes a portion 的 normal 发动机 airflow (either ram 或 compressed air) 用于 prime purpose 的 adding 至 发动机 推力 或 reducing specific fuel consumption。

expanded.definitionEN: The section of the engine which contains a propulsor(s) and provides the majority of the energy generated. The propulsor may be turbine-driven or gear-driven. Includes such items as propulsor turbines, propulsor blades, blade actuation, and frames (rotating and/or stationary).
expanded.definitionZH: 段/章节 的 发动机 其 contains a propulsor(s) 和 provides majority 的 energy generated。propulsor may be 涡轮-driven 或 gear-driven。包括propulsor turbines， propulsor blades， blade actuation， 和 frames (rotating 和/或 stationary)等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system from the main quick disconnect to the engine, which distributes fuel to the engine burner section and the thrust augmentor. Includes items such as plumbing, pumps, temperature regulators, valves, filters, manifold, nozzles, etc. Does not include the main or thrust augmentor fuel control.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 从 主 quick disconnect 至 发动机， 其 distributes fuel 至 发动机 burner 段/章节 和 推力 augmentor。包括管路， pumps， 温度 regulators， 活门， filters， manifold， nozzles， 等 不包括 主 或 推力 augmentor 燃油控制等。

expanded.definitionEN: The main fuel control which meters fuel to the engine and to the thrust augmentor. Includes items such as hydromechanical or electronic fuel control, levers, actuators, cables, pulleys, linkages, sensors, valves, etc. which are components of the fuel control units.
expanded.definitionZH: 主 燃油控制 其 meters fuel 至 发动机 和 至 推力 augmentor。包括hydromechanical 或 electronic 燃油控制， 手柄/杆， 作动器， 钢索/电缆， 滑轮， 连杆机构， 传感器， 活门， 等 其 are 部件 的 燃油控制 装置等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to indicate the flow rate, temperature and pressure of the fuel. Includes items such as transmitters, indicators, wiring, etc. Does not include indication, if indication is accomplished as part of an integrated engine instrument system (Ref. [Chapter (System) 77-40]).
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示 flow rate， 温度和压力 的 fuel的部分。包括传感/发送器， 指示器， 导线/布线， 等 不包括 indication， 如果 indication is accomplished 作为 part 的 an 综合发动机仪表系统 (Ref等。[Chapter (系统) 77-40])。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which generates electrical current for the purpose of igniting the fuel mixture in the combustion chambers and thrust augmentors. Includes items such as magnetos, distributors, booster coils, exciters, transformers, storage capacitors and compositors, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 generates 电流 用于 igniting fuel mixture 在 燃烧 chambers 和 推力 augmentors。包括磁电机， distributors， booster coils， exciters， transformers， storage capacitors 和 compositors， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which conducts high or low voltage electricity from the electrical power supply to the spark plugs, or igniters. Includes wiring between magneto and distributor in those systems where they are separate units. Includes items such as ignition harness, high tension leads, coils as used in "low tension" systems, spark plugs, igniters, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 conducts high 或 low voltage electricity 从 电源 供给 至 火花塞， 或 点火器。包括导线/布线 between magneto 和 distributor 在 这些 系统 其中 they are separate 装置。包括点火 harness， high tension leads， coils 作为 used 在 "low tension" 系统， 火花塞， 点火器， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which provides a means of rendering the electrical power supply inoperative. Includes items such as ignition switches, wiring, connectors, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供a means 的 rendering 电源 供给 inoperative的部分。包括点火 开关， 导线/布线， connectors， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to eliminate and prevent the formation of ice by bleed air in all parts of the engine, excluding power plant cowling which is covered under [Chapter (System) 30]. Includes items such as valves, plumbing, wiring, regulators, etc. Electrical anti-icing is covered in [Chapter (System) 30].
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于消除 和 防止 结冰 由 bleed air 在 所有 parts 的 发动机， excluding 动力装置 发动机罩/整流罩 其 is covered under [Chapter (系统) 30]的部分。包括活门， 管路， 导线/布线， regulators， 等 电防冰 is covered 在 [Chapter (系统) 30]等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to ventilate the engine and accessories. Includes items such as valves, plumbing, wiring, jet pumps, vortex spoilers, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于ventilate 发动机 和 accessories的部分。包括活门， 管路， 导线/布线， jet pumps， vortex 扰流板， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to control the flow of air through the engine. Includes items such as governors, valves, actuators, linkages, etc. Also includes the operation of variable stator blades, but not the maintenance and overhaul, which shall be covered under [Chapter (System) 72-30].
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于控制 flow 的 air through 发动机的部分。包括governors， 活门， 作动器， 连杆机构， 等 Also 包括 操作/工作 的 variable stator blades， 但 not 维修和翻修， 其 shall be covered under [Chapter (系统) 72-30]等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to indicate temperature, pressure, control positions, etc. of the air systems. Includes items such as transmitters, indicators, wiring, etc
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示 温度， 压力， 控制 positions， 等 的 air 系统的部分。包括传感/发送器， 指示器， 导线/布线， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which furnishes a means of controlling the main fuel control or coordinator. Includes controls to the propeller regulator on turboprop engines. Includes items such as linkages, cables, levers, pulleys, switches, wiring, etc. Does not include the units themselves.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供a means 的 controlling 主 燃油控制 或 coordinator的部分。包括控制装置 至 螺旋桨 regulator 在 turboprop engines。包括连杆机构， 钢索/电缆， 手柄/杆， 滑轮， 开关， 导线/布线， 等 不包括 装置 themselves等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which furnishes a means of controlling the flow of fluids to and from the engine during emergency procedures. Includes items such as levers, cables, pulleys, linkages, switches, wiring, etc. Does not include the units themselves.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于提供a means 的 controlling flow 的 fluids 至 和 从 发动机 during 应急 程序的部分。包括手柄/杆， 钢索/电缆， 滑轮， 连杆机构， 开关， 导线/布线， 等 不包括 装置 themselves等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which directly or indirectly indicates power or thrust. Includes items such as BMEP, pressure-ratio, RPM, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 directly 或 indirectly 指示 功率/动力 或 推力。包括BMEP， 压力-ratio， RPM， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which indicates temperatures in the engine. Includes items such as cylinder head, exhaust (turbine inlet), etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 指示 temperatures 在 发动机。包括cylinder head， exhaust (涡轮 inlet)， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to analyze engine performance or condition by means of instruments or devices such as oscilloscopes, etc. Includes items such as generators, wiring, amplifiers, oscilloscopes, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于analyze 发动机 performance 或 condition 由 means 的 instruments 或 devices 例如 oscilloscopes， 等 包括 generators， 导线/布线， 放大器， oscilloscopes， 等的部分。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is an integrated concept receives several/all engine operating parameters and transmits this to a central processor for crew presentation. Includes items such as display units, transmitters, receivers, computers, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 is an 综合 concept receives several/所有 发动机 operating parameters 和 transmits 该 至 a central processor 用于 机组 presentation。包括显示组件， 传感/发送器， receivers， 计算机， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which collects the exhaust gases from the cylinders or turbines and conducts them overboard. Includes items such as collector rings, exhaust and thrust augmentor ducts, variable nozzles, actuators, plumbing, linkages, wiring, position indicators, warning systems, etc. Does not include power recovery turbines, turbo-superchargers, etc., not noise suppressors or thrust reversers where they are not an integral part of the nozzle system.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 collects 排气 从 cylinders 或 turbines 和 conducts them overboard。包括collector rings， exhaust 和 推力 augmentor 管道， variable nozzles， 作动器， 管路， 连杆机构， 导线/布线， 位置指示器， 警告系统， 等 不包括 功率/动力 recovery turbines， turbo-superchargers， 等， not noise suppressors 或 推力 reversers 其中 they are not an integral part 的 nozzle 系统等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which reduces the noise generated by the exhaust gases. Includes items such as pipes, baffles, shields, actuators, plumbing linkages, wiring, position indicators, warning systems, etc. Use -10 where integral part of nozzle system.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 reduces noise generated 由 排气。包括pipes， baffles， shields， 作动器， 管路 连杆机构， 导线/布线， 位置指示器， 警告系统， 等 Use -10 其中 integral part 的 nozzle 系统等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to change the direction of the exhaust gases for reverse thrust. Includes items such as clamshells, linkages, levers, actuators, plumbing, wiring, indicators, warning systems, etc. Use -10 where integral part of nozzle system.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于change 方向 的 排气 用于 reverse 推力的部分。包括clamshells， 连杆机构， 手柄/杆， 作动器， 管路， 导线/布线， 指示器， 警告系统， 等 Use -10 其中 integral part 的 nozzle 系统等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which varies and controls supplementary air flow of the exhaust system. Includes items such as tertiary air doors, actuators, linkages, springs, plumbing, wiring, position indicators, warning systems, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 varies 和 控制装置 supplementary air flow 的 exhaust 系统。包括tertiary air 门， 作动器， 连杆机构， springs， 管路， 导线/布线， 位置指示器， 警告系统， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system used for storage of oil. Includes items such as tanks, filling systems, internal hoppers, baffles, tank sump and drain, etc. Does not include tanks which are an integral portion of the engine.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 used 用于 storage 的 oil。包括tanks， filling 系统， 内部 hoppers， baffles， tank sump 和 drain， 等 不包括 tanks 其 are an integral portion 的 发动机等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to conduct oil from and to the engine. Includes items such as plumbing, valves, temperature regulator, control systems, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于conduct oil 从 和 至 发动机的部分。包括管路， 活门， 温度 regulator， 控制 系统， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to indicate the quantity, temperature and pressure of the oil. Includes items such as transmitters, indicators, wiring, warning systems, etc. Does not include indication if indication is accomplished as part of an integrated engine instrument system (ref. [Chapter (System) 77-40]).
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示oil的数量、温度和压力的部分。包括传感/发送器， 指示器， 导线/布线， 警告系统， 等 不包括 indication 如果 indication is accomplished 作为 part 的 an 综合发动机仪表系统 (ref等。[Chapter (系统) 77-40])。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to perform the cranking portion of the starting operation. Includes items such as plumbing, valves, wiring, starters, switches, relays, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于perform cranking portion 的 起动 操作/工作的部分。包括管路， 活门， 导线/布线， starters， 开关， 继电器， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: The turbines which extract energy from the exhaust gases and are coupled to the crankshaft.
expanded.definitionZH: turbines 其 extract energy 从 排气 和 are coupled 至 crankshaft。

expanded.definitionEN: The turbines which extract energy from the exhaust gases and drive an air compressor.
expanded.definitionZH: turbines 其 extract energy 从 排气 和 drive an air 压气机。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used for the storage of water or water mixtures. Includes tank sealing, attachment of bladder type cells, ventilating system, cell and tank interconnectors, filling systems, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 该 portion 的 系统 其 is used 用于 storage 的 water 或 water mixtures。包括tank sealing， attachment 的 bladder type cells， ventilating 系统， cell 和 tank interconnectors， filling 系统， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to conduct water or water mixtures from the tanks or cells to the engine. Includes items such as plumbing, crossfeed system, pumps, valves, controls, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于conduct water 或 water mixtures 从 tanks 或 cells 至 发动机的部分。包括管路， crossfeed 系统， pumps， 活门， 控制装置， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to dump injection water and to purge the system. Includes items such as plumbing, valves, controls, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于dump injection water 和 至 purge 系统的部分。包括管路， 活门， 控制装置， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to indicate the quantity, temperature and pressure of the water mixtures. Includes items such as transmitters, indicators, wiring, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于指示water mixtures的数量、温度和压力的部分。包括传感/发送器， 指示器， 导线/布线， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: That portion of the system which is used to conduct power from the engine to the gearbox. Includes items such as drive shaft, adapters, seals, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: 系统中用于conduct 功率/动力 从 发动机 至 gearbox的部分。包括drive shaft， 适配器， seals， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: The case which contains the gear trains and shafts. Includes items such as gears, shafts, seals, oil pumps, coolers, etc.
expanded.definitionZH: case 其 contains gear trains 和 shafts。包括gears， shafts， seals， oil pumps， coolers， 等。

expanded.definitionEN: Those units or components dedicated to jet assist takeoff (JATO) systems.
expanded.definitionZH: 这些 装置 或 部件 dedicated 至 jet assist takeoff (JATO) 系统。

entries.sourceStatement: FAA Joint Aircraft System/Component (JASC) Code Table and Definitions; modified ATA Spec 100 four-digit public reference

entries.noteEN: Public authoritative 4-digit JASC/ATA-derived code. Use OEM/A4A iSpec 2200 for current proprietary ATA manual structures if required.
entries.sourceStatement: FAA Joint Aircraft System/Component (JASC) Code Table and Definitions; modified ATA Spec 100 four-digit public reference

entries.sourceStatement: FAA Joint Aircraft System/Component (JASC) Code Table and Definitions; modified ATA Spec 100 four-digit public reference

entries.definitionEN: For reports of miscellaneous system components or parts other than the controller, indicator, sensor, regulator, or outflow valves. Typical parts are amplifier, switch, electrical connector, etc.
entries.noteEN: Public authoritative 4-digit JASC/ATA-derived code. Use OEM/A4A iSpec 2200 for current proprietary ATA manual structures if required.

entries.definitionEN: The units and systems, which measure differential, pressure and transmit a signal. Typical parts are pressure switch, transducer, etc.

entries.sourceStatement: FAA Joint Aircraft System/Component (JASC) Code Table and Definitions; modified ATA Spec 100 four-digit public reference

entries.definitionEN: The units and systems supplying heated air to the cockpit or cabin. Includes the heat source (heater), controlling aspects, and temperature sensors/indicators. Typical parts are fuel pump, filter, plumbing, circuitry, relay, heat exchanger, igniter, etc.

entries.sourceStatement: FAA Joint Aircraft System/Component (JASC) Code Table and Definitions; modified ATA Spec 100 four-digit public reference

entries.definitionEN: The units and systems supplying cooled air to the cockpit or cabin. Does not include the temperature control and indicating system. Typical parts are flow valve, relay, condenser, ram air sensor, heat exchanger, cooling turbine, air cycle machine, etc.
entries.noteEN: Public authoritative 4-digit JASC/ATA-derived code. Use OEM/A4A iSpec 2200 for current proprietary ATA manual structures if required.
entries.sourceStatement: FAA Joint Aircraft System/Component (JASC) Code Table and Definitions; modified ATA Spec 100 four-digit public reference

entries.definitionEN: The units and circuitry other than the control unit which are used for controlling the temperature of the air in the cockpit and cabin. Typical parts are control valves, thermal sensing devices, switches, amplifiers, and wiring.
entries.noteEN: Public authoritative 4-digit JASC/ATA-derived code. Use OEM/A4A iSpec 2200 for current proprietary ATA manual structures if required.

entries.definitionEN: For reports of the parts within the cabin temperature control unit. A typical entry would only reference the "control unit" if specific part numbers are not available.
entries.noteEN: Public authoritative 4-digit JASC/ATA-derived code. Use OEM/A4A iSpec 2200 for current proprietary ATA manual structures if required.
entries.sourceStatement: FAA Joint Aircraft System/Component (JASC) Code Table and Definitions; modified ATA Spec 100 four-digit public reference

entries.definitionEN: For reports of the indicators, lamps and associated circuitry which indicates the air temperature in the cabin.

entries.definitionEN: For reports of the sensors and associated circuitry sensing the temperature of the air in the cabin and relays a signal to the indicator.

entries.definitionEN: For reports of system parts that control humidity. Typical parts are bag, sock, filter, moisture separator, etc.

entries.definitionEN: The units and components that furnish a means of automatically controlling flight of the aircraft. Includes those units and components controlling direction, heading, attitude, altitude, and speed. Use this code when there is insufficient information to file in a more specific JASC 2200 series code.
entries.noteEN: Public authoritative 4-digit JASC/ATA-derived code. Use OEM/A4A iSpec 2200 for current proprietary ATA manual structures if required.
entries.sourceStatement: FAA Joint Aircraft System/Component (JASC) Code Table and Definitions; modified ATA Spec 100 four-digit public reference

entries.definitionEN: For reports of miscellaneous parts associated with the autopilot system used for controlling attitude and direction. Typical parts are yaw damper, cable, switch, sensor, relay, etc. The major components such as computer, servo, and controller are to be filed in the specific JASC 2200 series code.
entries.noteEN: Public authoritative 4-digit JASC/ATA-derived code. Use OEM/A4A iSpec 2200 for current proprietary ATA manual structures if required.
entries.sourceStatement: FAA Joint Aircraft System/Component (JASC) Code Table and Definitions; modified ATA Spec 100 four-digit public reference

entries.definitionEN: For reports pertaining to the autopilot computer only. Typical parts are resistor, circuit board, capacitor, or power supply, etc.
entries.noteEN: Public authoritative 4-digit JASC/ATA-derived code. Use OEM/A4A iSpec 2200 for current proprietary ATA manual structures if required.
entries.sourceStatement: FAA Joint Aircraft System/Component (JASC) Code Table and Definitions; modified ATA Spec 100 four-digit public reference

entries.definitionEN: The units transmitting output information signals to automatically maintain a predetermined altitude, rate of climb, or descent. Does not include the connecting system parts such as the sensor switch. The controller make and model should be included.
entries.noteEN: Public authoritative 4-digit JASC/ATA-derived code. Use OEM/A4A iSpec 2200 for current proprietary ATA manual structures if required.
entries.sourceStatement: FAA Joint Aircraft System/Component (JASC) Code Table and Definitions; modified ATA Spec 100 four-digit public reference

entries.definitionEN: The command unit of an autopilot system. It is manually operated to generate signals which cause the aircraft to climb, dive, or perform coordinated turns. The controller make and model should be included.
entries.noteEN: Public authoritative 4-digit JASC/ATA-derived code. Use OEM/A4A iSpec 2200 for current proprietary ATA manual structures if required.
entries.sourceStatement: FAA Joint Aircraft System/Component (JASC) Code Table and Definitions; modified ATA Spec 100 four-digit public reference

entries.definitionEN: The instrument and associated circuitry that indicates the trim position selected by the pilot.

entries.definitionEN: The unit mechanically connected to primary flight control actuating mechanisms, which is used to mechanically reposition control surfaces in accordance with electrical or pneumatic signals from a controller.

entries.sourceStatement: FAA Joint Aircraft System/Component (JASC) Code Table and Definitions; modified ATA Spec 100 four-digit public reference

entries.definitionEN: The system which automatically maintains safe flight conditions by correcting for effects of speed and out-of-trim conditions by such means as automatic trim, mach trim, or speed stability and mach feel. This includes sensing, computing, actuating, indicating, internal monitoring, warning devices, etc.
entries.noteEN: Public authoritative 4-digit JASC/ATA-derived code. Use OEM/A4A iSpec 2200 for current proprietary ATA manual structures if required.
entries.sourceStatement: FAA Joint Aircraft System/Component (JASC) Code Table and Definitions; modified ATA Spec 100 four-digit public reference

entries.definitionEN: The system that automatically controls the position of the throttles to properly manage engine power during all phases of flight/attitude. This includes engaging, sensing, computing, amplifying, controlling, actuating and warning devices. Typical parts are amplifiers, computers, servos, limit switches, clutches, gearboxes, warning lights, etc.
entries.noteEN: Public authoritative 4-digit JASC/ATA-derived code. Use OEM/A4A iSpec 2200 for current proprietary ATA manual structures if required.
entries.sourceStatement: FAA Joint Aircraft System/Component (JASC) Code Table and Definitions; modified ATA Spec 100 four-digit public reference

entries.definitionEN: The system that automatically corrects and provides for gust loading/upset, aerodynamic augmentation, alleviation, suppression, ride control, etc. This includes sensing, computing, actuating, indicating, internal monitoring, warning devices, etc.
entries.noteEN: Public authoritative 4-digit JASC/ATA-derived code. Use OEM/A4A iSpec 2200 for current proprietary ATA manual structures if required.
entries.sourceStatement: FAA Joint Aircraft System/Component (JASC) Code Table and Definitions; modified ATA Spec 100 four-digit public reference

entries.definitionEN: For reports indicating a problem with wiring specific to the Autoflight/Auto Pilot System.
entries.noteEN: Public authoritative 4-digit JASC/ATA-derived code. Use OEM/A4A iSpec 2200 for current proprietary ATA manual structures if required.
entries.sourceStatement: FAA Joint Aircraft System/Component (JASC) Code Table and Definitions; modified ATA Spec 100 four-digit public reference

entries.definitionEN: The units and components furnishing a means of communicating from one part of the aircraft to another and between the aircraft or ground stations, includes voice, data, continuous wave (C-W) communicating components, passenger announcement systems, intercom, inflight telephones, and tape reproducers-record player. Use this code when insufficient information is reported to file in a more specific JASC 2300 series code. Also for reports of units or parts common to more than one communication system.
entries.noteEN: Public authoritative 4-digit JASC/ATA-derived code. Use OEM/A4A iSpec 2200 for current proprietary ATA manual structures if required.

entries.definitionEN: The system parts and circuitry including the receiver, transmitter, and antenna used exclusively for ultra high frequency (UHF) communications.
